84.summary: Nami asks Tony Tony Chopper to join the crew, but he isn't interested. Kureha tells Nami that Chopper is a reindeer who ate the Human-Human Fruit and some of what was his background. After realizing the abilities that Chopper has, Luffy is eager to make him join the crew.

85.title_eng: Freaky  An Outcast's Dream! Hiriluk the Quack!
85.title_romanji: Hamidashimono no yume! Yabu isha Hiruruku!
85.title_jap: はみだし者の夢!やぶ医者ヒルルク!
85.summary: Doctorine continues to tell how Chopper lived his life and how the quack doctor Hiruluk took care of him.

86.title_eng: The Impossible Dream Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms and the Will that Gets Carried On!
86.title_romanji: Hiruruku no sakura to uketsugare yuku ishi!
86.title_jap: ヒルルクの桜と受け継がれゆく意志!
86.summary: More of Chopper's past is revealed, including the fate of doctor Hiruluk and Wapol's cruelties as the king. Meanwhile, Wapol reaches the castle where the crew is residing.

87.title_eng: Defending the Flag Fight Wapol's Crew! The Power of the Munch Munch Fruit!
87.title_romanji: VS Waporu gundan! Bakubaku no mi no nōryoku!
87.title_jap: VSワポル軍団!バクバクの実の能力!
87.summary: Wapol is determined to bring down Hiruluk's flag, and to do that, he engages Sanji, Luffy and Chopper in a fight.

88.title_eng: Let's Get Ready to Rumble  Zoan-type Devil Fruit! Chopper's Seven-form Transformation!
88.title_romanji: Zōn kei akuma no mi! Choppā Shichidan Hengei
88.title_jap: 動物系悪魔の実!チョッパー七段変形
88.summary: Chopper demonstrates the abilities of Rumble Balls when fighting Chessmarimo. Dalton is uncovered from the avalanche.

89.title_eng: The Once & Future King  When the Kingdom's Rule Ends! The Flag of Faith Flies Forever!
89.title_romanji: Ōkoku no shihai owaru toki! Shinnen no hata wa eien ni
89.title_jap: 王国の支配終る時!信念の旗は永遠に
89.summary: After trying every trick in the castle, Wapol is finally hunted down by Luffy. The villagers along with Zoro, Vivi and Usopp start their ascent to the castle through a ropeway.

90.title_eng: Doc Rock  Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms! Miracle in the Drum Rockies!
90.title_romanji: Hiruruku no sakura! Doramu Rokkī no kiseki
90.title_jap: ヒルルクの桜!ドラムロッキーの奇跡
90.summary: After finally being convinced to join the team, Chopper announces his intentions to Dr. Kureha, who doesn't take it too well; but after escaping from the castle, she has decided to give the whole Straw Hat crew a farewell gift.

91.title_eng: Heading For Disaster  Goodbye Drum Island! I'm Going Out to Sea!
91.title_romanji: Sayōnara Doramujima! Boku wa umi e deru!
91.title_jap: さようならドラム島!僕は海へ出る!
91.summary: Chopper joins the Straw Hat crew as they continue their journey to Vivi's homeland.

92.title_eng: Face Off  Alabasta's Hero and a Ballerina on the Ship!
92.title_romanji: Arabasuta no eiyū to senjō no barerīna
92.title_jap: アラバスタの英雄と船上のバレリーナ
92.summary: Crocodile appears to stop rampaging pirates. Luffy and his crew meet Mr. 2 (Bon Clay) who shows off his Copy-Copy Fruit power and Vivi sees a shocking sight.

93.title_eng: Boogie Powder Off to the Desert Kingdom! The Rain-Summoning Powder and the Rebel Army!
93.title_romanji: Iza sabaku no kuni e! Ame o yobu kona to hanrangun
93.title_jap: いざ砂漠の国へ!雨を呼ぶ粉と反乱軍
93.summary: Luffy separates from the rest of the crew to find food, right after arriving at Alabasta's port city of Nanohana. The crew dons disguises while Luffy learns of Dance Powder.

94.title_eng: Chasing Luffy The Heroes Reunion! His Name is Fire Fist Ace!
94.title_romanji: Gōketsutachi no saikai! Yatsu no na wa hiken no Ēsu
94.title_jap: 豪傑達の再会!奴の名は火拳のエース
94.summary: While in Nanohana, the Straw Hats encounter Smoker and Tashigi. A powerful pirate named Portags D. "Fire Fist" Ace appears, and is revealed to be Luffy's older brother.

95.title_eng: Oh, Brother! Ace and Luffy! Hot Emotions and Brotherly Bonds!
95.title_romanji: Ēsu to Luffy! Atsuki omoi to kyōdai no kizuna
95.title_jap: エースとルフィ!熱き想いと兄弟の絆
95.summary: Ace fights Smoker while the Straw Hats run for their ship. Luffy reunites with his older brother, who has joined the Whitebeard Pirates after leaving home, and is searching for a former crewmate named Blackbeard who killed a fellow member. The brothers take down agents of Baroque Works, and Ace demonstrates his Flame-Flame Fruit power by destroying several ships in one attack.

96.title_eng: All Dried Up Erumalu, the City of Green and the Kung Fu Dugongs!
96.title_romanji: Midori no machi Erumaru to Kunfū Jugon!
96.title_jap: 緑の町エルマルとクンフージュゴン!
96.summary: Ace decides to travel with the Straw Hats, as he is hunting for a man known as Blackbeard. The group arrives first at the 'Green City' of Erumalu only to find it abandoned to the desert. Vivi and Nami explain what Dance Powder is and what it has done to Alabasta.

97.title_eng: Humps, Bumps & Chumps Adventure in the Country of Sand! The Monsters that Live in the Scorching Land!
97.title_romanji: Suna no kuni no bōken! Ennetsu no daichi ni sugomu mamono
97.title_jap: 砂の国の冒険!炎熱の大地に棲む魔物
97.summary: After leaving Erumalu, the Straw Hats plus Vivi & Ace continue through the desert, facing the many dangers of it.

98.title_eng: The Sand Trap Enter the Desert Pirates! The Men Who Live Freely!
98.title_romanji: Sabaku no kaizokudan tōjō! Jiyū ni ikiru otokotachi
98.title_jap: 砂漠の海賊団登場!自由に生きる男達
98.summary: Nami and Vivi found themselves an easier way to travel in the desert and leave all men behind. While trying to catch up with them, Ace gets lost. Luffy and the rest of the gang find the Desert Pirates, and Vivi meets a figure from her past. She learns that the two met while they were young girls, and despite her father's offer to help if anything happened to the town, the town was abandoned when the drought started and the sandstorms hit. Vivi apologizes and the two reconcile.

99.title_eng: Tough Bluff False Fortitude! Camu, Rebel Soldier at Heart!
99.title_romanji: Nisemono no iji! Kokoro no hanrangun Kamyu!
99.title_jap: ニセモノの意地!心の反乱軍カミュ!
99.summary: After hearing that a small village has fake Rebel Army bodyguards that have been keeping peace, Vivi asks the men of the crew to test if they're worthy of staying. While they initially are planning to run at the first sign of a real threat, they stand their ground, and are allowed to stay as the Straw Hats retreat.

100.title_eng: Kids of the Kingdom Rebel Warrior Koza! The Dream Vowed to Vivi!
100.title_romanji: Hanrangun senshi Kōza! Bibi ni chikatta yume!
100.title_jap: 反乱軍戦士コーザ!ビビに誓った夢!
100.summary: Still trekking through the Alabasta desert, the crew beats up a giant desert scorpion for lunch, while Vivi tells Nami about her past and her friendship with Kohza. When his village faced a drought, he appealed the king for help, and Cobra allowed the villagers to stay in the capital. He and Vivi were initially not on good terms, getting into a fight when they first met, but Vivi became vice-leader of the Sand Sand Clan, and Kohza's group risked their lives to save her from kidnappers. Kohza then left with his father to establish a new town called Yuba.

101.title_eng: Scorpion Showdown in a Heat Haze! Ace vs. the Gallant Scorpion!
101.title_romanji: Yōen no kettō! Ēsu vs otoko sukōpion
101.title_jap: 陽炎の決闘!エースVS男スコーピオン
101.summary: Ace fights against a bounty hunter, who claims to have defeated Blackbeard, although this was a lie to lure Ace out and challenge him in order to inspire his children to follow their dreams. Ace finds out that Blackbeard isn't in Alabasta after all, and leaves the group to continue looking for him. He leaves Luffy a mysterious piece of paper, explaining that it will let them meet again.

102.title_eng: Secret Beneath the Sand Ruins and Lost Ways! Vivi, Her Friends, and the Country's Form!
102.title_romanji: Kiseki to maigo! Bibi to nakama to kuni no katachi
102.title_jap: 遺跡と迷子!ビビと仲間と国のかたち
102.summary: Zoro, Chopper and Luffy manage to get themselves lost and stumble across some huge underground ruins.

103.title_eng: Odd Numbers Spiders Café at 8 o'Clock! The Enemy Leaders Gather!
103.title_romanji: Supaidāzu Kafe ni hachiji teki kanbu shūgō
103.title_jap: スパイダーズカフェに8時敵幹部集合
103.summary: Baroque Works plan starts to take effect, and for that, the Number Agents gather to meet Mr. 0. Meanwhile, the crew finds out that the Rebel Army has moved out of Yuba and headed to Katorea, and the rebel leader Kohza is determined to attack.

104.title_eng: Zero Luffy vs. Vivi! The Tearful Vow to Put Friends on the Line!
104.title_romanji: Rufi vs Bibi! Nakama ni kakeru namida no chikai
104.title_jap: ルフィVSビビ!仲間に賭ける涙の誓い
104.summary: In Yuba, Luffy learns that Toto was entrusted by Cobra to watch over the land and figures out a way to stop the sandstorm. At Rain Dinners, the Officer Agents learn that their leader, Mr. 0, is actually Crocodile, and learn that they are going to overthrow the country during the war. Mr. 3 reveals that the Straw Hats are alive. As punishment, Crocodile dries him up and drops him into a Bananagator pit for failing to kill them. Crocodile has Ms. All-Sunday tell the rebel army to kill everyone on sight. Meanwhile, the Straw Hats depart to Katorea, but Luffy stops. When Luffy tells Vivi of his plan to defeat Crocodile and denounces Vivi's plan to stop the rebellion as naive, the two get into a struggle. During this, Vivi reveals that she will only risk her own life. Luffy, however, says that she should be putting their lives on the line together and to trust her friends, and Vivi is moved to tears by his statement.

105.title_eng: Chase to Rainbase The Battlefront of Alabasta! Rainbase, the City of Dreams!
105.title_romanji: Arabasuta sensen! Yume no machi Reinbēsu!
105.title_jap: アラバスタ戦線!夢の町レインベース
105.summary: After the struggle, Vivi decides to go after Crocodile with the Straw Hats. The crew travels to the city of Rainbase, but run afoul of Smoker and Tashigi. They run toward Rain Dinners, walking into Crocodile's trap.

106.title_eng: Caged! The Trap of Certain Defeat! Storming Raindinners!
106.title_romanji: Zettai zetsumei no wana! Reindināzu totsunyū
106.title_jap: 絶体絶命の罠!レインディナーズ突入
106.summary: Most of the Straw Hats, along with Smoker, are trapped by Crocodile. Vivi reunites with the royal guardian Pell, but is captured by Miss All-Sunday. Crocodile reveals his invincible Devil Fruit power.

107.title_eng: Kingnapped Operation Utopia Commences! The Swell of Rebellion Stirs!
107.title_jap: ユートピア作戦発動!動き出した
107.summary: Baroque Works' plan to take over Alabasta is set in motion. The king is kidnapped, and Mr. 2 impersonates him, framing him for ordering the destruction of Nanohana to cover up the Dance Powder incident there, and the rebel army begins to move.

108.title_eng: They Call Me Mr. Prince The Terrifying Banana Gators and Mr. Prince!
108.title_romanji: Kyōfu no Bananawani to Misutā Purinsu
108.title_jap: 恐怖のバナナワニとミスタープリンス
108.summary: Most of the Straw Hats are helplessly trapped as Vivi tries desperately to get the key to their cage but fails. Crocodile is contacted by someone known as "Mr. Prince."

109.title_eng: The Great Escape The Key to a Great Comeback Escape! The Wax-Wax Ball!
109.title_romanji: Gyakuden dai dasshutsu e no kagi! Dorudoru Bōru!
109.title_jap: 逆転大脱出への鍵!ドルドルボール!
109.summary: "Mr Prince" is actually Sanji, and lures Crocodile out of the casino. Sanji goes to rescue the Straw Hats, and manages to open their cage by having Mr. 3, who was swallowed by one of the Bananagators, copy the key with his Wax-Wax Fruit powers. The room floods, but the Straw Hats swim to safety. Luffy orders Zoro to save Smoker, and he allows them to escape for the moment as they race to stop the rebellion.

110.title_eng: Zero Tolerance Merciless Mortal Combat! Luffy vs. Crocodile!
110.title_romanji: Nasakemuyō no shitō! Rufi vs Kurokodairu!
110.title_jap: 情無用の死闘!ルフィVSクロコダイル
110.summary: After escaping from Rain Dinners, the Straw Hats and Vivi cross the desert to Alubarne, where the final battle will take place. Crocodile, however, manages to catch Luffy, beginning the first round of their battle. Luffy is unable to land a hit on Crocodile because of his Sand-Sand fruit powers, which enable him to turn into sand to avoid any attack.

111.title_eng: Off the Hook Dash For a Miracle! Alabasta Animal Land!
111.title_romanji: Kiseki e no Shissō! Arabasuta Dōbutsu Rando
111.title_jap: 奇跡への疾走!アラバスタ動物ランド
111.summary: Luffy is left for dead by Crocodile, but is helped by the mysterious Miss All-Sunday. The rest of the Straw Hats reach Alubarna.

112.title_eng: Rebel Rousers Rebel Army vs. Royal Army! Showdown at Alubarna!
112.title_romanji: Hanrangun vs kokuōgun! Kessen wa Arubāna!
112.title_jap: 反乱軍VS国王軍!決戦はアルバーナ!
112.summary: The revolution is on the verge of starting and the crew comes out with a plan that could stop it. Vivi tries to call out to the Rebel Army, but fails because of a Baroque Works infiltrator in the Royal Army interferes. She is nearly trampled by the incoming army, but Karoo manages to protect her. Meanwhile, Sanji finds out that Mr. 2 defeated Usopp and Eyelashes, and is heading toward Vivi. Vivi sees through Mr. 2's deception when he reveals that he doesn't know Karoo's name or care for him, and when he fails to remove the bandage on his arm.

113.title_eng: Two Bad Alubarna Grieves! The Fierce Captain Karoo!
113.title_romanji: Naki no Arubāna! Gekitō Karū taichō
113.title_jap: 嘆きのアルバーナ!激闘カルー隊長!
113.summary: Karoo musters up the strength to carry Vivi up Alubarna's walls and into the city. When Karoo collapses, Mr. 2 is attacked by Sanji and members of the supersonic duck force. Meanwhile, Usopp arrives to help Chopper in his battle with Mr. 4, who hits exploding baseballs from his Dachshund-bazooka hybrid (thanks to the Dog-Dog Fruit: Model: Dachshund), and Miss Merry Christmas, who ate the Mole-Mole Fruit to become a mole-human hybrid.

114.title_eng: Extra Innings Sworn on a Friend's Dream! The Battle of Molehill, Block 4!
114.title_romanji: Nakama no yumi ni chikau! Kettō Mogura tsuka 4 banchō
114.title_jap: 仲間の夢に誓う!決闘モグラ塚4番街
114.summary: Usopp & Chopper struggle against the Mr. 4 team's attacks, with Miss Merry Christmas attacking from underground and Mr. 4 batting explosive balls. Usopp's plan to use a fake "5-ton" hammer against the two fails after it gets destroyed and revealed as fake, but Chopper manages to trick Lasso into firing into the tunnels. When the two are still standing after that attack, Usopp attempts to flee, but Miss Merry Christmas catches him and taunts him by claiming that Luffy is dead.

115.title_eng: Blow Up! Big Opening Day Today! The Copy-Copy Montage!
115.title_jap: 本日大公開!マネマネモンタージュ!
115.summary: Usopp is badly injured by a combination attack by the Mr. 4 team, but with Chopper's help, he tricks Mr. 4 into hitting Miss Merry Christmas, then finishes him off by launching a hammer from a slingshot on Chopper's antlers. Sanji fights with Mr. 2, and while they are evenly matched, Mr. 2 realizes that Sanji cannot attack him if he transforms into Nami, using that to prevent Sanji from fighting back.

116.title_eng: Trading Faces Transformed into Nami! Bon Clay's Rapid-Fire Ballet Kenpo!
116.title_romanji: Nami ni henshin! Bonkurē renpatsu baree Kenpō
116.title_jap: ナミに変身!ボンクレ-連発バレエ拳法
116.summary: Sanji manages to figure out that Mr. 2 must transform into his original form to use his Ballet Kenpo, and finally manages to defeat him. Vivi decides to have Chaka blow up the palace to distract the rebels long enough to reveal the truth, but before she can carry out the plan, Crocodile arrives with the kidnapped Cobra.

117.title_eng: The Weather Forcer Nami's Cyclone Advisory! Clima Takt Burst!
117.title_romanji: Nami no senpū chūihō! Kurimatakuto sakuretsu
117.title_jap: ナミの旋風注意報!クリマタクト炸裂
117.summary: Nami faces off against Miss Doublefinger and tries to figure out her new weapon, the Clima Takt (Climate Baton), at the same time.

118.title_eng: Bad Girls Secret Passed Down in the Royal Family! The Ancient Weapon Pluton!
118.title_romanji: Ōke ni tsuwaru himitsu! Kodai heiki Puruton
118.title_jap: 王家に伝わる秘密!古代兵器プルトン
118.summary: While Crocodile reveals to Vivi that he seeks the ancient weapon Pluton, Nami manages to defeat Miss Doublefinger with Tornado Tempo.

119.title_eng: Zoro vs. Mr. One Secret of Powerful Swordplay! Ability to Cut Steel and the Rhythm Things Have!
119.title_romanji: Gōken no kyokui! Kōtetsu o kiru chikara to mono no kokyū
119.title_jap: 豪剣の極意!鋼鉄を斬る力と物の呼吸
119.summary: Zoro struggles against Mr. 1 as his attacks have no effect on his steel body, but Mr. 1's Dice Dice Fruit enables him to attack by using any part of his body as a steel blade. After Mr. 1 severely wounds Zoro, he becomes able to sense the rhythm that all things have, enabling to cut or not cut at will, and allowing him to defeat Mr. 1 with a single slash.

120.title_eng: Hook, Lie & Sinker The Battle is Over! Koza Raises the White Flag!
120.title_romanji: Tatakai wa owatta! Kōza ga ageta shiroi hata
120.title_jap: 戦いは終わった!コーザが掲げた白い旗
120.summary: When Vivi reveals Crocodile's plan to Koza, he attempts to stop the fighting, but is shot. Crocodile reveals that he has set up a massive bomb in the city.

121.title_eng: His Fatal Flaw Where Vivi's Voice Gets Heard! The Hero Descends!
121.title_romanji: Bibi no koe no yukue! Hīrō wa maiorita!
121.title_jap: ビビの声の行方!英雄は舞い降りた!
121.summary: As Koza tries to stop the Rebel Army, both sides are once more fighting due to the intervention of Baroque Works. Vivi is thrown to her certain death when a fully recovered Luffy saves her and challenges Crocodile to a second round of the final battle, revealing that he has learned that he is weak against water.

122.title_eng: Live & Let Dry Sand Croc and Water Luffy! The Second Round of the Duel!
122.title_romanji: Suna wani to mizu Rufi! Kettō dai ni raundo
122.title_jap: 砂ワニと水ルフィ!決闘第2ラウンド
122.summary: Luffy fights Crocodile with more success this time by using water, but is defeated after Crocodile dries up the ground. Meanwhile, the other Straw Hats hurry to locate the bomb before it goes off. Nico Robin forces the king to take her to the tomb where the Poneglyph with Pluton's location is hidden, defeating Tashigi when she tries to stop her.

123.title_eng: The Crypt Script That Looks Croc-ish! Luffy, Run to the Royal Tomb!
123.title_romanji: Wanippoi! Ōke no haka e hashire Rufi!
123.title_jap: ワニっぽい!王家の墓へ走れルフィ!
123.summary: Crocodile joins Robin in the tomb, and orders her to translate the Poneglyph. Robin tells him that Pluton was not mentioned and that it was only about history, but Crocodile figures out that she was lying and stabs her in response. When Luffy recovers from the last round of fighting, he chases after Crocodile into the tomb.

124.title_eng: The Sweat Threat The Nightmare Draws Near! This is the Sand-Sand Clan's Secret Base!
124.title_romanji: Akumu no toki semaru! Koko wa Sunasunadan himitsu kichi
124.title_jap: 悪夢の時迫る!ここは砂砂団秘密基地
124.summary: Luffy fights with Crocodile by using blood on his fists, but Crocodile reveals that he has a poisonous hook, and plans on finishing Luffy off once and for all. Meanwhile, Vivi finds the bomb and calls the Straw Hats together, but realize that the Mr. 7 team is guarding the bomb.

125.title_eng: The Bomb in the Belfry Magnificent Wings! My Name is Pell, Guardian Deity of the Country!
125.title_romanji: Idai naru tsubame! Wa ga na wa kuno no shigoshin Peru
125.title_jap: 偉大なる翼!我が名は国の守護神ペル
125.summary: Vivi finds the bomb inside of the clock tower, but the Mr. 7 pair of Baroque Works are there to protect it. Vivi defeats them, but she realizes the bomb cannot be stopped so easily. It has a timer, and right before it blows up, Pell shows up and takes it into the atmosphere, where he sacrifices himself to save Alabasta. Meanwhile, the final round of the final battle between Luffy and Crocodile continues, with Luffy struggling due to Crocodile's use of poison.

126.title_eng: Sandbagged I Will Surpass You! Rain Falls in Alabasta!
126.title_romanji: Koete iku! Arabasuta ni ame ga furu!
126.title_jap: 越えていく!アラバスタに雨が降る!
126.summary: Luffy finally defeats Crocodile by punching him through solid bedrock. When Crocodile falls, the rain-drops calm the soldiers.

127.title_eng: All the King's Men A Farewell to Arms! Pirates and Different Ideas of Justice!
127.title_romanji: Buki yo saraba! Kaizoku to ikutsu ka no seigi
127.title_jap: 武器よさらば!海賊といくつかの正義
127.summary: Despite the rain falling, some rebels still wish to fight, but Igaram appears with proof of Cobra's innocence, as well as Koza telling everything. The Straw Hats meet with Vivi's father, and they collapse from their wounds, but Tashigi orders the marines under her command not to capture them. Tashigi and Smoker both are rewarded for taking on Crocodile, but neither one of them believes that is right, considering the Straw Hat pirates did all the work.

128.title_eng: The Turn of the Two Pirates' Banquet and Operation Escape from Alabasta!
128.title_romanji: Kaizokutachi no utage to Arabasuta dasshutsu sakusen!
128.title_jap: 海賊たちの宴とアラバスタ脱出作戦!
128.summary: Luffy is rescued from the collapsed tomb where he fought Crocodile and brought into Cobra's palace to rest. When he awakens, a magnificent banquet is thrown for the pirates, then, the Straw Hats are invited to enjoy the hot spring steam room inside the palace. Igaram receives word that Luffy's bounty has increased to 100 million Berries and Zoro has a 60 million berry bounty. However, the Straw Hats have already left, having been told by Mr. 2 to meet him to pick up their ship and evade the blockade. They tell Vivi that if she wishes to join, she must meet them in twelve hours.

129.title_eng: Pirate Vivi? It All Started On That Day! Vivi Tells the Story of Her Adventure!
129.title_romanji: Hajimaru wa ano hi! Bibi ga kataru bōkendan
129.title_jap: 始まりはあの日!ビビが語る冒険譚
129.summary: Bon Clay and his crew attempt to protect the Straw Hats from Hina, and sacrifice themselves to serve as a diversion. Vivi has Igaram stand in for her at her speech, and tells the Straw Hats that she cannot travel with them, but she hopes she will still be seen as their friend if they meet again. Unable to acknowledge her vocally without her being branded a criminal, the crew shows the marks on their arms as a sign of their friendship.

130.title_eng: Stowaway Scent of Danger! The Seventh Member is Nico Robin!
130.title_romanji: Kiken na kaori! Shichininme wa Niko Robin!
130.title_jap: 危険な香り!七人目はニコ·ロビン!
130.summary: The Marines fail again to catch the Straw Hats. After escaping from the Marines, Nico Robin (Ms. All Sunday) appears from inside of the Straw Hats ship. She manages to persuade the crew to let her join. Pell, who's survive from the bomb's explosion, seen at the end standing over his own grave.

131.title_eng: The First Patient! The Untold Story of the Rumble Ball!
131.title_romanji: Hajimete no Kanja! Ranburu Bōru Hiwa
131.title_jap: はじめての患者! ランブルボール秘話
131.summary: The Straw Hats land on an uninhabited island; Sanji immediately notices that it is covered with fruit-bearing trees. The crew decides to divide the work by drawing straws. Luffy, Zoro, and Usopp are sent to gather the fruit while Nami and Sanji survey the island. Chopper is left to guard the ship. He enjoys himself but suddenly realizes that Robin is nearby and flees into the cabin. He works on producing Rumble Balls and talks to himself about his mentor, Dr. Kureha, but notices that Robin is listening to him and breaks a barrel of water in surprise. Robin accompanies Chopper as he goes to replace the spilled liquid and he tells Robin about Dr. Kureha and how she became his first patient.

132.title_eng: Uprising of the Navigator! For the Unyielding Dream!
132.title_romanji: Kōkaishi no Hanran! Yuzure Nai Yume no Tame ni!
132.title_jap: 航海士の反乱! ゆずれない夢の為に!
132.summary: While fishing with Chopper and Usopp, Luffy fishes an ammonite-shaped vehicle out of the sea. The pirates debate if it is edible, but to their surprise, its side opens and a traveling salesman emerges. He offers them obscure items and tries to sell a pile of paper to Nami. However, before he can settle the deal, the salesman realizes that he is on a pirate ship and flees in panic, abandoning his merchandise. With the paper, Nami can finally begin drawing the map of the world that she has dreamed about making since her childhood. However, because the rest of the crew is causing mischief, she has trouble completing her work and has to restart twice before finishing her map of Reverse Mountain.

133.title_eng: A Recipe Handed Down! Sanji, the Iron Man of Curry!
133.title_romanji: Uketsugareru Yume! Karē no Tetsujin Sanji
133.title_jap: 受け継がれる夢! カレーの鉄人サンジ
133.summary: In a thick bank of fog, the Straw Hats run into a fleet of navy ships. Surprised by the sight of the skull and crossbones on the pirate ship's sails, the young trainee cook Tajiyo falls off of his navy vessel. Robin catches him before he hits the water and the boy regains consciousness in the Straw Hats' cabin. Scared at first, he loosens up when presented by Sanji with a soup of surprising quality. The small cook reveals his problem: he spilled the day's production of curry and has been charged with replacing it. To compound the issue, the fleet's captains plan to dine aboard his ship. Luffy and Sanji take Tajiyo back to his ship, where Sanji provides him with subtle cooking advice. Tajiyo's new curry turns out perfectly and the Straw Hats escape before the fog lifts in the mid-day sun.

134.title_eng: I Will Make it Bloom! Usopp, the Man, and the Eight-Foot Shell!
134.title_romanji: Sakasete Misemasu! Otoko Usoppu Hachi Shaku Tama
134.title_jap: 咲かせてみせます! 男ウソップ八尺玉
134.summary: Because it is raining, Luffy reads out of boredom. Fortunately for him, the Straw Hats' ship reaches the next island. Walking through its port town, they learn that the island known for its yearly fireworks show, which was to occur that day. The fireworks factory, run by an old man named Odama and his granddaughter Kodama, is on a hill outside the town. Usopp goes there, hoping for an opportunity to buy gunpowder. At the factory, he helps Odama and Kodama prepare for the show. Usopp learns that Kodama plans to secretly fire the second of two eight-shaku-tall firework balls to fulfill her parents' dream. Her parents died the previous year after the first misfired, and Usopp convinces Kodama that it is too dangerous for her to fire it. Usopp uses a tall, ancient building to safely launch the large firework ball.

135.title_eng: Legend of the Pirate Hunter! The Fabled Pirate Hunter! Zoro, the Wandering Swordsman!
135.title_romanji: Uwasa no Kaizoku Gari! Sasurai no Kenshi Zoro
135.title_jap: 噂の海賊狩り! さすらいの剣士ゾロ
135.summary: Before he meets Luffy, Zoro traveled the world in search of "Hawk-Eye" Mihawk. In a flashback, Zoro captures the target of the bounty hunters Johnny and Yosaku in a bar. According to bounty hunter rules, they demand that he relinquish the victim's body to them. Zoro, who does not consider himself a bounty hunter, complies, explaining that he only brings in a bounty from time to time so that he can survive until he can become the greatest swordsman in the world. Later that day, a group of bandits, led by a man with a much higher bounty, plunders the village. Johnny and Yosaku, inspired by Zoro's conviction, decide to take on the villain, but are quickly defeated. As the bandits prepare to kill the pair, Zoro returns and saves Johnny and Yosaku. After he defeats the bandits and their leader, Johnny and Yosaku become his followers.

136.title_eng: Zenny of the Island of Goats and the Pirate Ship in the Mountains!
136.title_romanji: Yagi no Shima no Zenii to Yama no Naka no Kaizoku Sen!
136.title_jap: ヤギの島のゼニィと山の中の海賊船!
136.summary: A few navy ships chase the Straw Hats. To escape them, the Straw Hats sail through an area of wild currents, which surround an island that is only inhabited by an old man named Zenny and his goats. Zenny realizes that the Straw Hats are pirates and sends his goats to attack them. During the fight Zenny's heart stops from fear. The Straw Hats take him to his home, nurse him back to health, and complete his chores, such as cleaning his house, preparing meals, and chopping wood. Zoro searches for food and discovers a small nearly completed pirate ship atop the island's mountain. At the day's end, as the crew is about to leave, Chopper reveals that the old man will die within three days. Driven by guilt, the Straw Hats decide to stay with him until then.

137.title_eng: How's Tricks? The Designs of Zenny the Moneylender!
137.title_jap: 儲かりまっか? 金貸しゼニィの野望!
137.summary: The Straw Hats continue to do Zenny's daily work and finish building his pirate ship, which he intends to use as a coffin. Zoro eventually realizes that the three days until Zenny's death, which Chopper had diagnosed, have long passed, but by the time he convinces the others to leave, Nami has already lost the Straw Hats' ship in a game of chess. Robin wins it back and they all have a party. As Zenny becomes drunk, he recollects his past as a moneylender who lent money to pirates. He describes how he was shipwrecked twenty years earlier, and that he, in hopes of one day becoming a pirate, started building a ship. As the years passed, he became too old for a pirate's life. Luffy disagrees, saying that pirates can be of any age. The next day, a group of marines lures the Straw Hats into a trap. To save them, Zenny and his goats ride his ship down the mountainside.

138.title_eng: Whereabouts of the Island Treasure! Attack of the Zenny Pirates!
138.title_romanji: Shima no Otakara no Yukue! Zenii Kaizoku Dan Shutsugeki!
138.title_jap: 島のお宝の行方! ゼニィ海賊団出撃!
138.summary: The commotion caused by Zenny's arrival allows Nami, Sanji, Usopp, and Chopper to board their ship safely. Zenny and his goats get on the navy ship and Zenny uses of his martial arts skills, with a counting frame to fight. Luffy attempts to slingshot himself over to help him, but lands in the water instead. Zoro immediately jumps in after him to rescue the non-swimmer, only to be run over by the Straw Hats' own ship. The marines are eventually defeated, but a fleet of nine more ships is still waiting in the fog surrounding the island. Zenny tells the Straw Hats that, on his arrival on the island, the goats ate all of his money and that they became his treasure instead. The Straw Hats give Zenny enough medicine to survive and leave the island, escaping from the navy.

139.title_eng: The Rainbow Mist Legend of the Rainbow Mist! Old Man Henzo of Luluka Island!
139.title_romanji: Nijiiro no Kiri Densetsu! Rurukajima no Rōjin Henzo
139.title_jap: 虹色の霧伝説! ルルカ島の老人ヘンゾ
139.summary: After escaping from another fleet of navy ships, the Straw Hats drop anchor outside a town with a huge tower. After they set foot on land, an official demands that they pay a harbor tax. The Straw Hats meet a scientist named Henzo, who asks them if they have seen what he calls the "Rainbow Mist." The other citizens of the town dislike Henzo because they have to pay high taxes to fund for his research. While shopping with Nami and Chopper, Sanji has a violent encounter with a tax collector, who is wearing an electric battle suit. A large, unmanned galley appears in the harbor, in the same condition that Henzo saw it fifty years ago. Henzo, Luffy, Robin, and Usopp board it. Further out at sea, a rainbow-colored mist appears and the group uses the Straw Hats' ship to enter it.

140.title_eng: Wreckers Reef Residents of the Land of Eternity! The Pumpkin Pirates!
140.title_romanji: Eien no Kuni no Jūnin! Panpukin Kaizoku Dan!
140.title_jap: 永遠の国の住人! パンプキン海賊団!
140.summary: Inside the mist, Luffy and his group discover a large ship graveyard. Luffy salvages a chest filled with gold and jewels from one of the shipwrecks, but a distant voice tells him to return the treasure and leave the mist. Usopp believes the voices to be ghosts, but they actually originate from a group of children who call themselves the Pumpkin Pirates. In his youth, Henzo was a member of this group, and they are the reason for his research. He spent his life in search of a means to rescue them from the Rainbow Mist. Only a short time earlier from their point of view, but fifty years earlier from Henzo's perspective, a group of pirates, led by a Captain Whetton, attacked the children's town. When Whetton came after the children, they tried to escape by stealing the pirates' ship. During the fight, Whetton smashed the ship's helm, and Henzo jumped overboard, taking Whetton with him, while the other children sailed into the mist.

141.title_eng: No Way Out Thoughts of Home! The Pirate Graveyard of No Escape!
141.title_romanji: Kokyū e no Omoi! Dasshutsu Funō no Kaizoku Hakaba!
141.title_jap: 故郷への想い! 脱出不能の海賊墓場!
141.summary: After entering the Rainbow Mist, the children followed the orders of Ian, the only pirate left on the ship. He mistreated them and they eventually locked him up in the brig of the wreck of a navy ship. Luffy and his group try to escape the mist, but they soon realize that they need help. The Straw Hats persuade one of the children to lead them to the Pumpkin Pirates' hiding place so they can ask them for a way out. Usopp prepares a steaming meal, which causes most of the children to like the Straw Hats; however, their leader, Lapanui, remains suspicious and unwilling to help. Henzo's transponder snail rings and the son of Whetton wants Henzo to investigate the mist, not knowing that the professor is already inside the mist. When Lapanui hears Whetton's name, he loses what little trust he has for Henzo.

142.title_eng: Into The Mist An Inevitable Melee! Wetton's Schemes and the Rainbow Tower!
142.title_romanji: Ransen Hissu! Uetton no Yabō to Niji no Tō
142.title_jap: 乱戦必死! ウエットンの野望と虹の塔
142.summary: Lapanui accuses Henzo of being Whetton's lapdog and says that in the past, Henzo would have never allowed that to happen. Usopp tells Lapanui that Henzo had endured the same insults from the townspeople yet still tried to rescue the children. Then, for no apparent reason, Luffy slingshots himself and Lapanui to another part of the mist. At the harbor, Nami ties a long lifeline, prepared by Henzo, to a boat and enters the Rainbow Mist. Once inside, Ian, who convinced one of the children to release him, steals the boat and escapes. He reaches Whetton and describes to him the mist's treasures. Whetton orders his men to invade the mist. The town's large tower falls into the water, creating a bridge from the island into the mist, and Whetton and his men cross it to attack.

143.title_eng: The Great Escape! And so, the Legend Begins! To the Other Side of the Rainbow!
143.title_romanji: Soshite Densetsu ga Hajimaru! Iza Niji no Kanata e
143.title_jap: そして伝説が始まる! いざ虹の彼方へ
143.summary: Luffy and Lapanui are outside the mist and use the newly created bridge to reenter it. There, Luffy fights Whetton and, as it becomes clear that he cannot defeat Luffy face-to-face, Whetton detonates the tower, trapping everyone else inside and Whetton's abandoned men join forces with Luffy's group. An exit appears in the distance and they row toward it, but it closes too fast for them to reach it. Hoping to generate enough wind to blow the Straw Hats' ship clear of the mist, Lapanui stays behind to destroy the navy ship's armory. The other children follow him, promising to meet Henzo again. The explosion they cause successfully blows the Straw Hats' ship outside the mist. There, a group of navy ships, led by an aged Lapanui, arrives and confiscates the Rainbow Mist's treasures from Whetton and takes him and his men into custody.

144.title_eng: Caught Log! The King of Salvagers, Masira!
144.title_jap: 奪われた記録!サルベージ王マシラ!
144.summary: Nami's log pose begins to point to the sky, after that, a big ship falls from sky and the crew finds a map in of an island named 'Skypiea' on a 200-year-old ship. They compete with the monkey-like Masira's salvage crew while they search for more clues on how to get there. The episode ends with Masira, Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji being eaten by a giant turtle.

145.title_eng: Monsters Appear! Don't Mess with the Whitebeard Pirates!
145.title_romanji: Kaibutsu tōjō! Shirohige Ichimi ni wa te o dasu na
145.title_jap: 怪物登場!白ひげ一味には手を出すな
145.summary: The Straw Hats decide to go to Jaya island to look for information on Skypeia. Meanwhile, Ace suddenly shows up on Buggy's ship; Buggy doesn't let any of his men attack Ace, fearing Whitebeard's retribution.

146.title_eng: Quit Dreaming! Mock Town, the Town of Ridicule!
146.title_romanji: Yume o miru na! Azakeri no machi Mokku Taun!
146.title_jap: 夢を見るな!嘲りの街モックタウン!
146.summary: Jaya's main town is full of famous pirates that are constantly brawling with each other. Luffy and Zoro have a run-in with a pirate known as 'Bellamy the Hyena,' who ridicules their dreams and beats them up.

147.title_eng: Distinguished Pirates! A Man Who Talks of Dreams and the King of Undersea Search!
147.title_romanji: Kaizoku no takami! Yume o kataru otoko to kaitei shinsaku ō
147.title_jap: 海賊の高み!夢を語る男と海底探索王
147.summary: Luffy, Zoro, and Nami meet the man who is later revealed to be Blackbeard. They leave Mock Town, and get into a fight with Masira's brother Shōjo, another salvage monkey.

148.title_jap: 伝説の一族!「うそつきノーランド」
148.summary: The Straw Hats meet with Montblanc Cricket on another part of Jaya; Cricket is a descendant of Montblanc Noland, an infamous "liar" who told of a gold city on Jaya, and Cricket was outcast for looking for artifacts of the gold city. He may be the only person who knows how to get to Skypiea.

149.title_eng: Steer for the Clouds! Capture the South Bird!
149.title_romanji: Kumo kaji ippai! Sausubādo o oe!
149.title_jap: 雲舵いっぱい!サウスバードを追え!
149.summary: Cricket explains how the Straw Hats can ride a dangerous vertical current called the Knock-Up Stream to get to Skypiea. However, they first have to catch a southbird to point them toward the point where the stream will erupt from the ocean.

150.title_eng: Dreams Don't Come True?! Bellamy Versus the Saruyama Alliance!
150.title_romanji: Yume wa kanawanai!? Beramī VS saruyama rengō
150.title_jap: 幻想は叶わない!?ベラミーVS猿山連合
150.summary: While the Straw Hats are looking for a Southbird, Bellamy and his crew attack Cricket's house, and steal the gold artifacts he'd collected over the years from his salvage work. When the Straw Hats return and see what happened, Luffy decides to take a side trip back to Mock Town.

151.title_eng: 100 Million Man! World's Greatest Power and Pirate Black Beard!
151.title_romanji: Ichioku no otoko! Sekai saikō kenryoku to kaizoku kurohige
151.title_jap: 一億の男!世界最高権力と海賊黒ひげ
151.summary: Luffy takes out Bellamy with a single punch. Meanwhile, the world government heads are concerned over Whitebeard, Shanks, and Luffy. The marines try to decide who will replace Crocodile as a Warlord – one of Blackbeard's crew shows up uninvited and nominates his captain.

152.title_eng: Take to the Sky! Ride the Knockup Stream!
152.title_romanji: Fune wa sora o yuku! Tsukiageru kairyū ni nore
152.title_jap: 船は空をゆく!突き上げる海流に乗れ
152.summary: The Going Merry is refitted by Masira and Shōjo to be more flight capable, and the Straw Hats catch a ride on the Knock-Up Stream for Skypeia.

153.title_eng: Sail the White Sea! The Sky Knight and the Gate in the Clouds!
153.title_romanji: Koko wa sora no umi! Sora no kishi to tengoku no mon
153.title_jap: ここは空の海!空の騎士と天国の門
153.summary: The Straw Hats arrive in an ocean above the clouds. Usopp almost falls out of the sky island but is saved at the last minute. The crew is also attacked by a mysterious looking warrior, but is saved by the Knight of the Sky. Finally, they arrive at the border which transports them to the upper realm, Skypiea.

154.title_eng: Godland, Skypiea! Angels on a Beach of Clouds!
154.title_romanji: Kami no kuni Sukaipia! Kumo no nagisa no tenshitachi
154.title_jap: 神の国スカイピア!雲の渚の天使たち
154.summary: As the crew arrives in Skypiea, they're greeted by Conis and her pet Suu. Both she and her father start explaining how the life in Skypiea is and how the different Dials work.

155.title_eng: The Forbidden Sacred Ground! The Island Where God Lives and Heaven's Judgement!
155.title_romanji: Kindan no seichi! Kami no sumi shima to ten no sabaki!
155.title_jap: 禁断の聖地!神の住む島と天の裁き!
155.summary: Nami finds out what should happen to anyone who enters the forest. Meanwhile, the rest of the gang are waiting for the wind to change but are rudely assaulted by Skypiea's police who are going to carry out Heaven's Judgement.

156.title_eng: Already Criminals?! Skypiea's Upholder of the Law!
156.title_romanji: Hayaku mo hanzaisha!? Sukaipia no hō no banjin
156.title_jap: 早くも犯罪者!?スカイピアの法の番人
156.summary: The Straw Hats have some problems with the local justice enforcer force called "The White Berets."

157.title_eng: Is Escape Possible?!? God's Challenge is Set in Motion
157.title_romanji: Dasshutsu naru ka!? Ugokihajimeta kami no shiren!
157.title_jap: 脱出なるか!?動きはじめた神の試練!
157.summary: Before they can leave Chopper, Robin, Nami and Zoro are abducted by a giant shrimp. Luffy, Sanji and Usopp go after them to the upper yard.

158.title_eng: A Trap on Lovely Street! The Almighty Eneru
158.title_romanji: Raburī dōri no wana! Zennō naru Goddo Eneru
158.title_jap: ラブリー通りの罠!全能なる神エネル
158.summary: Nami and Robin are captured by a giant shrimp, leading to a rescue mission by Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp. This moment highlights their teamwork and importance in the Sky Island Arc.[40]

159.title_eng: Onward Crow! To the Sacrificial Altar!
159.title_romanji: Susume Karasumaru! Ikenie no saidan o mezase
159.title_jap: すすめカラス丸!生贄の祭壇を目指せ
159.summary: Luffy, Usopp and Sanji finally enter Upper Yard, only to find out that the whole road is trapped heavily, but at last they arrive at the Ordeal Gates. Meanwhile Robin, Zoro, and Nami go out to explore Upper Yard while Chopper stays behind to guard the ship.

160.title_eng: 10% Survival Rate! Satori, the Mantra Master!
160.title_romanji: Seizonritsu 10%! Mantora tsukai no shinkan Satori
160.title_jap: 生存率10%!心綱使いの神官サトリ!
160.summary: Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp enter the Ordeal of Balls gate and encounter the Priest Satori.

161.title_eng: The Ordeal of Spheres! Desperate Struggle in the Lost Forest!
161.title_romanji: 'Tama no shiren' no kyōi! Mayoi no mori no shitō
161.title_jap: 「玉の試練」の脅威!迷いの森の死闘
161.summary: Usopp, Sanji, and Luffy fight Satori, but the power of Mantra seems to be too strong.

162.title_eng: Chopper in Danger! Former God vs. Priest Shura!
162.title_romanji: Choppā ayaushi! Moto kami VS Shinkan Shura
162.title_jap: チョッパー危うし!元神VS神官シュラ
162.summary: Chopper, threatened by priest Shura, blows the whistle for Gan Fall to come, but before he can arrive, Priest Shura assaults Chopper and begins destroying the Going Merry.

163.title_eng: Profound Mystery! Ordeal of String and Ordeal of Love?!?
163.title_romanji: Makafushigi! Himo no shiren to koi no shiren!?
163.title_jap: 摩訶不思議!紐の試練と恋の試練!?
163.summary: Satori is defeated by Luffy and Sanji. Meanwhile Gan Fall has been defeated and Chopper jumps in the water to rescue him.

164.title_eng: Light the Fire of Shandora! Wyper the Warrior!
164.title_romanji: Shandora no tō o nobose! Senshi Waipā
164.title_jap: シャンドラの灯を燈せ!戦士ワイパー
164.summary: Chopper is saved by a bunch of giant Southbirds, who tell him that Gan Fall was actually God. Nami, Zoro and Robin discover the reason why Upper Yard is a soil island: It was once part of Jaya, and this is the part that Liar Norland saw. Meanwhile the Shandians attack Upper Yard.

165.title_eng: Jaya, City of Gold in the Sky! Head for God's Shrine!
165.title_romanji: Tenkū no ōgonkyō Jaya! Mezase kami no yashiro
165.title_jap: 天空の黄金卿ジャヤ!目指せ神の社!
165.summary: The Shandians' attack on Upper Yard has started. The crew is finally reunited, and everyone speaks up about what has happened. Chopper takes care of Gan Fall, and the pirates plan to steal the gold on the island.

166.title_eng: Festival on the Night Before Gold-Hunting! Feelings for Vearth!
166.title_romanji: ōgon zenya matsuri! Vāsu e no omoi!
166.title_jap: 黄金前夜祭!「ヴァース」への想い!
166.summary: After befriending a wolf pack, Gan Fall tells the crew a little more about the history of Upper Yard.

167.title_eng: Enter God Eneru! Farewell to the Survivors!
167.title_romanji: Goddo Eneru tōjō!! Ikinokori e no ōpādo
167.title_jap: 神·エネル登場!!生き残りへの夜明曲
167.summary:
Eneru takes away the limitations of the priests. Also, Usopp witnesses a mysterious person fixing the ship; the next day Merry is found to be back to her original form. After getting her off the altar, the pirates plan out their course of action.


Note: This was the last episode to air on Toonami during its original run. The show returned to Toonami on May 18, 2013, continuing from episode 207.

168.title_eng: A Giant Snake Bares Its Fangs! The Survival Game Begins!
168.title_romanji: Kiba muku ōhebi! Tsui ni hajimaru sabaibaru gēmu
168.title_jap: 牙むく大蛇!遂に始まる生き残り合戦
168.summary: A giant python makes Luffy, Robin, Chopper and Zoro split while going to the ruins at the south.

169.title_eng: The Deadly Reject! War Demon Wyper's Resolve!
169.title_romanji: Sutemi no haigeki! Senki Waipā no kakugo
169.title_jap: 捨身の排撃!!「戦鬼」ワイパーの覚悟
169.summary: Wyper takes out Shura and tells his goal to the Shandians, and Eneru speaks up about how many people will be alive by the end of his plan.

170.title_eng: Fierce Mid-Air Battle! Pirate Zoro vs. Warrior Braham!
170.title_romanji: Kūchū no gekisen! Kaizoku Zoro VS Senshi Burahamu
170.title_jap: 空中の激戦!海賊ゾロVS戦士ブラハム
170.summary: Zoro fights the Shandian warrior Braham, and defeats him with One Sword Style: 36 Caliber Phoenix technique. ("36-Pound Cannon" In Japanese)

171.title_eng: The Roaring Burn Bazooka!! Pirate Luffy vs. War Demon Wyper!
171.title_romanji: Unaru nenshōhō!! Rufi vs senki Waipā
171.title_jap: 唸る燃焼砲!!ルフィVS戦鬼ワイパー闘
171.summary: Luffy fights Wyper, but after some time, he falls into some underground ruins. Meanwhile, Eneru appears on the Going Merry and after telling that his true goal was the City of Gold, he takes out both Usopp and Sanji; He then vanishes and leaves Satori's brothers, Hotori and Kotori, to avenge their brother.

172.title_eng: The Ordeal of Swamp! Chopper vs Sky Punk Gedatsu!
172.title_romanji: Numa no shiren! Choppā VS Shinkan Gedatsu!!
172.title_jap: 沼の試練!チョッパーVS神官ゲダツ!!
172.summary: Chopper is attacked by Gedatsu, who turns out to be a complete moron, and eventually defeats him, sending him plummeting to the Blue Sea. Conis and Pagaya help Aisa, and head to Upper Yard.

173.title_eng: Unbeatable Powers! Eneru's True Form is Revealed!
173.title_romanji: Muteki no nōryoku! Akasareru Eneru no shōtai
173.title_jap: 無敵の能力!明かされるエネルの正体
173.summary: Eneru defeats several members of the Shandian Tribe. Meanwhile, Gan Fall and Nami start and finish their fight with Kotori and Hotori. Hotori is defeated by Nami while Kotori is defeated by Gan Fall. It is also revealed that Eneru is made of lightning.

174.title_eng: A Mystical City! The Grand Ruins of Shandora!
174.title_romanji: Maboroshi no to! Yūdai naru Shandora no iseki!!
174.title_jap: 幻の都!雄大なるシャンドラの遺跡!!
174.summary: While Robin is looking at some ruins she found, Yama, The Chief Enforcer, attacks her. Yama is easily defeated by Robin. Later, she discovers the legendary city, Shandora.

175.title_eng: 0% Survival Rate! Chopper vs. Ohm, the Sword Wielding Priest!
175.title_jap: 生存率0%!!チョッパーVS神官オーム
175.summary: Priest Ohm appears and starts fighting everyone.

176.title_eng: Climb Giant Jack! Deadly Combat in the Upper Ruins!
176.title_romanji: Kyodai mame tsuru o nobore!! Jōsō iseki no shitō
176.title_jap: 巨大豆蔓を登れ!!上層遺跡の死闘
176.summary: At the Upper Ruins, the fight between Ohm, Zoro, Gan Fall and Wyper begins. When Nami appears, she is swallowed by the giant python, along with Gan Fall and Aisa.

177.title_eng: The Ordeal of Iron! White Barbed Death Match!
177.title_romanji: Tetsu no shiren no shinkocchō! Shiroibara Desumacchi!!
177.title_jap: 鉄の試練の真骨頂!白荊デスマッチ!!
177.summary: Ohm makes matters worse, creating a barbed wire cage around the area. Raki is knocked out by Eneru, and Nami, Aisa, and Gan Fall find out why the python was rampaging so much.

178.title_romanji: Hotobashiru Zangeki! Zoro VS shinkan Ōmu!!
178.title_jap: ほとばしる斬撃!ゾロVS神官オーム!!
178.summary: Zoro finally defeats Priest Ohm with his 108 Caliber Phoenix technique. Meanwhile Pagaya and Conis hear the terrible truth about the goal of Eneru: to eradicate every person in the sky.

179.title_eng: Collapsing Upper Ruins! The Quintet for the Finale!
179.title_romanji: Kuzure yuku jōsō iseki! Fināre e no kuintetto
179.title_jap: 崩れゆく上層遺跡!終曲への五重奏!!
179.summary: Eneru appears only to reduce the group as close to his prediction as he can.To do that, Eneru destroys the Upper Ruins with one of his attacks, causing everyone to fall onto Shandorians ancestors city.

180.title_eng: Showdown in the Ancient Ruins! Sky God Eneru's Goal!
180.title_romanji: Kodai iseki no taiketsu! Goddo Eneru no mokuteki
180.title_jap: 古代遺跡の対決!神·エネルの目的
180.summary: Eneru counterattacks Gan Fall and lands a finishing hit. He then knocks out Robin as she tries to manipulate him. Zoro impresses Eneru with his power but is easily beaten, while trying to make him pay for what he did to Robin; but it takes Wyper with a secret weapon to take Eneru down.

181.title_eng: Ambition Towards the Endless Vearth! The Ark Maxim!
181.title_romanji: Kagirinai daichi e no yabō hakobune Makushimu
181.title_jap: 限りない大地への野望方舟マクシム!!
181.summary: Eneru defeats Zoro and Wyper. Upon seeing this, Nami follows him to a cave where his ark, Maxim, is. Luffy finally gets out of the snake, along with Aisa, only to find out the outcome of the fight against Eneru. When Aisa tells him that she knows where he is, he asks her to take him there.

182.title_eng: They Finally Clash! Pirate Luffy vs God Eneru!
182.title_romanji: Tsui ni gekitotsu! Kaizoku Rufi VS Goddo Eneru!!
182.title_jap: 遂に激突!海賊ルフィVS神·エネル!!
182.summary: Luffy and Eneru start fighting. Conis tells the dangers of staying in Sky Island to the other Skypieans.

183.title_jap: マクシム浮上!動き始めたデスピア!!
183.summary: Eneru starts a machine that would bring the death of Sky Island: Deathpiea.

184.title_eng: Luffy Falls! Eneru's Judgement and Nami's Wish!
184.title_romanji: Rufi rakuka! Kami no sabaki to Nami no nozomi!!
184.title_jap: ルフィ落下!神の裁きとナミの望み!!
184.summary: Luffy falls from the ark. Nami starts fighting Eneru while Sanji and Usopp try to rescue her.

185.title_eng: The Two Awaken! On the Front Lines of the Burning Love Rescue!
185.title_romanji: Mesameta futari! Moeru koi no kyūshutsu zensen!!
185.title_jap: 目覚めた二人!燃える恋の救出前線!!
185.summary: Usopp and Sanji split up to rescue Nami, but the first one to get on deck is Usopp.

186.title_eng: Capriccio for Despair! The Impending Doom of Sky Island!
186.title_romanji: Zetsubō e no kyōsōkyoku hakari kuru sorajima no shōmetsu!!
186.title_jap: 絶望への狂想曲迫り来る空島の消滅!!
186.summary: Eneru's thunderclouds are coming down to Sky Island while the evacuation is half complete.

187.title_eng: Led by a Bell's Sound! Tale of the Great Warrior and the Explorer!
187.title_romanji: Kane no oto no michibiki! Daisenshi to shinkenka no monogatari
187.title_jap: 鐘の音の導き!大戦士と探検家の物語
187.summary: The history of Noland and Calgara is told, as a flashback from Wyper.

188.title_eng: Free From the Spell! The Great Warrior Sheds Tears!
188.title_romanji: Jubaku kara no kaihō! Daisenshi ga nagashita namida!!
188.title_jap: 呪縛からの解放!大戦士が流した涙!!
188.summary: Noland and Calgara are enjoying themselves, as well as the villagers and Noland's crew, but that changes one day, as the villagers start hating their new friends.

189.title_eng: Eternal Friends! The Vowed Bell Echoes Across the Mighty Seas!
189.title_romanji: Eien no shinyū! Daikaigen ni hibiku chikai no kane
189.title_jap: 永遠の親友!大海原に響く誓いの鐘
189.summary: The cause of the hatred is discovered and explained. Meanwhile, Calgara vows to meet Noland again.

190.title_eng: Angel Island, Obliterated! The Horror of The Raigo's Advent!!
190.title_romanji: Enjerushima shōmetsu! Raigō kōrin no kyōfu!
190.title_jap: エンジェル島消滅!雷迎降臨の恐怖!!
190.summary: Angel Island is destroyed by Eneru's attacks. Luffy decides to go and ring the golden bell before Eneru takes it away.

191.title_eng: Knock Over Giant Jack! Last Hope for Escape!
191.title_romanji: Kyodai mame tsuru o taose! Dasshutsu e no saigō no nozomi
191.title_jap: 巨大豆蔓を倒せ!脱出への最後の望み
191.summary: Nami finds out a way to get to Eneru and sends a message to the others for them to cut down Giant Jack. Zoro cuts down half of the stalk, but Eneru fires a bolt straight at Zoro, rendering him unconscious. As the others look on hopelessly, Wyper lets his pride get the better of him, saying that the descendants of Calgara should ring the bell. Usopp tries to help in a knowingly futile attempt by using his Exploding Star techniques. Robin tells Wyper that Cricket, Noland's descendant, is searching for the Gold City and Luffy wants to ring the bell for him. Reinvigorated, Wyper goes to Giant Jack and uses one final Reject, knocking down the rest of the stalk in the process. Nami and Luffy then charge up Giant Jack to face Eneru.

192.title_eng: Miracle on Skypiea! The Love Song Heard in the Clouds!
192.title_romanji: Kami no kuni no kiseki! Tenshi ni todoita rabusongu
192.title_jap: 神の国の奇跡!天使に届いた島の歌声
192.summary: Luffy defeats Eneru by smashing him into the Golden Bell, ringing it in the process.

193.title_eng: The Battle Ends! Proud Fantasia Echoes Far!
193.title_romanji: Tatakai no shūen! Tōku hibiku hokori takaki gensōkyoku
193.title_jap: 戦いの終焉!遠く響く誇り高き幻想曲
193.summary: Luffy has won and the 400 year war on Sky Island is finally over. Montblanc Cricket and the Masira Brothers hear the Golden Bell ringing and realize that the Gold City was always in the sky. Eneru, who was thrown to the Blue Sea heads out to the Fairy Vearth (the Moon). The Sky People (both Skypieans and Shandorians) celebrate the end of the war with a great bonfire.

194.title_eng: I Made it Here! The Yarn the Poneglyphs Spin!
194.title_romanji: Ware koko ni itaru! Rekishi no honbun ga tsumugu mono
194.title_jap: 我ここに至る!歴史の本文が紡ぐもの
194.summary: Robin deciphers the poneglyphs on the Golden Bell and realizes how to find the Rio Poneglyph. She also discovers that the poneglyphs on the Bell were written by Gol D. Roger, who could understand poneglyphs, who had discovered the Rio Poneglyph, and had once visited Skypiea. Soon afterwards, the Straw Hats steal a bunch of gold from the Giant Anaconda's belly and they begin to leave Skypiea.

195.title_eng: Off to the Blue Sea!! A Heartfelt Finale!
195.title_romanji: Iza seikai e!! Omoi ga shibarinasu saishū gakushō
195.title_jap: いざ青海へ!!想いが織りなす最終楽章
195.summary: The Golden Bell rings as the Straw Hats are going down to the sea, meaning that they are welcome and are deeply thankful for what they did. When the ship finally rests on the sea, problems appear, as the ship has landed in a Marine base.

196.title_eng: A State of Emergency is Issued! A Notorious Pirate Ship has Infiltrated!
196.title_romanji: Hijō Jitai Hatsumei! Akumei Takaki Kaizokusen Sennyū
196.title_jap: 非常事態発令!悪名高き海賊船潜入!
196.summary: The Marines are convinced the Going Merry is a ghost ship after it crashes inside their fortress from above. The crew members are scattered around the premises.

197.title_eng: Sanji the Cook! Proving His Merit at the Marine Dining Hall!
197.title_romanji: Ryōrinin Sanji! Kaigun Shokudō de Shinka Hakki!
197.title_jap: 料理人サンジ!海軍食堂で真価発揮!
197.summary: In disguise, Sanji shows the Marine chefs the proper way to prepare a meal.

198.title_romanji: Towareta Zoro to Choppā Kinkyū Shittō
198.title_jap: 囚われたゾロとチョッパー緊急執刀!
198.summary: Zoro is taken prisoner as Chopper and Nami assist a nervous doctor in treating injured Marines.

199.title_eng: The Marines Dragnet Closes In! The Second Member Captured!
199.title_romanji: Hakaru Kaigun no Sōsamō! Towareta Futarime!
199.title_jap: 迫る海軍の捜査網!囚われた二人目!
199.summary: Robin and Usopp both disguise themselves as the same visiting inspector, and Usopp is thrown in the brig with Zoro. Luffy and Sanji are discovered by Jonathan after a slight mishap.

200.title_eng: Luffy and Sanji's Daring Rescue Mission!
200.title_romanji: Kesshi no Rufi to Sanji! Kūshutsu Daisakusen!
200.title_jap: 決死のルフィとサンジ!救出大作戦!
200.summary: The real Inspector is thrown in the brig with Zoro and Usopp, while Sanji and Luffy race to rescue the two while avoiding detection.

201.title_eng: Enter the Hot-Blooded Special Forces! Battle on the Bridge!
201.title_romanji: Netsuketsu Tokubetsu Butai Sansen! Burijji Kōbōsen!
201.title_jap: 熱血特別部隊参戦!ブリッジ攻防戦!
201.summary: Sanji and Luffy, after freeing Usopp and Zoro, try to escape Navarone. As the Burning Soul combat unit is deployed, Dr. Kobato leads Nami and Chopper to the docks.

202.title_eng: Breaking Through the Siege! The Going Merry is Recovered!
202.title_jap: 包囲網突破!奪還ゴーイングメリー号
202.summary: The crew meets at the docks and are surrounded by Marines. Using Nami as their fake hostage, they trick the Marines into letting them back on the Going Merry.

203.title_eng: The Pirate Ship Disappears! Fortress Battle, Round #2!
203.title_romanji: Kieta Kaizokusen! Yōsai Kōbō Dai 2 Raundo
203.title_jap: 消えた海賊船!要塞攻防第2ラウンド
203.summary: The crew disguises the Going Merry as a Marine ship so they can get their treasure back. With the gold, they decide they’ll hire a shipwright.

204.title_eng: The Gold and Waver Recovery Operations!
204.title_romanji: Ōgon Dakkan Sakusen to Ueibā Kaishū Sakusen!
204.title_jap: 黄金奪還作戦とウエイバー回収作戦!
204.summary: Usopp splits up the crew into two teams: the gold retrieval team and the waver retrieval team. Inspector Shepherd decides to catch Luffy on his own.

205.title_eng: The One Fell Swoop Plan! Jonathan's Surefire Secret Tactic!
205.title_romanji: Ichimōdajin Keikaku! Jonasan Jishin no Hisaku!
205.title_jap: 一網打尽計画!ジョナサン自信の秘策
205.summary: Luffy, Zoro, Usopp, and Robin continue to search for their treasure. Luffy leads Nami to the captain’s quarters where they retrieve their gold.

206.title_eng: Farewell, Marine Fortress! The Last Battle for Escape!
206.title_romanji: Saraba Kaigun Yōsai! Dasshutsu e no Saigō no Kōbō
206.title_jap: さらば海軍要塞!脱出への最後の攻防
206.summary: The Going Merry is grounded during a period of low tide and Jonathan believes they’ve reached “checkmate”. They cleverly use the impact dial to boost the ship and the breath and flame dials to inflate the octopus balloon again so they can escape.

207.title_eng: Great Adventure in Long Ring Long Land!
207.title_romanji: Rongu Ringu Rongu Rando no Daibōken!
207.title_jap: ロングリングロングランドの大冒険!
207.summary: Luffy and company come across a mysterious pirate ship after trying to escape a giant wave. Soon, they arrive on an island inhabited by strange animals. Going Merry is captured by the Foxy Pirate crew.

208.title_eng: A Davy Back with the Foxy Pirates!
208.title_jap: フォクシー海賊団とデービーバック!
208.summary: After Tonjit re-unites with his horse, they are soon attacked by Captain Foxy and his subordinates, who challenge Luffy in a Davy Back Fight, a contest of pirates where the stakes are members of the crew.

209.title_eng: Round 1! One Lap of the Donut Race!
209.title_romanji: Dai Ikkaisen! Gururi Ishū Dōnatsu Rēsu
209.title_jap: 第一回戦!ぐるり一周ドーナツレース
209.summary: The first round of Davy Back Fight involves a race around the island with tiny boats. Zoro's and Chopper's boat is eliminated.

210.title_eng: Silver Fox Foxy! The Merciless Interference!
210.title_romanji: Gin Gitsune no Fokushī! Mōretsu Bōgai Kōsei!
210.title_jap: 銀ギツネのフォクシー!猛烈妨害攻勢
210.summary: With only Luffy, Nami, and Porche's boat remaining, it's an all out war to the goal, but after Foxy exposes his Devil Fruit powers, Porche wins and takes Tony Tony Chopper from Luffy. The second round prepares to start.

211.title_eng: Round 2! Shoot It into the Groggy Ring!
211.title_romanji: Dai Ni Kaisen! Buchikome Gurokkī Ringu!
211.title_jap: 第二回戦!ブチ込めグロッキーリング
211.summary: Without Chopper, Sanji and Zoro must face the Foxy Pirates in a ball game, but are hampered by their blatant cheating and the crooked referee.

212.title_eng: A Barrage of Red Cards in Groggy Ring!
212.title_jap: レッドカード連発!グロッキーリング
212.summary: The bickering rivals Sanji and Zoro manage to overcome the opposing team by working together. Luffy chooses Tonjit's horse, Sherry over Chopper.

213.title_jap: 第三回戦!ぐるぐるローラーレース!
213.summary: The Straw Hats face Foxy in a race around a giant ring on roller skates.

214.title_eng: A Seriously Heated Race! Into the Final Round!
214.title_romanji: Hakunetsu Bakusō Rēsu! Saishū Raundo Totsunyū
214.title_jap: 白熱爆走レース!最終ラウンド突入!
214.summary: Thanks to some quick planning, the Straw Hats win the race.

215.title_jap: うなる熱球剛球! 海賊ドッジボール!
215.summary: With Luffy's victory, he takes Chopper back, but foolishly accepts another challenge by Foxy.

216.title_eng: Showdown on the Cliff! Red Light, Green Light!
216.title_romanji: Dangai no Kessen! Daruma-san ga Koronda!
216.title_jap: 断崖の決戦!だるまさんがころんだ!
216.summary: Foxy decides to take Robin from Luffy this time because of her Devil Fruit ability. The next match is a race to the top of the island.

217.title_eng: The Captains Square Off! The Final Combat Round!
217.title_jap: キャプテン対決!最終戦コンバット!
217.summary: With Chopper gone again from Luffy's crew, Luffy and Foxy face off in the final game: a battle of brawn aboard Foxy's ship.

218.title_eng: Full-Blast Slow-Slow Onslaught Vs. Invulnerable Luffy!
218.title_romanji: Zenkai Noro Noro Kōgeki vs Fujimi no Rufi
218.title_jap: 全開ノロノロ攻撃VS不死身のルフィ
218.summary: Luffy continues to battle Foxy with the odds not in his favor, and the fight continues inside Foxy's ship.

219.title_eng: Epic, Heated Combat! The Fateful Final Conclusion!
219.title_romanji: Sōzetsu Nettō Konbatto! Unmei no Saishū Ketchaku!
219.title_jap: 壮絶熱闘コンバット!運命の最終決着
219.summary: Luffy manages to finally defeat Foxy by using his ability against him. After dismissing his new crewmembers, the Straw Hats leave in search for a shipwright.

220.title_eng: Was It Lost? Stolen? Who Are You?
220.title_romanji: Ushinatta? Ubawareta? Omae wa Dare da?
220.title_jap: 失った?奪われた?おまえはだれだ?
220.summary: A mysterious figure appears during the night and steals the memories of the crew. In the morning, Robin is the only one who remembers the Straw Hats adventures together. Her attempts to keep the crew together fail as Nami and Zoro go separate ways.

221.title_eng: A Mysterious Boy With a Horn and Robin's Deduction!
221.title_romanji: Fude o Daita Nazo no Shōnen to Robin no Suiri!
221.title_jap: 笛を抱いた謎の少年とロビンの推理!
221.summary: Robin suggests that only those who were sleeping lost their memories. Luffy and the others then remember seeing the mysterious boy who played some kind of flute. Later that night, they discover the boy outside and Luffy tries to fight him. At the last second, he proclaims his memory has returned.

222.title_eng: Now, Let's Get Back Our Memories! The Pirate Crew Lands On the Island!
222.title_romanji: Iza Kioku o Dakkan seyo! Kaizokudan Shima ni Jōriku
222.title_jap: いざ記憶を奪還せよ!海賊団島に上陸
222.summary: During the night, Usopp, Chopper, and Sanji question what brought them to the Going Merry. In the morning, Usopp builds them a raft and they sail to the island where they meet Nami again. Meanwhile, the boy sets his sights on Zoro.

223.title_eng: Zoro Bares His Fangs! A Savage Animal Stands in the Way!
223.title_romanji: Kiba o Muku Zoro! Tachihadakatta Yajū
223.title_jap: 牙をむくゾロ!立ちはだかった野獣!
223.summary: On their way to "The Palace of the Sea God" Robin's group meets an entranced Zoro. It looks like Zoro wants to fight so Luffy urges the others to keep going without him. They apprehend the kid but the whistle was what was really stealing their memories. Zoro returns, still entranced, but Luffy's nowhere to be seen.

224.title_eng: The Last Counterattack by the Memory Thief Who Reveals His True Colors!
224.title_romanji: Honsei o Arawashita Kioku Dorobō no Saigo no Gyakushū
224.title_jap: 本性を現した記憶泥棒の最後の逆襲!
224.summary: Luffy returns and knocks some sense into Zoro. Cornered, the sea horse spreads illusions of the people in their memories to distract them. It steals their complete memories and claims that it has become a Sennenryu. Luffy defeats it and returns all the memories but the townspeople are convinced they're the memory stealers.

225.title_romanji: Hokori Takaki Otoko! Gin Gitsune no Fokushī
225.title_jap: 誇り高き男!銀ギツネのフォクシー
225.summary: Luffy rescues Foxy, Hamburg, and Porche from a storm at sea. When they reunite with the Sexy Foxy ship, they find it captained by somebody new. Foxy accepts a Davy Back Fight in order to regain his ship and crew. Donning the afro once again, Luffy vows to defeat the captain.

226.title_eng: The Guy Who’s the Closest to Invincible? And the Most Dangerous Man!
226.title_romanji: Mottomo Muteki ni Chikai Yatsu? To Mottomo Kiken na Otoko!
226.title_jap: 最も無敵に近い奴?と最も危険な男!
226.summary: Once Foxy wins back his crew, he captures the Straw Hats. Nami and Luffy fight Foxy and although he's defeated, his crew accepts him back. Later, they sail to an island where they meet someone Robin knows; a Marine named Aokiji.

227.title_eng: Navy Headquarters Admiral Aokiji! The Ferocity of an Ultimate Powerhouse!
227.title_romanji: Kaigun Hombu Taishō Aokiji! Saikō Senryoku no Kyōi
227.title_jap: 海軍本部大将青キジ!最高戦力の脅威
227.summary: The man they met, Marine High Admiral Aokiji, appears to be incredibly lazy. He first displays his Devil's Fruit ability by freezing the sea so some deserted people can get off the island. Unfortunately, he's determined to catch Robin. Luffy, Sanji, and Zoro attack but they seem to be no match.

228.title_eng: Duel Between Rubber and Ice! Luffy vs. Aokiji!
228.title_romanji: Gomu to Koori no Ikkiuchi! Rufi VS Aokiji!
228.title_jap: ゴムと氷の一騎打ち!ルフィVS青キジ
228.summary: Robin is frozen by Aokiji and Luffy tells the others to escape with her. In the Going Merry, Usopp and Chopper try to thaw her in the shower. Luffy gets defeated, but his life is spared as Aokiji believes he must repay the debt the marines incurred from Crocodile's defeat at Luffy's hands. With the crew defrosted, they continue sailing as usual. Zoro spots the giant frog they heard about and they chase it to an island with a lighthouse, but it appears they'll sink before they get there.

229.title_eng: The Dashing Sea Train and the City of Water: Water Seven!
229.title_romanji: Shissō umi ressha to mizu no miyako Uōtā Seven
229.title_jap: 疾走海列車と水の都ウォーターセブン
229.summary: After the Going Merry narrowly escapes being hit by a "sea train" which knocks away the giant frog attempting to derail it, the Straw Hats meet the stationmaster Kokoro along with her granddaughter Chimney and her bunny-like cat Gonbe. Kokoro assures the crew that the frog, Yokozuna, was perfectly fine and that it was always testing its strength against the Sea Train Puffing Tom, which connects several of the nearby islands. She also explains that the Log Pose would lead them to Water Seven, a canal city of shipwrights where they could fix their ship, providing Luffy with a map and letter of introduction to the shipwrights' leader Iceburg. The Straw Hats reach Water Seven, the group splits up with Luffy, Nami and Usopp leaving to exchange their gold and rent boats driven by fish-like sea monsters called Yagaras.

230.title_eng: Adventure in the City on the Water! Head to the Mammoth Shipbuilding Plant!
230.title_romanji: Suijō toshi no bōken! Mezase kyodai sōsen kōjō
230.title_jap: 水上都市の冒険!目指せ巨大造船工場
230.summary: Luffy, Nami, and Usopp get strange greetings from the residents and they get to experience the roller coaster-like channels of Water Seven. Luffy find out that some pirates had been beaten at the hands of some powerful craftsmen; the Galley La Company. Meanwhile, Chopper loses Robin when she is approached by a masked figure when Zoro encounters strange figures that came to the Going Merry.

231.title_jap: フランキー一家とアイスバーグさん
231.summary: Zoro awakens and drives off the "Franky Family", a gang of hoodlum pirate hunters. Luffy's group gets the gold they acquired from Skypeia exchanged for 300,000,000 berries. They soon reach Dock No. 1 and meet a man who resembles Usopp, Galley La's carpenter foreman Kaku, who jumps off to inspect the Going Merry while they speak to Iceberg. Usopp loses the money in his care to the Franky Family.

232.title_eng: Galley-La Company! A Grand Sight: Dock #1!
232.title_jap: ガレーラカンパニー!壮観一番ドック
232.summary: The Franky Family nearly escape with the Straw Hats' money were it not for untimely intervention of Galley La's Paulie while he was evading debt collectors, with another member named Rob Lucci keeping him from running off with the money. Iceberg's aide Kalifa shows Luffy, Nami, and Usopp around Dock No. 1 and tells them how Iceberg founded the Galley La Company. Usopp and the 200,000,000 berries he was carrying go missing as Kaku returns from the Going Merry and tells them that their keel is irreparably damaged.

233.title_eng: Pirate Abduction Incident! A Pirate Ship That Can Only Await Her End!
233.title_romanji: Kaizoku yūkai jiken to shi o matsu dake no kaizokusen
233.title_jap: 海賊誘拐事件と死を待つだけの海賊船
233.summary: Luffy refuses to believe that Galley La cannot repair the Going Merry before he and Nami realize that not only is Usopp missing now, but the two brief cases that were returned to them are empty. Nami decides to head to Franky House and finds Usopp on the way in a pitiful state, heading back to the ship for help while Usopp goes to the Franky House himself.

234.title_eng: Rescuing Our Friend! Raid On the Franky House!
234.title_jap: 仲間救出!殴りこみフランキーハウス
234.summary: Luffy, Sanji, Zoro, and Chopper follow Usopp's bloody trail to the Franky House, where they find him passed out in front after being beaten up in an attempt to get the money back from the Franky Family's leader Franky, who left with the money. The four of them proceed to overpower the Franky Family and destroy the Franky House, deducing that the money is likely gone while Luffy accepts that the Going Merry is beyond repair.

235.title_eng: Big Fight Under the Moon! The Pirate Flag Flutters With Sorrow!
235.title_romanji: Gekka no dai kenka! Kanashimi ni hirugaeru kaizoku hata!
235.title_jap: 月下の大喧嘩!哀しみに翻る海賊旗!
235.summary: Once they're back on the ship, Luffy explains to a guilt-ridden Usopp that the Going Merry can no longer be repaired and has chosen to get a new ship instead. Usopp believes that Luffy has abandoned the dignity of their ship and says he's leaving the crew, challenging Luffy to an official duel at nighttime.

236.title_eng: Luffy vs. Usopp! Collision of Two Men's Pride!
236.title_romanji: Rufi VS Usoppu! Butsukaru otoko no iji
236.title_jap: ルフィvsウソップ!ぶつかる男の意地
236.summary: Usopp fights Luffy in order to decide who keeps the Going Merry; going all out while keeping a hesitant Luffy on his toes as he and others remember their time with Usopp. Even after taking a harsh beating, Luffy defeats Usopp before he and the crew leave him and the ship behind.

237.title_eng: Severe Shock Hits the City of Water! Iceberg Targeted!
237.title_romanji: Gekishin mizu no miyako! Newareta Aisubāgu
237.title_jap: 激震水の都!狙われたアイスバーグ
237.summary: The Straw Hats get themselves a hotel room as Nami finds the crew on the roof and informs them that Iceberg has been shot. As the Galley La Company frantically search for answers, Luffy and Nami decide to check on his condition – only to be met by closed gates. At the same time, Franky returns to Water Seven and goes after Luffy to exact his revenge for destroying the Franky House – with style.

238.title_romanji: Gomugomu ningen VS hi o fuku kaizō ningen
238.title_jap: ゴムゴム人間VS火を吹く改造人間
238.summary: In the streets outside of the hospital, Luffy fights Franky as the latter reveals himself to be a cyborg. Inside, Iceberg recalls seeing Nico Robin and another tall man before he was shot. The Galley La company run outside and stop Franky and Luffy and tell them that they suspect the Straw Hat Pirates of the crime.

239.title_eng: The Straw Hat Pirates Are the Culprits? The Protectors of the City of Water!
239.title_romanji: Hannin wa mugiwara kaizokudan? Mizu no miyako no yōjinbo
239.title_jap: 犯人は麦わら海賊団?水の都の用心棒
239.summary: The Galley La Company continues to fight Luffy with an enraged Franky attempting to take both sides out. An incredibly high tide called the "Aqua Laguna" is coming and Chopper and Sanji rush to warn Usopp. Luffy raises some chaos in order to meet with Iceberg and he demands to know what's happening. Iceberg says he wants to see Robin one more time.

240.title_eng: Eternal Farewell? Nico Robin: The Woman Who Draws Darkness!
240.title_romanji: Eien no wakare? Yami o hiku onna Niko Robin
240.title_jap: 永遠の別れ?闇を引く女ニコ·ロビン
240.summary: In a bar, while recharging his soda reserves, Franky talks with Kokoro about her theory that Iceberg was shot by an agent of World Government's shadow organization CP9. The rumors she speaks of seem to have some truth as we see Robin meeting with CP9 members. While the crew hide from angry residents, Sanji and Chopper indirectly warn Usopp of Aqua Laguna before discovering Robin, who informs them of what they've feared: she's responsible and she wants to part ways.

241.title_eng: Capture Robin! The Determination of the Straw Hats!
241.title_romanji: Robin o tsukamaero! Mugiwara ichimi no ketsui
241.title_jap: ロビンを捕まえろ!麦わら一味の決意
241.summary: Chopper reunites with the others without Sanji and they discuss what's happened. Luffy decides that they need to catch Robin to know the full truth. Usopp attempts to repair the ship enough to withstand the Aqua Laguna and the Straw Hats make their way to the Galley La Company.

242.title_eng: Cannon Fire Is the Signal! CP9 Goes Into Action!
242.title_romanji: Aizu wa hōgeki to tomo ni! Ugokidashita CP9
242.title_jap: 合図は砲撃と共に!動き出したCP9
242.summary: The Straw Hats rush to Galley La as three CP9 agents commence their raid. Robin and the mysterious man that shot Iceberg enter Iceberg's room due to the latter's Devil Fruit powers. The masked-man informs him that CP9 framed the pirates and seeks blueprints he kept hidden and would've passed down to Paulie. Luffy separates from his group.

243.title_eng: CP9 Takes Off Their Masks! Their Shocking True Faces!
243.title_romanji: Kamen o totta CP9! Sono odoroki no sugao
243.title_jap: 仮面を取ったCP9!その驚きの素顔
243.summary: Robin speaks with Iceberg while the masked man leaves to keep anyone from interfering. She learns that Iceberg possesses the blueprints to the ultimate warship, Pluton. Elsewhere, Luffy is tied up with Paulie after the latter reveals to masked CP9 agents that the blueprints are fake. This forces the CP9 agents to regroup in Iceberg's room to interrogate him while revealing their true identities as Lucci, Kaku, Kalifa, and Blueno.

244.title_jap: 秘めた絆!アイスバーグとフランキー
244.summary: Lucci tells Iceberg their hypothesis from learning of the decoy blueprints and has Kaku check Iceberg's pulse to confirm that he gave the blueprints to another: a fellow apprentice of his mentor Tom named Cutty Flam, who now goes by Franky. The Straw Hat Pirates and Paulie break into the room where they find Iceberg and CP9. Meanwhile, Franky learns of Usopp working on the Going Merry and decides to capture him.

245.title_eng: Come Back, Robin! Showdown With CP9!
245.title_romanji: Kaette koi Robin! CP9 to no taiketsu!
245.title_jap: 帰って来いロビン!CP9との対決!
245.summary: Luffy and the others request that Robin comes back to the crew. She refuses and tells them that she cannot accomplish her "wish" if she were to stay with them. Robin turns to leave and while CP9 hold the pirates back while intent silence them, Iceberg, and Paulie. Robin successfully escapes and Lucci decides to use the remaining time before the building goes up in flames to unveil his "transformation".

246.title_eng: The Straw Hat Pirates Annihilated? The Menace of the Leopard Model!
246.title_romanji: Mugiwara kaizokudan zenmetsu? Moderu hyō no kyōi
246.title_jap: 麦わら海賊団全滅?モデル豹の脅威!
246.summary: Lucci explains he acquired the power of a Zoan Devil Fruit; the Cat-Cat Fruit: Leopard-Type, before quickly disposes of Luffy and Zoro while CP9 tie up Paulie and Iceberg, leaving them alone as the building slowly burns down around them. In Franky's underground hideout, Usopp tells him his story and Franky is finally touched. In return, Franky tells him a little about Tom's contributions to Water Seven.

247.title_eng: The Man Who Is Loved Even by His Ship! Usopp's Tears!
247.title_romanji: Fune kara mo aisareta otoko! Usoppu no namida!
247.title_jap: 船からも愛された男!ウソップの涙!
247.summary: Usopp believes that the person who repaired the Going Merry in Skypeia was really the ship itself, with Franky explaining that the ship was inhabited by a spirit who manifests on ships who are dearly cared for and the Going Merry repaired itself so the Straw Hats can reach the next island. When attempting to stop Franky from destroying the Going Merry in an act of mercy for the ship's sake, Usopp admits he knows be cannot bring himself to abandon the ship. The doorbell rings from the sea side and the CP9 agents enter, after attacking Franky's men.

248.title_eng: Franky's Past! The Day the Sea Train First Ran!
248.title_romanji: Furankī no kako! Umi ressha ga hashitta hi
248.title_jap: フランキーの過去!海列車が走った日
248.summary: The CP9 agents overpower Franky and discover a hidden room that they tear through to Franky's dismay of them trampling his memories. A long flashback ensues, covering Franky's past in Tom's Workers and how he and Iceberg helped create the Sea Train so Tom can save their city while not be held accountable for creating Gol D. Roger's ship.

249.title_eng: Spandam's Scheme! The Day the Sea Train Shook!
249.title_romanji: Supandamu no inbō! Umi ressha ga ureta hi
249.title_jap: スパンダムの陰謀!海列車が揺れた日
249.summary: Eight years prior to the Straw Hats reaching Water Seven, a CP5 agent named Spandam seeks to acquire the Pluton blueprints from Tom by any means to give the World Government an advantage against all pirates. As Franky walked into the town on the day that Tom would be a free man, Spandams flunkies stage an attack with the battleships that Franky personally constructed. Tom and Iceberg run to their shipyard where they're attacked by two ships which also destroy the others, they and Franky brought before the judge for trial. Franky denounces his ships with a provoked Tom punching him, taking him to acknowledge every ship he ever made or he'll never forgive him.

250.title_eng: The End of the Legendary Man! The Day the Sea Train Cried!
250.title_romanji: Densetsu no otoko no saigo! Umi ressha ga naita hi
250.title_jap: 伝説の男の最期!海列車が泣いた日
250.summary: After telling Franky to take pride in the ships he created, Tom takes a swing at Spandam before confessing to the attack while asking the judge to alter the arrangement to resolve him and his apprentices of the crime while taken to Enies Lobby and be executed for building Roger's ship. Franky, after disfisguring Spandam with the butt of a rifle, falses in his attempt to stop the train to Enies Lobby with his bare hands and was presumed dead by everyone. In the present, after being restrained, Franky finally learns that Spandam is now actually the leader of CP9.

251.title_eng: The Truth Behind Her Betrayal! Robin's Sorrowful Decision!
251.title_romanji: Uragiri no shinsō! Robin no kanashiki ketsui!
251.title_jap: 裏切りの真相!ロビンの哀しき決意!
251.summary: Chopper escapes the burning building with Paulie and Iceberg on his back and collapses outside.
