Queen fires bullets at Chopper but the Pleasures rush to his aid. Since Chopper saved them, the Pleasures decide to join his side, fighting Queen. Marco takes this opportunity to grab Queen by the neck, allowing Chopper to transform into his Monster Point form and strikes Queen, as he yells at everyone, who inwardly apologizes, that he isn't a raccoon. On the rooftop, Luffy rejoins the battle against Kaido. Meanwhile, in the treasure repository, the Akazaya Nine wake up to find their wounds bandaged. They open the door to find, to their surprise, Oden greeting them.

1024.title_eng: Oden Appears! The Confused Hearts of the Akazaya Members!
1024.title_romanji: Oden Arawaru! Yureru Akazaya no Kokoro!
1024.title_jap: おでん現る！揺れる赤鞘の心！
1024.summary: In the Right Brain Tower, Yamato and Shinobu defend Momonosuke from enemy Beast Pirates, but Momonosuke becomes frustrated by his inability to fend for himself. He accidentally transforms into a pink dragon, shocking Yamato. Momonosuke thinks back to when he was in Punk Hazard, he broke into a restricted area and ate a fruit, not knowing it was Vegapunk's Artificial Devil Fruit. Yamato comments that his ability is very similar to Kaido's. In the room CP0 are in, agent talks about when the Punk Hazard scientists, led by Vegapunk, created the fruit by extracting Kaido's Lineage Factor when he was once captured by the Navy. However, the experiment was deemed a failure and the fruit was left abandoned in the laboratory following its closure. In the treasure repository, the Akazaya Nine are happy to see Oden, assuming that he must have escaped the boiling pot and survived. Oden claims to have been saved by Toki's power and offers to lead them once again. However, Ashura and Raizo become suspicious and the latter reminding Kin'emon that Toki told them that it is impossible to return to the past. Ashura slices Oden's face, but he does not bleed. Furthermore, Oden stabs Ashura with his sword, confirming he is an impostor. It is revealed he is a drawing made by Kanjuro. Kanjuro states that he was fatally wounded by Kikunojo and would not survive the battle, but he plans to kill Momonosuke in his final moments. While in the hallways, Momonosuke returns to normal and somehow reveals that Luffy is worn out but still in high spirits. On the Skull Dome's roof, as the Worst Generation are being pushed back by Kaido and Big Mom, they decide to split them up in order to beat them.

1025.title_eng: The Worst Generation Gets Wiped Out?! The Emperors' Deadly Attack!
1025.title_romanji: Saiaku no Sedai Zenmetsu!? Yonkō no Ōwaza!
1025.title_jap: 最悪の世代全滅!? 四皇の大技！
1025.summary: The Akazaya Nine fight off the Kanjuro-controlled Oden, but Oden reveals and lights an explosive vest. To save the others, Ashura tackles Oden, crashing through a window before the vest detonates, killing them both. The Akazaya Nine begin to grieve his death. Kanjuro runs through the halls, still looking for Momonosuke, and states that he intends to kill the young lord then die himself, finally ending his life-long play. Meanwhile, in another room, a somehow still-living and vengeful Orochi knocks over a barrel of oil and sets it aflame, setting the castle on fire. The remaining Akazaya run through the hallways but quickly run into Jack, surrounded by fallen Mink warriors. Dogstorm break away from the group to battle Jack while the others advance to rescue Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Queen gets up to battle Chopper, but Marco rushes to his aid, battling Queen together. Although some Beast Pirates attempt to put the fires out, Orochi cuts them down before he's joined by Fukurokuju, planning to burn down Onigashima as revenge against Kaido. On the rooftop, as the Worst Generation try to figure out a way to separate the two emperors, with saying Law can't transport them downstairs because their Haki is too strong. Kaido and Big Mom decide to use a joint attack to try and wipe them out and they launch Conquest of the Sea, unleashing an extremely powerful shockwave. The Worst Generation members are unable to dodge the attack, but Zoro blocks the attack, protecting the others from the attack but leaving himself gravely injured. Luffy attempts to retaliate but Kaido evades the attack, preparing to attack him further.

1026.title_eng: The Supernovas Strike Back! The Mission to Tear Apart the Emperors!
1026.title_jap: 超新星反撃！四皇分解作戦
1026.summary: Orochi and Fukurokuju continue to set fire to the castle, as they prepare to go to the explosive storage. The remaining Akazaya Nine run through the hallways, worried about the fire, when they run into Orochi. The samurai tell Orochi that he's inconsequential to them. Fukurokuju offers to battle them, but Orochi insists on battling them himself, transforming into his Yamata no Orochi form (though it only now have seven heads). Despite this, the Akazaya Nine cut off Orochi's heads effortlessly, with Kin'emon cutting down his main head. When Orochi collapses, the Akazaya depart with Raizo staying behind to deal with Fukurokuju. Meanwhile, Kaido and Big Mom  continue to battle the Worst Generation on the rooftop, with Kaidou battling Luffy and Big Mom battling the others. Still, Luffy struggles to hurt Kaido and Big Mom wreaks havoc on the Worst Generation. As the Akazaya members hear the battle raging on the roof, Kin'emon assures his faith in Luffy. On the rooftop, the Worst Generation are being overwhelmed, with Kaido saying he'll take everything from them but Luffy reaffirms that they'll he'll never let Kaido take what's theirs. The pirates re-engage, with Luffy fighting hard against Kaido, only to be hit by a powerful blow from the Emperor. The rest of the Worst Generation tries a strategy to take Big Mom down by immobilizing her homies. Law traps Zeus into a metal box created by Kid, Zoro slices Prometheus into several pieces, and Killer distracts Napoleon by attacking him. With all her homies unable to aid her, Kid attaches some scrap to Big Mom to levitate her into the air while Law launches a boulder at her sending her to the edge of the island, as Zoro cuts off the cliff edge, causing her to start falling into the sea.

1027.title_eng: Defend Luffy! Zoro and Law's Sword Technique!
1027.title_romanji: Rufi o Mamore! Zoro to Rō no Kengi
1027.title_jap: ルフィを守れ！ゾロとローの剣技
1027.summary: Big Mom falls into the ocean below and starts to drown, but her homies are unable to go rescue her. With Luffy left unconscious from Kaido's attack, Kaido aids the homies by attacking Zoro. Law uses his powers to swap places with Zoro and strike at Kaido, but knocked back. This allows Prometheus and Napoleon to escape, while Zeus is still trapped in the box. Prometheus and Napoleon dive into the sea, rescue Big Mom and carry her back to Onigashima. Kid and Killer break off from the group to deal with Big Mom. On the way back to the floating island, Big Mom thanks Prometheus and Napoleon for rescuing her, but gets angry at Zeus for not coming to her aid. Prometheus, no longer wanting to share his power with Zeus, suggests that Big Mom abandons him and creates a new homie to be his girlfriend, which she agrees to. While they rise to the island, the Heart Pirates watch her from the Polar Tang, angry that she survived. Kaido prepares to finish off an unconscious Luffy, but Zoro prepares to use the last of his strength to take him down. Zoro, using Nine Sword Style, slashes Kaido's chest leaving a grievous wound. Seeing his wound, Kaido questions Zoro if he has Conqueror's Haki. Zoro doesn't know what he is talking about as he falls down, saying that he had hoped that attack would have brought Kaido down to the ground. Kaido, however, tells Zoro that his attack will definitely leave a scar. Kaido then retaliates and when Law tries to aid Zoro, he, too, is struck down. Kaido considers it a pity that they didn't decide to work for him, but Luffy, having regain consciousness, stands firm on their choice to ally with the samurai, and once again swears to defeat Kaido.

1028.title_eng: Surpass the Emperor of the Sea! Luffy Strikes Back with an Iron Fist!
1028.title_romanji: Yonkō o Koero – Rufi Hangeki no Tekken
1028.title_jap: 四皇を超えろ ルフィ反撃の鉄拳
1028.summary: Luffy's declaration angers Kaido. Meanwhile, Big Mom takes out a fragment of her soul and gives it to the thundercloud above, creating a new homie to replace Zeus. As her first technique, this new homie fires a powerful lightning bolt at Kid and Killer, hitting them at near point-blank range and shaking the entire island. Meanwhile, Nami, Tama, and Usopp attempt to return to the Performance Floor on Komachiyo while Page One chases them. Page One transforms into his Human-Beast Form and leaps onto Komachiyo's back, but Komachiyo begins to speed up, running into a wall at full speed and ramming Page One into it. Kid and Killer emerge from the rubble somewhere inside the castle. Big Mom is on the floor directly below them, still in pursuit of Kid. Suddenly, they are attacked by Hawkins, and Kid becomes enraged that Hawkins abandoned Kid in favour of Kaido. Killer convinces Kid to advance towards Big Mom while he stays behind to battles Hawkins, who transforms into a scarecrow-like figure. Back on the roof, Luffy admits all the attacks he used on Kaido were shallow, but after being struck with his kanabō, Luffy realized the truth behind Kaido's strength: Kaido can infuse objects with Conqueror's Haki. Kaido laughs in confirmation as he charges at Luffy, revealing that only a select few powerful individuals can pull it off as he brings his club down on Luffy. Remembering Hyogoro's lessons and the defeats he'd experienced in the past, Luffy infuses Conqueror's Haki into his limbs and blocks the attack with his foot without even touching it. With this, Luffy strikes Kaido's stomach without touching him, then unleashes a powerful uppercut knocking Kaido over. As Law is left in disbelief that Luffy did damage without actually touching Kaido, Luffy thanks both him and Zoro for covering him, but tells them to go back downstairs, declaring that he can handle the rest and he will beat Kaido no matter what.

1029.title_eng: A Faint Memory! Luffy and Red-Haired's Daughter Uta!
1029.title_romanji: Awai Kioku – Rufi to Akagami no Musume Uta
1029.title_jap: 淡い記憶 ルフィと赤髪の娘ウタ
1029.summary: While at sea the Straw Hat Pirates listen to the hit song 'New Genesis'. Meanwhile, Uta stands on a cliff, staring out into the ocean and thinking about her childhood. 12 years ago in Windmill Village, a seven year-old Luffy constantly wishes for a life of freedom all the while refusing his grandfather, Garp's desire for him to become a Marine. One day, the Red Hair Pirate come ashore, and Luffy meets Shanks for the first time, along with the Red Hair Pirates' musician and Shanks' nine-year-old daughter, Uta. While the two children initially don't get along, due to Luffy's constantly asking to join Shanks' crew and Uta's spoiled behavior, the two eventually formed a friendship. Back in the present day, Uta states that she will realise her dream, and continues to look out over the ocean.

1030.title_eng: A Pledge for the Next Genesis! Luffy and Uta!
1030.title_romanji: Shin Jidai no Chikai! Rufi to Uta
1030.title_jap: 新時代の誓い！ルフィとウタ
1030.summary: Luffy and Uta spend their time competing with each other. After one competition, Uta reveals that she dreams of travelling around the world with Shanks, and bringing joy with her singing. When the Red Hair Pirates leave Luffy swears to Uta that he'll be strong enough to join Shank's crew. However, when the Red Hair Pirates return, Luffy is shocked to learn Uta is gone. Shanks claims Uta left the crew to become a singer, but Luffy doesn't believe him, knowing that Uta loved Shanks and that something must have happened to her. When Shanks still doesn't tell him, Luffy runs off telling Shanks he's done with him. Some time later, news of Elegia's destruction spread across the world, with a reported 100% mortality rate and Shanks being held responsible. Back in Windmill Village Shanks' first mate, Beckman tries to Luffy to forgive Shanks, saying there are somethings people can't talk about, but Luffy instead runs off to the mountains, where he is attacked by bandits he and Uta had a previous encounter with. He is eventually saved by Beckman and brought back to the village. The Next day Luffy asks to join Shanks' crew, but is swiftly rejected. He sits with the Red Hair Pirates, telling Shanks that he won't ask what happened because it's his and Uta's business. Back in the present day, Usopp tells Luffy that Uta is putting on a live performance, and Nami adds that it's her first one. Luffy decides to go, and the crew head for Elegia. On the island, Uta prepares for the concert, stating that a new genesis is going to begin, leading to the events of One Piece Film: Red.

1031.title_eng: Nami Screams – A Deadly Death Race!
1031.title_romanji: Nami Zekkyō – Zettai Zetsumei Desu Rēsu!
1031.title_jap: ナミ絶叫 絶体絶命デスレース！
1031.summary: When Big Mom's new homie hit Kid and Killer with its attack, Kid's imprisonment of Zeus collapsed, finally freeing him. On Luffy's instruction, Law teleports himself and Zoro  to a lower level abring Zeus as well to keep hem from reuniting with Big Mom. Meanwhile, Momonosuke's group hides in the castle ceiling. They get in touch with Kin'emon, informing him that Momonosuke is safe, giving him their location so they can reunite as Yamato gathers some sewing supplies for their next move. Elsewhere, Usopp, Nami, and Tama are still being chased by Page One, who rides on Komachiyo's back, with Usopp upset that Tama's power doesn't work on non-SMILE Zoans. Tama plans to give an order on the Performance Floor in order make all the Gifters that ate a Kibi Dongo switch sides. Usopp manages to use his Pop Greens to knock Page One off Komachiyo's back, but he still fiercely pursues them. However, Big Mom appears, and is initially hostile to Nami and Usopp. However, due to her soft spot for children under the age of ten, she enters "Mother Mode" when she sees Tama. She remembers that when she lost her memory, the people of Okobore Town took care of her, fed her and fixed her hair. However, Tama tells her since food was stolen from Bakura Town, Kaidou's subordinates, led by Holedem, set fire to the town. Several people were harmed in the fire, including Tsuru. Page One, in his spinosaurus form, continues to pursue Tama's group, and Tama reminds Big Mom that he is one of Kaido's subordinates. Angry over Okobore Town's destruction, Big Mom strikes Page One with a Conqueror's Haki-imbued punch, alerting Kid and Zeus to her location. Page One collapses on the ground in front of Ulti, defeated.

1032.title_eng: The Dawn of the Land of Wano – The All-Out Battle Heats Up!
1032.title_romanji: Wano Kuni no Yoake – Zenmen Taiketsu Gekika!
1032.title_jap: ワノ国の夜明け 全面対決激化！
1032.summary: The grouped Akazaya head to Momonosuke to protect him from Kanjuro. Kikunojo states that the pain from her arm was far less than the pain of when Izo left. The Akazaya decide to split up to assist various areas of the battlefield, but Kiku remains with Kin'emon to pursue Kanjuro. Cat Viper is finally informed about Pedro's sacrifice and death, now knowing that his killer, Perospero, is present on Onigashima. To avenge Pedro, Cat Viper goes to assist Wanda and Carrot in battling Perospero. Yamato decides to run off with a decoy of Momonosuke, diverting the Marys' attention from the real Momonosuke. In the crawl space, Momonosuke hears Luffy's voice and senses that Luffy is battling Kaidou one-on-one. On the rooftop, they are battling fiercely but neither person could hit the other. On the castle's second floor, Sanji carries a heavily-bandaged Zoro on his back, fighting off swarms of Gifters and Pleasures while the latter heals from his injuries. On the Performance Floor, Chopper battles Queen, but Perospero intervenes by firing candy arrows at Chopper, which angers Queen as he doesn't want any help. Meanwhile, Ulti decides to avenge her defeated brother by attacking Big Mom. She brutally beats Komachiyo down to the ground, and when Tama attempts to stop her, Ulti strikes her in the face. Angry that Ulti assaulted a young girl, Nami and Big Mom both decide to turn on her and fight her directly. Nami attacks Ulti with her Clima-Tact, striking her with lightning, swearing to take her down.

1033.title_eng: The Conclusion! Luffy, Accelerating Fist of the Conqueror
1033.title_romanji: Ketchaku! Rufi Kasoku Suru Haō no Kobushi
1033.title_jap: 決着！ルフィ加速する覇王の拳
1033.summary: Sanji carries and protects Zoro as he heals, angry that he had to carry someone with a lower bounty than him. He remembers how this happened. Previously, Law teleported Zoro and the others downstairs and ran into Sanji on the way. Law instructed Sanji to take care of Zoro while his group ran off to another area. Sanji begrudgingly took Zoro to another room and bandaged his wounds. Back in the present, Sanji continues to carry Zoro down the halls when he encounters Kawamatsu and Izou. On Zoro's advice, they go to the Performance Floor. On the rooftop, Luffy and Kaidou continue to fight. They clash, destroying the floor under them, and Luffy is nearly thrown off the island. Luckily, he restabilizes himself on the island and continues the clash. Luffy declares he will restore the Kouzuki Family, free the Land of Wano and become the King of the Pirates. Back in the castle, Ulti gets back up and attacks Nami, grabbing her arm. However, Big Mom's homies, Prometheus, Napoleon and her new thndercloud homie, Hera, combine into a single weapon. They use Maser Cannon, unleashing a powerful beam piercing Ulti's abdomen, causing the Tobi Ropp collapse. Zeus watches from the corner, hurt that the other homies and Big Mom prefer Hera over him, even though she shows no respect to the other homies. Zeus then spots Nami, but she coldly ignores him, something he doesn't blame her for. Big Mom then approaches Zeus and he's eager to rejoin his master, but Big Mom coldly states that he's been replaced and is no longer needed in her crew. On the rooftop, Luffy begins to tire but refuses to back However, Kaido eventually triumphs, knocking Luffy unconscious and throwing him off the island, transformed back into his human form, Kaido regrets not taking Luffy's head, knowing his allies will still maintain their hope and belief in him.

1034.title_eng: Luffy, Defeated! The Straw Hats in Jeopardy?!
1034.title_romanji: Rufi Haiboku! Mugiwara no Ichimi Kyūchi!?
1034.title_jap: ルフィ敗北！麦わらの一味窮地!?
1034.summary: Kaido watches as Luffy falls into the ocean, remarking that though Luffy coated himself in Conqueror's Haki, he was still sloppy and unable to wield it perfectly. He then declares that Luffy will never become Joy Boy. Inside the palace, Big Mom rejects Zeus, no longer wanting him in her crew. She instructs Hera to eat Zeus so she can gain more power from his soul. Knowing that Big Mom is trying to take his life, Zeus attempts to reconcile with Nami, apologizing for his cowardice, but Nami refuses to forgive her. So, Zeus rebels for one final time against his mother, . Big Mom effortly subdues him and removes his soul before offering him to Hera. Taking pity in Zeus, Nami tries to help him by giving him Black Balls, but both they and Zeus are devoured by Hera. Meanwhile, on the Performance Floor, Queen and Perospero battle against and Chopper and the defected Beast Pirates, with Perospero raining down a swarm of candy arrows onto the floor striking down many combatants. An enraged then Chopper gets the upper hand by slamming Queen's body into the floor and throwing him into a wall, but Queen is unharmed while Chopper is left exhausted. On the third floor, Yamato continues to run through the halls with her fake Momonosuke, defeating a group of Gifters who fall for his decoy. The real Momonosuke is waiting in the crawl space for backup. While he is in hiding, he reads the Oden's, which tells of his adventures as a pirate. However, Momonosuke suddenly detects another mysterious voice. Unbeknownst to him, he is watched by another Mary. Having located him, Bao Huang reports Momonosuke's location to Kaido, who decides to personally pursue him. Hera receives a surge in energy from eating Zeus, and Nami's group decides to leave. As Tama also fled with them, Big Mom loses her compassion for her. Big Mom attacks them, but Kid appears and confronts her.

1035.title_eng: The Beasts Trample Down! The End of the Kouzuki Family!
1035.title_jap: 百獣蹂躙！光月家の終焉！
1035.summary: As Momonosuke continues to react to the mysterious voice, Shinobu begins to panic, allowing Kin'emon and Kikunojo to find them. Meanwhile, on the Performance Floor, Chopper continues to protect everyone from Perospero's arrows. As he does so, he thinks back to a conversation he had with Caesar Clown, where the scientist offered to improve the duration of Chopper's Rumble Ball from three minutes to thirty. Chopper was initially oppose to it, due the side effects that would come with it, but agreed when Caesar pointed out that he'll be facing stronger foes. Back in the present, with less ten minutes left in transformation Chopper charges at back into battle, but is overpowered by Queen. Suddenly, Bao Huang announces the end of the duel between Luffy and Kaido, declaring Kaido as the winner. Across the island, various allies and enemies react to the news, and Bao Huang announces that Kaido will re-enter the castle and begin cleaning up the remaining pirates and samurais. She offers the attackers the option to surrender and join the Beast Pirates, though nobody accepts. Meanwhile, Kanjuro arrives to Momonosuke's hiding spot As he enters disguised as Oden, both Momonosuke and Shinobu fall for his deception, but Kin'emon and Kikunojo see through it, holding the other two back. Kikunojo prepares to fight to avenge Ashura, but she is stopped by her memories of Oden which Kanjuro takes advantage of and stabs her, making her fall to the ground. With Kikunojo out of the fight, Kin'emon and Kanjuro prepare to duel. Kanjuro creates a stage for the fight, and Kin'emon angrily charges at him, cutting the actor down. The two think back on their time together, and Kanjuro declares that he needed to lose Kin'emon, his best friend on the stage, before falling to the ground, defeated. With the fight over, Kin'emon returns to Momonosuke and Shinobu, but Kaido suddenly appears before them, smashing through the ceiling. Kin'emon prepares to fight the Emperor as Shinobu and Momonosuke escape, and he is crushed by Kaido's kanabō while Momonosuke watches helplessly.

1036.title_eng: Fight Against the Dark Night – The Commander-in-chief of the Land of Wano Sounds Off
1036.title_romanji: Yamiyo ni Aragae – Wano Kuni Sōdaishō Hoeru
1036.title_jap: 闇夜に抗え ワノ国総大将吠える
1036.summary: As Luffy sinks into the ocean, Chopper continues to battle Queen, but is demotivated from his captain's defeat. Across Onigashima, various samurai and allies react to Bao Huang's announcement, with some reacting like Chopper and some refusing to believe it. Meanwhile, Onigashima approaches the Land of Wano, finally reaching the mainland. As the samurai begin to give up in their fight, the Nine Red Scabbards continue to fight, stating they won't stop until they defeat Kaidou. Izou points out how they can't confirm Luffy's death, and Kawamatsu remarks that even the possibility destroyed morale. However, Sanji refuses to even consider that Luffy lost, getting angry at the samurai for thinking that they might have lost. Back on the Performance Floor, Queen now has the upper hand against Chopper, as Perospero continues to bombard the samurai with arrows. They encourage everybody to give up fighting, as Queen is about to bite Chopper wit retractable needle-like fangs; however, he's stopped by Sanji whose kick is hard enough to send Queen's head spinning, causing him to intercept all of Perospero's arrows as well as send Perospero himself flying. He congratulates Chopper for holding off Queen enough for him to arrive, and tells him to continue trusting in Luffy, before handing him Zoro and telling to take care of the injured swordsman. Sanji resolves to fight Queen, and the samurai look on in awe, noting how he doesn't give up despite his captain having been defeated. Meanwhile, above the first floor, Kaidou easily defeats Kin'emon. Despite his injuries, Kin'emon continues to stand up and stab Kaido with his broken sword, allowing Shinobu and Momonosuke time to run. As he struggles, Kin'emon thinks back to when they were sent to the present day. He thinks back to when he and Momonosuke pretended to be father and son, and encourages him to continue living. However, he is stabbed by Kaido, collapsing to the floor. As Momonosuke runs with Shinobu, he also thinks back to his time with Kin'emon. He resolves himself to tell the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance members that Luffy isn't dead, and speaks into one of the Marys, announcing it across the island. He declares that Luffy is speaking to him, and encourages the allies to continue fighting until Luffy returns to the island.

1037.title_eng: Believe in Luffy! The Alliance's Counterattack Begins!
1037.title_romanji: Rufi o Shinjiro! Dōmei Hangeki Kaishi!
1037.title_jap: ルフィを信じろ！同盟反撃開始！
1037.summary: As Luffy sinks into the sea, Momonosuke uses a Mary to inform everybody located on Onigashima of his survival, and to declare that Luffy will defeat Kaido. The people located on the Performance Floor begin to cheer, and are reinvigorated in their fights. However, Momonosuke and Shinobu are still being followed by Kaidou, and are forced to flee, being thrown outside the Skull Dome. However, before Kaido can crush them, Shinobu is able to destroy the floor using her abilities, and the pair fall into the ocean. Bao Huang and horse Gifter, Horseman decide to announce their fall, hoping to demoralize the remaining samurai. Meanwhile, Nami, Usopp, and Tama continue heading towards the Performance Floor, hoping to allow Tama to take control of all the SMILE users who have eaten her dango. As they talk, Nami's Clima-Tact responds, shocking the trio. Elsewhere, Kid prepares to battle Big Mom, when Law suddenly arrives. He offers to form a temporary alliance with Kid to defeat Big Mom. Meanwhile, in the Flower Capital, the residents of Wano celebrate the Fire Festival. Tenguyama Hitetsu and Toko walk through the town together, and he explains the festival to her. Toko wonders if her father is watching them, and Hitetsu responds that he's sure he is. Back in Onigashima, the CP0 present assess the ongoing battle. They notice how nobody surrendered even after Luffy's supposed defeat, and count 5,000 soldiers who can no longer fight. With the Pleasures and Gifters present on the Performance Floor switching sides, the Beasts Pirates now have 20,000 combatants, and the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance have 7,000.Back with Nami, Usopp, and Tama, the group is trying to identify why Nami's Clima-Tact can suddenly speak it responds that it's actually Zeus. He reveals that when Nami tried save him from Hera, his conciseness was pressed into her Clima-Tact. Nami tries to shake him out of the Baton, but he points out that he can't leave without Big Mom's power, so she gives up and continues running. The trio finally arrive at the Performance Floor, exiting a door directly behind Bao Huang. As she is about to announce Momonosuke's fall from Onigashima, she is alerted to their presence, which distracts Usopp and allows Ulti to attack him from behind. She grabs Tama, angry that she has been able to make Beasts Pirates members switch sides, and prepares to attack her; however, she is attacked by Nami and Zeus, who can now extend and transform the Clima-Tact. Usopp is able to attack Ulti from behind, separating her and Tama, which allows Nami to prepare a lightning strike without fear of hurting Tama. Meanwhile, the Heart Pirates hear a voice underwater, finding Luffy sinking and they hurry to save him. Meanwhile, Yamato reaches the roof, seeing Kaido at the edge of the island and announcing that she is cutting ties.

1038.title_eng: Nami's Lethal Attack! Otama's Desperate Challenge!
1038.title_romanji: Nami Hissatsu! Otama Kesshi no Ōichiban!
1038.title_jap: ナミ必殺！お玉決死の大一番！
1038.summary: The Heart Pirates find a sinking Luffy, bringing him to the surface on their submarine. They begin trying to treat him, forcing the water he's swallowed out of his stomach. Meanwhile, as Shinobu and Momonosuke fall from Onigashima, Shinobu uses a kite, and the pair glide to the Wano mainland. However, when they land, Momonosuke bursts into tears, worried over the Kin'emon and Kiku. Back on Onigashima, Ulti is terrorizing Tama when she is suddenly attacked by Nami. Zeus offers to send a lightning blast, but Nami argues that it would hurt Tama; however, Usopp is able to separate her, and Nami takes the opportunity to make a cloud, but Zeus becomes the cloud. Nami then launches a Lightning Blast at Ulti who tries to dodge the strike, but Zeus redirects himself to hit her, knocking the Tobi Roppo unconscious. Panicking, Bao Huang accidentally announces Ulti's and Page One's defeats over the Marys system, causing panic across the Beast Pirates. Taking advantage of her panicking, Usopp incapacitates Horseman and Bao Huang, informing Tama that the latter works as a transmitter. As the allies across the island are overwhelmed with numbers, Tama speaks into the transmitter, converting the Gifters tamed by her power into allies. Elsewhere, Yamato informs Kaido of her decision to cut their familiar ties. Kaido tries to persuade her otherwise, stating that he defeated both Luffy and Momonosuke, but Yamato refuses to change her mind. Yamato declares her intention to set out to sea, stating that she will force Kaido to leave Wano; however, Kaido refuses to allow her to be a pirate elsewhere, stating she must stay in Wano as he transfoms into his Human-Beast Form. The two clash, with Yamato intending on forcing Kaido to remain on the rooftop until Luffy returns.

1039.title_eng: A Dramatic Increase of Allies! Straw Hats Fight Back!
1039.title_romanji: Mikata Gekizō! Mugiwara no Ichimi Gyakushū!
1039.title_jap: 味方激増！麦わらの一味逆襲！
1039.summary: Across Onigashima, the Gifters who have eaten Tama's dango begin to switch sides, attacking former allies. A Mary reports the mass-betrayal to CP0 as the combat devolves even further into chaos. The Beasts Pirates react in angry confusion, while the Alliance members welcome the change. Nami, Tama, and Usopp celebrate their success, drawing attention from Queen; however, as he tries to shoot them, he is attacked by Sanji, instead shooting the inside of his mouth. Queen welcomes him as Judge's son, angering Sanji, and reveals that he and Judge were former members of the science group MADS. As he prepares to fight, Queen reveals he is a cyborg and enters his Human-Beast Form. The surrounding Beast Pirates panic at his transformation, but Sanji ignores him, confirming with Chopper that Zoro will recover. As he turns to ask, however, he notices that Chopper has entered a new transformation, the Baby Geezer, as a result of his Rumble Ball transformation. However, as they talk, Sanji is attacked by Queen, and he prepares to face off. Chopper begins explaining his new form to Tristan, and Sanji begins fighting Queen. His explanation complete, Chopper turns to helping Zoro. Miyagi informs him about a powerful instant recovery drug from Zou; however, should he take it, his pain will be doubled when the drug wears off. Chopper decides not to give Zoro the drug, but Zoro insists on receiving it, stating that he wants to return to the fight. Elsewhere, the CP0 agents calculate the traitorous Gifters, estimating 300 people switched sides. Meanwhile, Nami, Tama, and Usopp try to find a safe space to hide, having completed their mission. As they run through the halls, they are attacked by a group of Waiters; however, they're suddenly saved by Daifugo and joined by Speed and Gazelleman, who offer lifts to the group. Gazelleman also informs them that he found Komachiyo unconscious. Elsewhere, Jinbe and Who's-Who begin to fight. Among his attacks, Who's-Who incorporates the Six Powers, prompting Jinbe to remark that he's using a World Government fighting style. He brings up a story about a CP9 agent escaping from prison, and Who's-Who confirms that he's the agent as he transforms into his Human-Beast Form. As the two continue fighting, Who's-Who begins explaining his past as a Government agent who was on par with Rob Lucci, though Jinbe has trouble understanding how the story is relevant to him. However, Who's-Who explains that 13 years ago, a Devil Fruit that he was assigned to protect on a Government ship was stolen; the Gum-Gum Fruit.

1040.title_eng: The Pride of a Helmsman? The Enraged Jimbei!
1040.title_romanji: Sōdashu no Hokori – Ikari no Jinbē!
1040.title_jap: 操舵手の誇り 怒りのジンベエ！
1040.summary: As Speed carries Tama, Nami, and Usopp through Onigashima, with Gazelleman and Daifugo following close behind in order to recover Komachiyo, defending the trio along the way, Zeus asks Nami if he can become her attendant again; however, she declines, asking him to be her partner instead. Elsewhere, the present CP0 agents speculate that 2,000 soldiers switched sides due to Tama's abilities, which, after discounting 2,000 Beast Pirates due to injury, leaves the field at 16,000 vs. 9,000. However, they remark it as inconsequential to them, noting that they only need to confirm Who's-Who's death as punishment for leaving CP9. Meanwhile, Jinbe asks why Who's-Who left the World Government and became a pirate, but Who's-Who just responds that Jinbe functionally did the same thing. Who-Who's reveals his grudge against Luffy comes from the latter having the Gum-Gum Fruit and his connection with Shanks (the one who stole the fruit). The two then argue over their opinions of Luffy. In the ocean, the Heart Pirates continue trying to resuscitate Luffy. Thinking back to his past with Luffy, Jinbe swears to fight as the helmsman of the Straw Hat Pirates. As they continue to fight, Who's-Who tells Jinbe that while he was imprisoned, he told about the "Sun God" Nika, a legendary warrior of ancient times who would supposedly free slaves. Jinbe asks how this information is relevant to him, and Who's-Who brings up the past slavery of Sun Pirates members and Fish-Men as a whole, asking Jinbe for more information about Nika while mentioning the guard who mockingly told him about Nika was eventually executed, and asks if it's dangerous to even know of his existence. He begins once again bombarding Jinbe with attacks, asking if he knows a lot about slavery due to being a Fish-Man. However, Jinbe just catches Who's-Who's arms, stating that he has nothing to tell him. Jinbe breaks Who's-Who's fingers and steps on his tail, and tells him that if he wants to investigate history then he needs to be prepared for what he'll find as he defeats Who's-Who with Fish-Man Karate Secret Art: Demon Brick Fist.

1041.title_eng: Showdown Battles of the Monsters! Yamato and Franky
1041.title_romanji: Kaijū Dai Kessen! Yamato to Furankī
1041.title_jap: 怪獣大決戦！ヤマトとフランキー
1041.summary: Kaido and Yamato clash on the Onigashima rooftop, as Yamato attempts to cut ties with her father. However, Kaido refuses to accept it, instead trying to convince Yamato to become the Shogun of Wano under Kaido. Yamato states that she will continue to believe in Luffy, and that he will stall Kaido until he returns. He transforms into his Human-Beast Form, vowing to protect Wano. On the Performance Floor, Queen continues to attack Sanji, bragging about his powers as a cyborg, firing lasers from the mechanical claws on the end of his left arm, tail and braid. However, Sanjishows no real interest in them angering Queen. As Sanji continues to dodge the lasers, Zoro convinces Chopper and Miyagi to give him the miracle drug. Elsewhere, Gifters under Tama's influence begin assisting Franky, driving off the Beast Pirates who were surrounding him. As Franky and Sasaki fight, the two realize that they're both very durable, so Sasaki transforms into his Human-Beast Form. Back on the roof, Kaido continues trying to convince Yamato to stay by his side while expessing anger Yamato for eating her Devil Fruit. Yamato responds that she only ate it because she was starving and is also mad since she can no longer swim. Back in the Right Brain Tower, Sasaki draws his Trick Mechanism Screw Sword as Franky draws his sword. Franky instructs the surrounding Gifters to go help others, but Sasaki suddenly begins spinning his frill like a propeller, and begins to fly, charging forward and sending the Gifters flying. Franky is forced on the defensive, preparing the General Shield in anticipation of Sasaki's next charge. However, Sasaki accidentally spins his frills the wrong direction, throwing himself backwards instead. He follows up with a charge forward, successfully blowing one of the thrusters on the General Franky's shoulder. However, Franky managed to grab Sasaki, suplexing him into the ground. In the ocean, the Heart Pirates continue trying to wake up Luffy. He finally regains consciousness, and begins demanding meat.

1042.title_eng: The Predator's Trap - Black Maria's Temptation
1042.title_romanji: Hoshokusha no Wana - Burakku Maria no Yūwaku
1042.title_jap: 捕食者の罠 ブラックマリアの誘惑
1042.summary: Yamato and Kaido continue to duel on the rooftop, with Yamato officially refusing Kaidou's offer to become Shogun. Meanwhile, Franky points out Sasaki's stomach cut despite his toughness, attempting to slash his stomach again. However, Sasaki avoids it, and the two begin a sword fight, leading to the Fraken being shattered and half of General Fanky's left shoulder being sliced off. Franky is eventually forced to run, but upon realizing that they're close to the Performance Floor, Franky makes his stand and fires the General Cannon at Sasaki. Sasaki endures the attack and dive-bombs Franky, critically damaging General Franky. But Franky is ejected from the robot and defeats the Tobi Roppo by firing a Franky Radical Beam at the Sasaki's stomach. Back on the rooftop, Kaidou laments Yamato having eaten the Dog-Dog Fruit, Mythical Type Model: Okuchi no Makami,[22] as the Okuchi No Makami is considered as the "Guardian Deity of the Land of Wano" and asks once again for Yamato to become Shogun under him. Yamato refuses once again, and begins shooting ice at Kaidou, though the latter counters the ice shots with a blast of fire. Inside Onigashima, Brook and Robin walk through fog, with Nico Olvia suddenly appearing before them. Saul and Clover quickly follow suit, gesturing towards Robin. She reminisces her time with the three of them, remembering their deaths. However, she realizes soon enough that they're simply mere illusions, knocking away Black Maria's minions, including Numbers member, Kunyun, who were embodying these illusions. Remembering the words of both her mother and Luffy, Robin declares that she has friend and has decided to live.

1043.title_eng: Slash the Nightmare - Brook Draws His Freezing Sword!
1043.title_romanji: Akumu o Kiru - Burukku no Kōri no Battō!
1043.title_jap: 悪夢を斬る ブルックの氷の抜刀！
1043.summary: As Robin runs from Black Maria's Gifters, she is joined by Brook, who relieves that she was not tricked by the Illusion Mist. However, they are suddenly attacked by Black Maria herself as Robin remarks that Brook was immune to the mist as well. He explains that he saw his old crew, the Rumbar Pirates, in the mist. However, he saw though the illusion because of how often he hallucinated that his old crew was alive while he was stuck in the Florian Triangle for 50 years and was able to cut down the enemies hiding in the illusion. As the two continue running, Robin points out that they have a lot in common, and Brook thinks back to his time joining the Straw Hat Pirates. While Robin and Brook keep running, Black Maria swipes at them with Wanyudo, who is actually a Pug SMILE user who runs on the inside of the wheel of her weapon to generate flames, setting the floor bablaze. Robin to grab onto the ceiling and lift the two Straw Hats off the floor. Brook realizes that Wanyudo is a living being, sending his soul through him and freezing him, before Brook extinguishes the flames by covering the ground in ice. Black Maria tries to state that Sanji sold out Robin, hence the reason he called for help, but Robin ignores her. Brook leaves Black Maria to Robin, promising to defeat her underlings instead. Once Brook leaves, Robin argues with Black Maria's description of Sanji, and begins fighting back in earnest. Robin creates a giant version of herself, grabbing Black Maria with multiple extra sets of giant hands. However, Black Maria begins slicing at the arms, causing injuries to form on Robin herself. Noticing Robin receive the injuries, Black Maria launches multiple tendrils of thread, blocking the movement of Robin's enlarged limbs. Back on mainland, as Momonosuke and Shinobu watch as Onigashima flies more inland, they're reunited with the Heart Pirates and Luffy, the latter loudly shouting for meat, having already quickly ate through all the Heart Pirates' provisions, while still asking for more. The Heart Pirates, Momonosuke and Shinobu explain the respective situation to each other. As Momonosuke begins cry, Luffy yells at him to stop, stating he'll be the next Shogun. He then begins yelling for meat again, as Caribou arrives, offering meat to the Heart Pirates. Meanwhile, Luffy asks Momonosuke to transform into a dragon and fly him back up to Onigashima.

1044.title_jap: クラッチ！悪魔の化身 ロビン！
1044.summary: Black Maria traps Robin's enlarged form in her web, and starts to sadistically beat Robin with her brass knuckles. Eventually, Robin cancels her technique, recreating her giant arms behind Black Maria. However, Black Maria is able to block the attack, burning the webs she used and surrounding Robin in the process. Black Maria begins swiping at Robin, forcing her to evade, until she ends up caught in one of Black Maria's webs. Black Maria states that she is only retaliating for Robin punching her earlier, and she hits Robin again, throwing her into another set of webs. As she continues to beat Robin, she berates her, stating that she is only useful as somebody who can read the Poneglyphs. Black Maria's insults remind Robin of her childhood and time on the run, and Brook advises Black Maria to run before it's too late as he creates an ice wall to prevent Black Maria's underlings from interfering. As Robin continues to think back, she remembers a training session with the Revolutionary Army, during which she learned a new palm-thrust technique that applies Fish-Man Karate techniques. She creates another giant arm and thrust the ceiling above her and crashing debris above Black Maria, putting out the fire in the process. Free from the webs, Robin creates another giant body, this one in the shape of a demon, Demonio Flur. She generates more arms, trapping Black Maria in a grappling hold and knocks her unconscious with Grand Jacuzzi Clutch. Hearing Black Maria's scream, her Gifters and Kunyun try to see through Brook's ice wall. They realize the Black Maria has lost, and while in a panic, are swiftly defeated by Brook. Brook then walks over to Robin and catches her when she passes out from exhaustion as a Mary is shown to have observed the fight. Back on the Wano mainland, Luffy eats the food provided by Caribou. As he eats, he reassures the Heart Pirates that their captain is alive, and Momonosuke tries to convince Shinobu to use her powers to turn him into an adult so he can transform into a full-grown dragon. Even though Shinobu warns him the process can't be undone, Momonosuke, is undeterred, saying if they don't, all of Wano will be destroyed.

1045.title_eng: A Spell! Kid and Zoro Facing Threats!
1045.title_romanji: Jubaku! Semaru Kyōi - Kiddo to Zoro!
1045.title_jap: 呪縛！迫る脅威 キッドとゾロ！
1045.summary: A Mary reports Black Maria defeat to CP0. Raizo enters battle against Fukurokuju but Fukurokuju uses his long earlobes as whips, knocking him to the ground, with Fukurokuju mocks Raizo's emotion saying they're unfitting for a ninja. However, Raizo retorts that those emotions are what make him and his comrades who they are claiming they'll succeed in making Momonosuke the shogun and ending Kaido and Orochi's cruel reign. On Wano's mainland Shinobu turns Momonosuke into an adult and weeps at his appearance. Killer's fight with Hawkins continues, and though Killer manages to slash him, Hawkins' Straw-Straw Fruit ability allows him to redirect the damage onto other people, leaving himself unharmed. When Killer stabs Hawkins, he instead injures Kid, hurting his battle with Big Mom. Hawkins reverts to his normal form and reveals to Killer that he has Kid's Strawman doll in his body, making Killer realizes that he can't harm Hawkins without first killing his own captain. On the Performance Floor, Sanji is left to battle against both King and Queen while Zoro continues to heal, waiting for the drug to take effect, while Marco appears to have reached his limit. Perospero attempts to sabotage Sanji by shooting him with his candy bow, but Cat Viper appears and strikes him out of the castle. King and Queen get the upper hand and strike Sanji down. While Queen brutally punishes the defected Gifters, King decides to pursue and attack Zoro while he is incapacitated. Although Chopper's group attempts to take Zoro away, King stops them, with the drug having yet to take effect.

1046.title_eng: Taking a Chance! The Two Arms Go into Battle!
1046.title_jap: 一か八かの大勝負！両翼出陣！
1046.summary: King intercepts Chopper's group which is carrying Zoro. Sanji sees this and tries to defend against King but is shot by Queen's laser. Marco manages to block King's attack and the two square off. Marco talks of a race that could ignite themselves and once lived on top of the Red Line and says that he didn't expect to meet one in King. King and Queen are prepared to fight Marco, but he surrenders seeing that Zoro has recovered from his injuries, thanks to the drug given to him by Miyagi. Zoro deflects Queen's attack. He and Sanji then proceed to attack the two Lead Performers. Zoro and Sanji then both say that winning this battle will give them a glimpse of Luffy becoming the King of the Pirates Hyogoro advises the other samurai not to interfere in the fight as Kawamatsu arrives at the Performance Floor. Marco spaces out as he watches the fight. He recalls his conversation with Whitebeard about how Mary Geoise used to be the Land of Gods. He is then saved by Izou when some Beast Pirates shoot at Marco while he is in a daze. During their fight, Sanji notices something different in his body from when he put on his Raid Suit a while back. Queen notices this, too, and (despite Sanji's refutes) claims that Sanji must also be a cyborg like Judge's other children since no human can ignite themselves as he's not a Lunarian. Zoro attempts to attack King but he blocks it with a sword that has several notches in it, in which Zoro's swords are caught, allowing King to simply toss them away and leaving Zoro open to be punched by a retractable-spiked glove. Zoro uses the sword in his mouth to block it as he calls King a bloodthirsty brute. King retorts that he never understood why anyone would stick to traditional forms and techniques in a real battle, which Zoro accepts, admitting King never claimed to be a swordsman himself. Nevertheless, Zoro reclaims his swords and tells King he can't afford to lose to him. As the four continue to battle, Hyougoro and Kawamatsu notice Zoro's similarities with the former Daimyo of Ringo, Shimotsuki Ushimaru, who was a descendant of the God of the Blade, Shimotsuki Ryuma―from the way he stands, his one eye, down to his swordplay. They feel that the fact that he returned Shusui to Wano was fate. Meanwhile in Tokage Port, Luffy regains his strength and looks for Momonosuke. Shinobu responds to Luffy as two giant eyes appear behind the shadows.

1047.title_eng: Ascend to the Dawn! A Pink Dragon Gets Agitated
1047.title_romanji: Yoake e to Nobore! Momoiro no Ryū Takeru
1047.title_jap: 夜明けへと昇れ！桃色の龍猛る
1047.summary: As the castle is slowly being engulfed by fire, many Beast Pirates quickly move towards the Performance Floor where Sanji, Zoro, King and Queen are fighting, Hyougoro and Kawamatsu preventing them from interfering with the fight. Meanwhile, after beating Sasaki, as Franky fends off some Beast Pirates, he runs out of energy so Bepo, Penguin, and Shachi step in. On the second floor of the castle, Nami, Usopp, and Tama are riding on Speed's back, with Zeus following close by. They are running away from Beast Pirates and while trying to escape Usopp to fall off Speed's back. On the same floor, Law and Kid are battling with Big Mom. Her Conqueror's Haki causes a large number of Beast Pirates to lose consciousness, which saves Usopp from their attacks. Usopp bluffs about causing the surge of Haki and urges the remaining conscious Beast Pirates to join him. On the third floor, Brook is carrying an unconscious Robin inside the burning floor while the fourth floor, Jinbe and Heat are also fighting Beast Pirates. Meanwhile, at the rooftop, Yamato barely manages to keep Kaido preoccupied while waiting for Luffy to return. In the Treasure Repository, Dogstorm and Jack are still engaged in battle, with Jack now in his centaur-like Human-Beast Form. Jack seems to have the upper hand since Dogstorm can't use his Sulong form indoors. However, using his convictions, he gets a surge of energy to toss Jack though a wall into a portion of the castle where the roof was blown off, (the room where Ashura sacrificed himself). Now with the moon visible, Dogstorm transforms into his Sulong form. Outside, as Shishilian and Bariete tend to Carrot and Wanda, Cat Viper faces Perospero, vowing to avenge Pedro's death, transforms into a Sulong as well. On the second floor, Fukurokuju mocks the Akazaya Nine fools for serving a child but Raizo angrily tells him that Momonosuke still has time to grow, with Wano serving to shape that. In Tokage Port, Caribou and the other Heart Pirates see a large pink dragon and are frightened as it resembles Kaido. Luffy approaches the dragon, knowing that it is actually Momonosuke. Shinobu reveals that she used her Ripe-Ripe abilities to age him to 28 years old, at the young shogun's request. Luffy then tells Momonosuke that it is time for them to take Wano back.

1048.title_eng: For the Future! Yamato and the Great Swordsmen's Pledge
1048.title_romanji: Mirai e! Yamato to Dai Kengō no Chikai
1048.title_jap: 未来へ！ヤマトと大剣豪の誓い
1048.summary: Luffy rides on Momonusuke's back and they start flying towards Kaidou. However, being afraid of heights and having realized that they have been flying, Momonosuke comes crashing down. Meanwhile, as he continues his fight with Kaido Yamato remembers the first time she saw Oden and how the latter's sacrifice to save his retainers touched him as a young child. This caused the young Yamato to rampage around the castle. Yamato was subdued after knocking out several Beast Pirates with Conqueror's Haki. When Yamato declared her love for Oden and declared himself to be Oden, Kaido chained her and locked her up inside the Sacrad Cave with three damiyos who rebelled against Kaido, telling them that they would be locked up for a month, but would be let ou earlier if they changed their mind and joined his army. Yamato feared the samurai would kill her for being Kaido's child, but instead they showed her nothing but kindness. They gave her the little food they were given, released her from her chains, and trained her. When Yamato saw that the samurai did not intend to harm her, she asked them to help her read Oden's journal which she had found at the foot of Oden Castle. The four read the journal together, learning of the era Oden predicted. After 10 days, the samurai resolved to escape from the cave after seeing that Kaido had no plans on releasing his own son. They also had no intention of rotting away inside the cave and while they would not be able to see the battle that would happen in 20 years, they were reassured knowing that people like Yamato would still be there to fight for Wano. Back in the present, Yamato and Kaido are still exchanging blows, with Yamato remembering that there were people who believed in her and accepted her. She demands to know why her father is taking away her freedom and the freedom of Wano. Kaido answers that life is not a series of simple questions and answers as their advance Conqueror's Haki clash.

1049.title_eng: Luffy Soars! Revenge Against the King of the Beasts
1049.title_romanji: Rufi Hishō! Hyakujū e no Ribenji
1049.title_jap: ルフィ飛翔！百獣へのリベンジ
1049.summary: Luffy urges Momonosuke to fly and grows impatient, but the young master is crippled by his fear of heights. Meanwhile, Yamato keeps Kaido busy and the two continue to exchange blows. Yamato manages to make Kaido bleed and is able to defend against Kaido's attacks coating himself in a layer of ice, declaring that he cannot die until Luffy comes back. Kaido mocks Yamato's resolve to protect Wano since Yamato is still his son so the people of Wano would never look at him as an ally while further laughing at how Yamato doesn't even have any friends. Yamato disagrees as she remembers Ace who became her friend when the latter came to Wano. However, he also remembers when he was a child and one of Kaido's men helped him by giving him food when he was starving and a blanket when it was cold but was executed when Kaido found out about it. Kaido points out that all of those who have been good to Yamato are all dead, including the samurai who were locked up with him in the Sacred Cave. Yamato rebuffs him, saying that they all died because he killed him, to which Kaido replies that they were getting in the way of him educating his child. Back in Tokage Port, Luffy pulls on Momonosuke's dragon whiskers to force him to fly. Ultimately, Momonosuke takes flight towards Onigashima, albeit, with closed eyes due to fear. Flying blindly, Momonosuke crashes into the Skull Dome and flies through the castle, destroying walls and ceilings as he runs wild, confonding all who see him. He finally opens his eyes and finds his way to the rooftop where they see Kaido and Yamato, both back in their human forms. Yamato prepares her Divine Swiftness White Serpent technique and Luffy joins him in Fourth Gear: Snakeman, launching a Jet Culverin. The two simultaneously attack, sending Kaido flying across the rooftop.

1050.title_eng: Two Dragons Face Off! Momonosuke's Determination!
1050.title_jap: 双竜相搏つ！モモの助の覚悟！
1050.summary: After sending Kaido flying across the rooftop, Luffy thanks Yamato for holding back Kaidou and Yamato expresses her relief that Luffy has finally arrived. Kaido then emerges in his dragon form, unscathed. He is in disbelief that Luffy survived his previous injuries. He notices the pink dragon before him and demands to know who he is. Although frightened at first, Momonosuke answers that he is Kouzuki Momonosuke, the one who will become the Shogun of Wano. Meanwhile, the people in the Flower Capital are oblivious to the events on Onigashima. Toko and Hitetsu join the festivities, with Toko remembering her farther, Yasuie while Hitetsu worries for Tama's safety. A Mary reports updates on the rooftop to all of Onigashima, with the Starw Hats relief at their captain's return. Elsewhere, Dogstorm and Cat Viper seem to be winning their fights against Jack and Perospero, respectively. However, clouds slowly obstruct the full moon, causing the minks to loss their Sulong form. Deprived of their Sulong form and drained of their energy, the minks are overwhelmed by their opponents, as Jack and Perospero prepare to strike down their opponents, with the latter turning his cane into a candy ax. On the rooftop, Kaido is about to breathe fire on Momonosuke, so Luffy urges the pink dragon to do the same. However, Momonosuke doubts he can produce such an attack so Luffy instead, tells him to bite the emperor. Momonosuke is horrified by this suggestion. Kaido blasts him with successive Blast Breaths which Momonosuke barely manages to evade. Momonosuke remembers what he and his family went through in the hands of Kaido so he musters up the courage to sink his teeth onto the blue dragon. An angered Kaido is about to blast another attack when Luffy punches him in the face, preventing Kaidou from breathing fire. Luffy shouts his praises for Momonosuke which is heard all throughout Onigashima. Luffy tells Momonosuke that he just bit an Emperor of the Sea so there should be nothing left in the world that can scare him. Momonosuke realizes what he just did and concurs.

1051.title_eng: A Legend All Over Again! Luffy's Fist Roars in the Sky
1051.title_romanji: Densetsu no Sairai! Ten ni Todoroku Rufi no Kobushi
1051.title_jap: 伝説の再来！天に轟くルフィの拳
1051.summary: Luffy's proud declaration from the Skull Dome rooftop inspires the remaining fighters of the alliance to continue fighting. With this, Zoro and Sanji increase their efforts, beginning to overpower King and Queen. However, Kaido reemerges from the rubble after being bitten. Transform back into his Human-Beast Form, Kaido asks Luffy if he honestly thinks has a chance at defeating him with Luffy replying that as long as he is still alive, he has infinite chances.  As Luffy and Kaido clash once again, their Conqueror's Haki creates a powerful explosion that breaks apart the clouds above and revealing the night sky. As Yamato watches in awe at Luffy and Kaido's clash, he remembers Oden writing about how Roger and Whitebeard's clash split the heavens as well. Upon Luffy's instruction, Momonosuke and Yamato then leap off the edge of the island, aiming to stop Onigashima from moving while Luffy prevents Kaido from stopping them. Though Momonosuke initially struggles, Yamato's encouragment allows him to generate flame cloud and run across the sky. The explosion created by Luffy and Kaido, which revealed the full moon, allows Dogstrom and Cat Viper to transform back into their Sulong forms. Using Oden One Sword Style with their respective claws and sword leg, Cat Viper and Dogstorm defeat Perospero and Jack respectively. Jack's defeat is observed by Orochi, who is still alive and hiding, and horrified that a Lead Performer has been defeated before remembering he is no longer Kaido's ally. On the rooftop, Luffy and Kaido resume their battle, with Kaido warning Luffy that if he loses everyone in the Land of Wano he will become his slave.

1052.title_eng: The Situation Has Grown Tense! The End of Onigashima!
1052.title_romanji: Fūun Kyū o Tsugeru! Onigashima no Matsuro!
1052.title_jap: 風雲急を告げる！鬼ヶ島の末路！
1052.summary: Momonosuke and Yamato fly away from the island to try to move it back. They learn that Kaido's flame clouds are becoming unstable due to Kaido weakening and the island risks collapsing and crashing into the Flower Capital below, with all the explosives stored inside Onigashima threatening to destroy the capital if the island falls. Momonosuke panics and considers getting Luffy to stop fighting Kaido, but Yamato smacks him on the head and reminds him that Luffy is already putting everything on his shoulders with his fight, and he doesn't need anymore pressure, meaning the two of them need to figure out how to stop the island themselves. Momonosuke attempts to push the island, but to no avail. Yamamoto advises him that he will have to create flame clouds of his own to support the island. On the Performance Floor, Sanji's battle with Queen continues and Zoro's battle with King. Sanji is hit with a strong attack from Queen, but is surprised that none of his bones are broken. Zoro sends a flying slash that slices off a spike from King's outfit. As this was the first time that King's mask was compromised, he quickly grows infuriated and transforms back into his Human-Beast Form, sending flying slashes into the battle. Several fighters are hit by the slashes, with one slash hits Queen's behind while Zoro is sent flying into a hallway with King following. Meanwhile, as they battle inside the Performance Floor, Queen begs Sanji to put on his Raid Suit, but Sanji refuses stating again he despises the Vinsmokes as his body starts to feel weird again. In the hallway, Zoro clashes with King but is overpowered, though he manages to slice off another piece of King's mask, revealing part of his scalp. King's attacks send Zoro flying off the island but Zoro manages to get back onto the island. As King reverts to his human form, Zoro tell him he will not forgive him for trying to kill him without a sword with King saying he will not forgive Zoro either.

1053.title_eng: Sanji's Mutation? The Two Arms in Crisis!
1053.title_romanji: Sanji no Ihen - Ryōyoku Kiiro Shingō!
1053.title_jap: サンジの異変 両翼黄色信号！
1053.summary: Momonosuke attempts to make Flame Clouds in order to move Onigashima, but he struggles to create them as the clouds immediately disintegrate. Yamato decides to leave him and go back into the island to secure explosives; as explosives are stored on the island, if the island crashes into the Flower Capital the destruction will be amplified by the explosives. To prevent this, Yamato climbs back onto the island. Rob Lucci contacts the lead CP0 agent[23] and the other members of CP0 on the island, who are planning their moves and inform Lucci of the second pink dragon that allied with Luffy. Lucci informs the agents that if the alliance wins the battle and Kaido falls, the World Government plans to seize the Land of Wano to make it a member state and that reinforcements are on the way. The agents then say the Beast Pirates numbers have been reduced to 12,000 while the alliance now has 8,000 members. Lucci also informs them of another target of interest: Nico Robin. Meanwhile, on the third floor, Brook and a now conscious Robin continue to evade Beast Pirates trying to capture Robin. As Momonosuke continues to struggle making flame clouds, Yamato makes it up to the island and transforms into her divine wolf beast form and runs inside. As he runs past the Heart Pirates, who have also arrived, Yamato maintains belief that Momonosuke will succeed. Sanji still refuses to use the Raid Suit as his battle with Queen intensifies as he uses Diable Jambe against Queen. Queen transforms into his brachiosaurus form before using his Brachiosnakeus: he detaches his head, neck and tail from his body making him resemble a snake. He then captures Sanji and constricts him, breaking his bones and crushing him as Armament Haki cannot protect someone's insides. Queen then activates the voice activated missile launcher equipped to his torso. However, Queen accidentally fires missiles at himself, freeing Sanji from his grasp. Strangely, Sanji gets up and finds that he was unharmed by Queen's attack. Although his bones are broken and dented, he is able to pound his body back into place. Queen, back in his Human-Beast Form, attempts to behead Sanji, only for the blade to shatter against Sanji's neck and cause him only minor pain. Sanji, to his horror, realizes that he may have genetic enhancements just like his siblings.

1054.title_eng: Death to Your Partner! Killer's Deadly Gamble!
1054.title_romanji: Aibō ni Shi o! Kirā Kesshi no Ōbakuchi
1054.title_jap: 相棒に死を！キラー決死の大博打
1054.summary: Killer continues his battle against Hawkins, but the battle is not in his favour. With his Devil Fruit abilities, total immunity from Killer's attacks, with the damage inflicted being redirected to Kid, Hawkins begins to mock Killer upon learning he ate a defective SMILE Fruit. Members of the Kid Pirates arrive to Killer's aid, but he forbids them from attacking Hawkins, telling them the situation. As Killer refuses to fight back, Hawkins decides to harm Kid himself. As he fights Big Mom, Kid head starts to feel severe pain, proving especially disadvantageous to Law, who struggles to fight and protect Kid. Kid's pain is caused by Hawkins repeatedly slamming his head into a pillar, redirecting the pain to Kid. Desperate, Killer offers his life in exchange for Kid's, but Hawkins refuses further claiming that all of Killer's suffering was caused by Kid's refusal to submit to Kaido before an offer to Killer to join the Beast Pirates if he surrenders. Killer refuses, calling Hawkins out for his own regret for not standing up to Kaido before declaring that Kid will become the King of the Pirates. This angers Hawkins, causing him to ruthlessly beat Killer. Killer gets back up and asks Hawkins what will happen if he takes damage that has nowhere to go. Then with a single attack, Killer slices off Hawkins' left arm. As Hawkins writhes in pain, questioning why the attack worked, Killer reminds him Kid already lost his left arm, meaning the damage had nowhere to be transferred to. Killer pulls the straw doll out of Hawkins' severed arm and destroys it, undoing the damage dealt to Kid's body. Hawkins no longer has any people left to redirect damage to and is now completely vulnerable to attacks. In a last-ditch effort, Hawkins uses his Strawman Cards. He reveals the "Death" card upright, summoning a giant straw monster, but Killer decapitates the monster, instantly destroying it. Hawkins draws a second card, only to find to his horror that he drew the "Tower" card. With this, Killer slices Hawkins with Spin & Sonic, defeating him and causing him to collapse. The narrator explains the "Tower" card is assigned two meanings: the death of the old and a new path. Sure enough, once Hawkins falls, Kid says he feels better now as Killer cheers him on.

1055.title_eng: A Shadowy Figure Pulls the Strings! Onigashima in Flames
1055.title_romanji: Yami no Mono no An'yaku! Onigashima Enjō
1055.title_jap: 闇の者の暗躍！鬼ヶ島炎上
1055.summary: After Queen's blade shatters upon contact with Sanji's neck, Sanji realizes that he may have scientific enhancements just like his siblings. As he starts to run away in a panic, Sanji theorizes that putting on the Raid Suit is what causing him to change Even when his enemies shoot him with firearms, he survives uninjured. Still, he denies his abilities due to contempt of his old family. Drake continues his battle against combatant Beast Pirates when he is confronted by Apoo who suggests that as both side would be heavyly injured after the battles over, they should form of an alliance to defeat the weakened victor. On Apoo's side are three Numbers: Inbi, the centaur-like Fuga and Zanki. Drake is uninterested by this offer, untrusting of Apoo. Nami, Usopp, Tama, her tamed Gifters and an injured Komachiyo try to escape the fire, but they come face-to-face with Kin'emon's lower body. His lower body can communicate though farts, but cannot hear others because his ears are on his other half. Nami traces the reverse crescent on his rear, allowing him to identify her as an ally and asks for aid. Usopp and Hamlet takes Kin'emon's leg and head to his location. On the third floor, Brook continues to escort Robin away, but are surrounded by Beast Pirates, who attempts to capture Robin, but Mink combatants come to her support. Unfortunately, they're confronted by the members of CP0, who're also after Robin. As Kin'emon upper body remains in the attic, he thinks that his survival from his defeat at Kaido's hands was due to his body not being reattached properly after it  been bifurcated by Law, while he hopes that aid will come soon for Kiku. Kanjuro reveals to have also survived his defeat and is in contact with Orochi. On Orochi's order, Kanjuro decides to give a "final performance" using his Devil Fruit ability. To symbolize the burning hatred of the Kurozumi Clan, he draws and creates a large ghost-like entity wreathed in flames, Kazenbo. The monster passes through walls and sets everything it touches on fire. Shortly after creating the monster, Kanjuro collapses, finally succumbing to his injuries. The Marys announce that the Skull Dome is now on fire. As Orochi eagerly anticipates his enemies to burn, Sanji continues his battle against Queen, Zoro battles fiercely against King outside, and Luffy and Kaido continue their combat on the roof of the Skull Dome.

1056.title_eng: A Countercharge! Law and Kid's Return-Attack Combination
1056.title_romanji: Gyakushū! Rō to Kiddo no Hangeki Dōmei
1056.title_jap: 逆襲！ローとキッドの反撃同盟
1056.summary: As Momonosuke attempts to create the flame clouds needed to stop Onigashima, Yamato runs to the armory to secure the explosives. Meanwhile, Law and Kid continue their battle against Big Mom, but their attacks are futile because of her homies. They both reveal to each other their "trump card": their awakened Devil Fruit powers. While they both admit that their awakened powers greatly drain their stamina, but Kid points out that they can't win if they don't go all out, before telling Law to follow his lead. Elsewhere, on Orochi's command, Kazenbo also heads towards the armory to ignite the explosives to destroy the island, while Orochi waits to escape with Fukurokuju's (who is still fighting Raizo) aid. Kid creates Punk Rotten to combat Big Mom, but she overpowers him and hit Kid with Ikoku, blasting him into the Performance Hall just as Yamato arrives. When Big Mom prepares to finish off Kid, Law seizes the opportunity and use his awakened powers. Law creates a miniature ROOM (K ROOM) and coats his sword with it before phasing it into Big Mom's neck, and unleashes Shock Wille, striking her with an electrical shock that also knocks out her homies. Kid follows up with his awakened powers, he makes Big Mom magnetic, causing metallic objects, including Napoleon, to fly towards her. Then, he use Punk Clash causing even the castle's pillars to be pulled in, causing them both buy and crush her under a mountain of metal. Although Big Mom was finally damaged for the first time in the battle, she survived the entire attack, now enraged. Using Soul Pocus, she steals the lifespans of the nearby Beast Pirates, using the souls to revive Napoleon, Phometeus and Hera, while also creating new homies. Then, she consumes an entire year's worth of her own lifespan in order to increase her size and power. Yamato, who carries on her mission, decides to take a detour through the Cave Chamber. Big Mom admits to Kid and Law that it has been decades since she last felt such pain, and like Luffy, they are serious about dethroning her. She then dares them to continue fighting, as she will show them what it means to be an emperor. Law confirms saying he wants to learn the true history, and Kid says that no matter the costs, he plans on taking her down.

1057.title_eng: For Luffy - Sanji and Zoro's Oath
1057.title_romanji: Rufi no Tame ni - Sanji to Zoro no Chikai
1057.title_jap: ルフィの為に サンジとゾロの誓い
1057.summary: Apoo tries to convince Drake to team up against Kaido after the emperor defeats Luffy, stating Kaido has never been so weakened before. However, Drake rejects his offer and attacks Apoo instead. The skirmish is interrupted by Yamato who is in a hurry to go to the armory and stop Onigashima from exploding, with Fuga (who seems to be on friendly terms with Yamato) chasing after her, Apoo (who now wants Yamato to ally with him) chasing after both of them and Drake chasing after Apoo. Elsewhere, CP0 agents have come to take Nico Robin. However, the Minks attack the agents as a distraction, allowing Brook and Robin to escape. Meanwhile, Sanji is fleeing from his fight against Queen after he noticed that his body had started mutating. As he fears of turning into a cold-blooded Germa soldier like his brothers, he fails to notice a lady calling to him for help and he only regains his senses when he sees the said lady on the floor bleeding and looking at him in terror. He rushes to help her, but she begs him not to come closer. The woman, Some, rushes to a nearby room where other geishas have been hiding. Sanji again offers to help Some, but the other women chastise him for hurting a defenseless woman, before driving him outside their hiding place where he finds Queen who had been looking for him. Shaken by the thought of possibly striking a woman, Sanji comes to the realization that his mutation was brought about by his use of his Raid Suit. He wonders if Luffy would rather have an unreliable crewmate who is helpless against women or a cruel and heartless warrior who is able to bring anybody's head when he's ordered. He ponders what the future King of Pirates needs and decides to destroy his Raid Suit. Using a Transponder Snail that he slip on him, Sanji calls Zoro, who is in the middle of his fight against King. Unsure if his mutation will change him for good, he asks the swordsman, once the battle is won, to kill him if he ever loses his humanity. Zoro gladly accepts and tells Sanji not to die before then. Shortly after, Sanji turns seemingly invisible and hits Queen with his Hell Memories attack.

1058.title_eng: The Onslaught of Kazenbo - Orochi's Evil Clutches Close in
1058.title_romanji: Kazenbō Shūrai - Semaru Orochi no Ma no Te
1058.title_jap: 火前坊襲来 迫るオロチの魔の手
1058.summary: An angered Big Mom promises to inflict unspeakable pain towards Law and Kid. She sics her homies on the two which they barely fend off, while at the same time Izo has Marco carry him to the inner castle Meanwhile, Kazenbo is wreaking havoc and burning everything on its path, causing both samurai and Beast Pirates all flee in a panic. Elsewhere, Brook and Robin are on the run with the CP0 hot on their tail, jumping down to a lower floor. Yamato is still charging her way towards the armory, with Apoo and Fuga following her and Drake chasing Apoo.   When Robin and Brook land in Fuga's hair CP0 tries to follow them but they're engulfed by Kazenbo as it falls from the ceiling. Not wasting time Yamato tells Fuga as she heads to the armory. In the Treasure Repository, Orochi listens with excitement to the chaos brought about by Kazenbo, which was created to exact vengeance in the name of the Kurozami Clan. Suddenly, he hears a shamisen playing nearby. He is drawn to the sound which reminds him of his beloved Komurasaki. Outside, a determined Momonosuke is frantically creating flame clouds to prevent Onigashima from crashing down onto the Flower Capital. Zoro and King are still in battle. In his pteranodon form, King grabs his crest and pulls his head back, which also pulls back his beak before letting go of his crest causing his head flings forward at extreme speed in an attack Zoro deems to be unblockable. He notices the flames on King's back, and wonders out loud if this is an ability from his Devil Fruit. King hears this and answers that it is not a feature of the Pteranodon. Zoro attacks with Black Rope Dragon Twister but King easily overcomes this. Zoro is at a loss at how durable King is, noting that it must be because of his dinosaur Devil Fruit. King, turning back into his human form, agrees but hints that it might also be because he is also a little unique. Zoro concludes that King's durability, wings, and flames are a feature of a tribe that is unknown to him. Zoro is knocked down and exhausted. All of a sudden, Zoro hears the sound of a shamisen which causes Enma to start draining his Haki and emaciate his arm. Inside, Orochi crawls towards the shamisen player and sees Komurasaki alive and well. He cries out in tears while she greets him with a smile.

1059.title_eng: Zoro Faces Adversity - A Monster! King the Wildfire
1059.title_romanji: Gyakkyō no Zoro - Kaibutsu! Kasai no Kingu
1059.title_jap: 逆境のゾロ 怪物！火災のキング
1059.summary: Kazenbo continues to make its way down to the Armory as the he Beast Pirates and samurai try in vain to stop its descent. Realizing that the flame spectre is moving through walls and that it will be reaching the Armory soon, Yamato urgently moves faster, enlisting the help of Fuga. Atop Fuga's head are Brook and Robin. Knowing that the CP0 are just behind the flames, they hop off and quickly put distance between them and the agents. The CP0, still in pursuit, are stopped when Apoo take their pictures to sell the photos to Morgans of the World Economy News Paper. One them of agents attacks Apoo before attacking Drake as well. Drake suggests that they team up to take down the CP0 agents and Apoo gladly accepts. Meanwhile, as Onigashima is inching closer towards the Flower Capital Momonosuke coutinues try to prevent the floating island from crashing, determined not to betray the promise he made to his friends and keep everyone safe. Inside, Hiyori (under her Komurasaki persona) plays her shamisen while Orochi watches tearfully. The sound of the shamisen causes Enma to drain Zoro's Haki. Seeing Zoro trying to stop Enma from fully draining him, King mocks how Zoro is having a falling out with his "friend." The two continue their clash, with King mockingly allows Zoro to stab him, only to cause a fiery explosion that leaves King unharmed. Elsewhere, Sanji continues fighting Queen, who expresses disappointment in not being able to see Sanji use his Raid Suit. Queen proceeds to provoke Sanji, calling him mentally weak for asking Zoro for emotional support. He tells Sanji that Zoro isn't any better and that he will not be able to defeat King since King is a Lunarian, a thought to be extinct race that could survive in any natural environment ane were once revered as gods. Sanji brushes this off, asking how "gods" managed to become extinct. Zoro is at a loss at how to defeat King. He attacks using his Death Lion Song, an attack he deems to be stronger than his previous attacks. However, this does not cause any damage to King. Zoro hears the shamisen and once again, Enma drains his Haki. Meanwhile, King attacks Zoro and lands a hit on him causeing him to let go of his swords. King notes that this is the first time he has ever seen a swordsman being held back by his own swords. Zoro falls and tries to retrieve his blades. He recalls the day he obtained Sandai Kitetsu, the cursed sword forged by Tenguyama Hitetsu. King attacks Zoro in midair which sends him crashing onto the side of the floating island. There, he finds Wado Ichimonji, the sword of Kuina, his childhood friend. In a flashback, Hitetsu explains that Enma and Wado Ichimonji were forged by the same person, the legendary swordsmith, Shimotsuki Kouzaburou. This is why Enma fits comfortably in Zoro's hand. These memories make Zoro question how a sword from the Land of Wano ended up in a remote region in the East Blue.

1060.title_eng: The Secret of Enma! The Cursed Sword Entrusted to Zoro
1060.title_romanji: Enma no Himitsu! Zoro ni Takusareshi Yōtō
1060.title_jap: 閻魔の秘密！ゾロに託されし妖刀
1060.summary: Zoro struggles against King as Emma constanyly drains his Haki. When he's thrown back inside, Zoro recalls how he learned of the battle cry, "Sunacchi" and how Momonosuke was prohibited from uttering such cry. He also recalls Hitetsu explaining that his two swords, Wado Ichimonji and Enma were both forged by the legendary swordsmith, Shimotsuki Kozuburo. Zoro then remembers how 13 years ago in his home village, an old man who was rumored to have been a samurai told the phrase "Sunacchi". The old man latter explained Zoro to that every sword had a personality and that it was a swordsman's job to tame them and that a "cursed sword" is a fine sword that was simply called as such because the weak feared it. The old man recalled the greatest sword that he forged that he dubbed "the great king of hell." Remembering all these, Zoro realizes that the aforementioned sword―the great king of hell―was none other than Enma.
