Outside, Momonosuke accidentally grasps Kaido's flame clouds and realizes that since he is also a dragon, he can also control and manipulate the cloud and proceeds to try and divert Onigashima's path. Inside the castle, the CP0 agents begin to overpower Drake and Apoo when Inbi and Zanki arrive. Meanwhile, Zoro remembers that he learned that the old was Kuina's grandfather after his death and that his village was founded by a pirate. It wasn't a coincidence that the village was named Shimotsuki. Hitetsu mentioned that Shimotsuki Kouzaburou, had left Wano more than fifty years ago. Zoro deduces that the old man and Kouzaburou are one and the same. He remembers Kouzaburou explaining that it is the sword that chooses its wielder. With that, Zoro understood that Enma chose him and was simply testing him. Zoro then recalls the night he and Kuina made their promise to become the world's strongest swordsman, her death and him taking her blade to keep their promise. Back to the present, as a group of Beast Pirates arrive to attack him, Zoro realizes that Enma was not draining him out of malice and admits that he was simply lacking thus unable to withstand the sword unlike Oden who had been using it with ease even though the sword took away so much of his Haki. Zoro tries to figure out how to control the flow of his Haki and keep it from being depleted and ultimately causing his death. Rather than fighting the sword's effects, he decides to let Enma take his Haki instead and "conquers" it, unleashing his Conqueror's Haki and rendering the nearby Beast Pirates unconscious. King notices and asks if he was trying to be a conquer. Remembering when he first met Luffy, Zoro answers by saying that he just remembered his promise to his captain and best friend.

1061.title_eng: The Strike of an Ifrit! Sanji vs. Queen
1061.title_romanji: Majin no Ichigeki! Sanji tai Kuīn
1061.title_jap: 魔神の一撃！サンジVSクイーン
1061.summary: Sanji continues his battle against Queen. After Sanji destroys his Raid Suit, Queen decides to continue on with the battle. This time, he demonstrates his scientific enhancements and uses techniques from Sanji's brothers to ovepower him. He reveals that he had a rivalry with Judge and his goal is to outperform Germa 66. Before he could slam Sanji into the ground, however, Sanji uses a Diable Jambe-infused kick to destroy Queen's mechanical arm. Some, the woman who Sanji accidentally attacked earlier, has her wounds bandaged and healed. However, the room where she and the other geishas were hiding are destroyed during the battle. The geishas decide to evacuate, but Some's pet mouse, Chuji, is missing, so Some stays behind to look for it. In fury, Queen uses Sanji's Stealth Black ability to become invisible to catch him off guard. However, Sanji uses moves at high speed, allowing him to become effectively invisible to Queen but physically taxing him. Queen plans to wait for him to exhaust himself, then strike him unexpectedly. Sanji perches on a wall looking for his next approach. Some follows Chuji dangerously into the battlefield, unaware of Queen's presence. Queen recognizes her; when he was searching for Sanji, he saw her and realized that her uses of sickness as an excuse to repeatedly turned him down were lies. Infuriated, he stuck her in anger while invisible when she encountered Sanji. Queen prepares to attack Some again, giving his position away to Sanji. Combining his exoskeleton with Armament Haki, Sanji coats his legs with hotter, blue flames, dubbing it as Ifrit Jambe. With added agility and greater kicking power along with the realization that Queen was the one who hurt Some he strikes Queen and follows up with a barrage of flaming kick, knocking him into the ground. Queen gets up, preparing his retaliation. Remembering his past and accepting the scientific advancements given to him by Germa 66, Sanji uses Boeuf Burst against Queen, sending a powerful flaming kick into Queen's stomach and defeating him. Queen's unconscious body is sent flying out of the Skull Dome and off Onigashima, falling into the mainland below. Emerging victorious from his battle, Sanji returns Chuji to Some then collapses from his injuries.

1062.title_eng: The Three-Sword Style of the Conqueror! Zoro vs. King
1062.title_romanji: Haō no Santōryū! Zoro tai Kingu
1062.title_jap: 覇王の三刀流！ゾロVSキング
1062.summary: With his swords now infused with both Armament and Conqueror's Haki, emanating the black lightning and a green smoke-like aura, Zoro with his newly dubbed King of Hell Three Sword Style, faces off King yet again. As they clash, Zoro lands manages to make King bleed and also rips up the Lead Performer's mask. Zoro finally figures out that King's durability and speed are directly linked to the flames on his back―that once the said flames go out, King's speed increases, but his defense gets weaker. A couple of Beast Pirates see King without his mask and observe that he has black wings, white hair, and brown skin. They say that he is of a race so rare that the World Government awards 100,000,000 Berries to those with information about their existence. King overhears this and burns them to death. King and Zoro continue their battle outside the Skull Dome. King finally acknowledges Zoro's strength and the danger he poses. Zoro accepts the compliment and vows to end Kaido's and the Beasts Pirates’ reign. King rebuffs this and declares that Kaido will be the King of the Pirates. Zoro rejects this declaration and attacks. King recalls the first time he met Kaido. Years ago both Kaido and King (who back then went by Alber) were both World Government test subjects on Punk Hazard until Kaido broke them out. King agreed to join the pirate crew Kaido was forming after he guaranteed that he would change the world. After noting how strong Alber was, Kaido gave him the name "King" and promised that he would never betray him and made him his right-hand man. Back in the present, King attacks with Imperial Flaming Wings, which sends a magma-like flame dragon onto Zoro but Zoro is able to counter and cut King. As the battle continues King sends a multitude of magma-like flame dragons onto Zoro. The flames try to engulf Zoro, but he cuts them down while he makes his way towards King. Zoro attacks with King of Hell, Three Sword Serpent: 103 Mercies Dragon Damnation and King, coating himself with a flame dragon, counters with his Extra Large Imperial Flaming Wings. As the clash sends a shockwave throughout Onigashima, Zoro emerge victorious. King's sword is broken, and his right wing is ripped apart. As King's consciousness fades as he falls to the mainland, he thinks of his captain. He had thought of Kaido as the prophesized Joy Boy. Thankful for the life Kaido gave to him, he asked his captain to remain the strongest. He also promised that he would never lose so that he can make Kaido the King of the Pirates. Meanwhile, Zoro, too, recalls his vow to become the world's greatest swordsman―a vow he made to Luffy, the man who he declared will become the King of the Pirates.

1063.title_eng: Luffy is on the Move! A Turning Point to a New Era!
1063.title_romanji: Rufi Yakudō! Shin Jidai no Bunkiten!
1063.title_jap: ルフィ躍動！新時代の分岐点！
1063.summary: Zoro loses consciousness after defeating King. A Mary announces King's loss to a CP0 agent who now assesses the situation to be dire as all of the Beast Pirates’ Lead Performer and Tobi Roppo members have lost, noting that only Big Mom and Kaido stand in the way of the Straw Hats’ victory. Kaido and Luffy's battle is reaching its climax as Momonosuke, now able to control Kaido's Flame Clouds, tries to pull Onigashima away to safety. Kazenbo, a flame specter, is continuing to make its way to the basement with the purpose of making Onigashima explode midair. Yamato, determined to prevent this from happening, finally reaches the door to the basement armory. With the help of Fuga, the doors are opened and Yamato rushes through as Fuga keeps the guard, Numbers member, Rokki, at bay. Meanwhile, Usopp finds the injured Kin’emon and Kiku but the Beast Pirates arrive capture them and Usopp tries to fight back. The two samurai ask him to leave them behind, but Usopp chides them for their so-called honor and tells them to hold on to life instead. A few moments later, Izo arrives to stave off the pursuers while Usopp, Kin’emon and Kiku escape on Hamlet's back. On the third floor of the Skull Dome, Fukurokuju and Raizo are in a stand-off as the two cast Ninpo: Paralysis Jutsu at the same time. Neither of them budges even though the whole floor is being engulfed in flames and Raizo catches on fire. On the second floor, Komurasaki continues to play her shamisen as Orochi listens on. He asks Komurasaki to play his favorite piece and Komurasaki indulges him. Meanwhile, Drake and Apoo are defeated by the CP0. Drake and Zanki are knocked out and Apoo and Inbi run away. The agents are apprised of the defeat of the Lead Performers and are ordered to leave Onigashima. On the rooftop, Luffy and Kaido continue their final fight, with both of them enjoying themselves.

1064.title_eng: Drunken Dragon Bagua! The Lawless Dragon Closing in on Luffy
1064.title_romanji: Shuron Hakke! Rufi ni Semaru Muhō no Ryū
1064.title_jap: 酒龍八卦！ルフィに迫る無法の龍
1064.summary: While the final battle between Luffy and Kaido is taking place at the rooftop of the Skull Dome, Momonosuke is desperate to steer Onigashima away from the Flower Capital where its citizens are oblivious to the catastrophe that could befall them. In the Flower Capital, the people are drinking their fill and dancing to the music. They send lanterns to the sky, with their wishes written on them so that they may reach heaven. In hers, Toko writes that she wants to see her father again, which breaks Hitetsu's heart. Back at the rooftop, Kaido starts drinking, much to Luffy's annoyment. Kaido, now drunk, uses his Drunken Dragon Bagua fighting style, making his movements become more unpredictable and his Haki stronger while switching rapidly between his Zoan forms, during which Kaido reveals a bulkier, dark blue version of his Human-Beast Form. Enduring Kaido drunken assault, Luffy continues to retaliate and finally lands a kick to his stomach which causes Kaidou to cough up blood. Meanwhile, in Mary Geoise, the Five Elders complain how this year's Levely is cursed. They mention that it resulted in the total abolition of the Seven Warlords of the Sea, an incident concerning the Arabasta Kingdom, and the Revolutionary Army's infiltration of Mary Geoise. The blond elder says that they need to set those aside for now and immediately deal with what is happening in the Land of Wano. He is expectant that the CP0 have captured Nico Robin by now, and says they should use Big Mom and Kaido as an excuse to wipe out their "inconveniences". He mentions of the need to erase the existence of a certain Devil Fruit. Another elder rebuffs its existence, saying that the said fruit is a mere legend even to them as it has not awakened for centuries. However, the blond elder says that the World Government would not have bothered giving that Devil Fruit another name if they did not want to hide its name from history. At the seas just outside of Wano, a fleet of Marine Ships are on standby awaiting orders as they spot Zunesha approaching the country.

1065.title_eng: The Destruction of the Alliance?! Fire up, the Will of the New Generation!
1065.title_romanji: Dōmei Kaimetsu!? Moero Shin Sedai no Ishi!
1065.title_jap: 同盟壊滅!? 燃えろ新世代の意志！
1065.summary: On the third floor, Raizo and Fukurokuju remain at a standstill with neither one of them releasing their Paralysis Jutsu despite both catching on fire. On the second floor, Jinbe helps some samurai escape by preventing them from being crushed by fallen debris and pointing out a route to their escape. On the Performance Floor, Chopper returns to his normal form and is now able to move, though he worries for Zoro whom he knows will be suffering twice as much once the special medicine he was given wears off. Outside, Zoro is slowly bleeding out and begins to see the Grim Reaper approach him. Meanwhile, at the Right-Brain Tower, Franky searches for Zoro. Elsewhere, Izo is finishing off the last of the Beasts Pirates but is weakened and stabbed in the stomach by a pirate who he shoots to death. He staggers away, his way out of the castle, he hopes that Kin’emon and Kiku have escaped successfully. He comes across the CP0 agents who were after Robin. The agents make an offer to each other as they had no intention of going after the last remnants of the Whitebeard Pirates since their business right now is with the Straw Hats. Instead of letting them go, however, Izo tells them to stop. Yamato has finally reached the armory where the bombs are located just as Kazenbo does, preparing to set fire to the explosives therein. Yamato briefly transforms and freezes everything inside. She then swings at the flame specter, determined to stop it from fulfilling the command given to it by Kanjuro and Orochi. It proceeds to engulf Yamato in flames, with the latter screaming in pain. Back at the Performance Floor, Big Mom continues to wreak havoc with her lightning attacks, knocking back Law and Kid. She remembers that Kaido is on the rooftop fighting Luffy and wonders why she still has not heard the emperor's shout of victory. She commands Hera to take her to the rooftop, but Law stops her with K-ROOM. He impales her with his sword and uses Shock Wille, causing her to fall. Kid then use his Punk Corna Dio to create a metallic bull bigger than Bog Mom and proceeds to charge at her with it into a building. As Kid and Law prepare to fight her once again, they vow that they will never let her go to the rooftop even if it means their death.

1066.title_eng: Here Comes Main Act! Powerful Techniques of Shockwave and Magnetism
1066.title_romanji: Ōtori Kitaru! Hadō to Jiki no Ōwaza
1066.title_jap: 大トリ来る！波動と磁気の大技
1066.summary: As Momonosuke continues to pull Onigashima away from the Flower Capital, he is momentarily distracted when he suddenly hears someone calling out to him. At the Performance Floor, Big Mom knocked down by Kid's Corna Dio leaving her right arm shattered. With her ribs also broken from Law's shockwaves, Big Mom uses her Devil Fruit powers to heal her arm by giving her bones life and having them repair themselves. Seeing Big Mom unleash her Conqueror's Haki, Law tells Kid that he will be out of energy in the next barrage. Before he can ask Kid to coordinate their attacks, Kid demands not to tell him what to do. Big Mom combines her homies into a Maser Saber which cuts Kid's metallic bull in half. Kid uses Assign on Big Mom, magnetizing her and the tower behind her. She is flung towards its wall, unable to escape. Kid's metallic bull is launched towards her, so she tears the wall down and uses it to shield herself from Kid's attack. Kid proceeds to attack her legs, causing her to fall to her knees. Kid and Law bombard her with attacks and manage to damage her bit by bit. She is seemingly unable to keep up with the assault but finally shields herself and counters, sending the two Supernovas flying. The emperor then uses Mother's Visit Cannon: 3,000 Leagues of Misery to fuse Napoleon, Prometheus, and Hera into a giant phantom-like homie composed of flames and lightning, Misery. The homie appears before Kid and immediately lunges to attack him. Her continuous onslaught kills those who are nearby and Kid's crew can only watch as their captain takes a beating. Law suddenly uses Takt and sends a nearby tower to crush Big Mom. knocking her on her back. Law then coats his sword with K-ROOM again and stabs her through the chest, extending his blade longer as it pierces straight through the floating island and all the way down to Wano's surface, which Yamato observes. Big Mom starts pummeling Law to force him to release her, but he holds on and drives his sword even deeper, despite his crew begging to lo let go. Once long enough, Law uses Puncture Wille, unleashing a shockwave causing Big Mom to howl in pain as his attack makes a hole both in the island and on Wano, which even Momonosuke sees. Big Mom almost falls into the hole but manages to grab on. Big Mom has Misery aim its attention at Law, but Law shouts to Kid to "do it.  Kid appears in the air with a railgun made of the scrap metal as he readies to attack. Big Mom eggs him on, saying that it will not be enough to take her down, but Kid uses his Damned Punk to fire a huge blast of energy at Big Mom that hits her right in the chest, as Law declares her era is over.

1067.title_eng: To the New Era! Settled! The Determination of the Brats
1067.title_romanji: Shin Jidai e! Ketchaku! Gaki-domo no Kakugo
1067.title_jap: 新時代へ！決着！ガキ共の覚悟
1067.summary: The standoff between Raizo and Fukurokuju continues as Raizo is ablaze and Fukurokuju is eventually completely set alight. Unable to withstand the heat of the flames, he collapses and screams for water. Meanwhile, Big Mom is cornered by Kid and Law, as Kid's Damned Punk attempts to knock her into the hole. As a last-ditch effort, she uses Soul Pocus and attempts to take fifty years from their lifespans, effectively killing them. However, as neither Kid nor Law feared her, the attack is rendered ineffective. Using his ability, Law creates an R-ROOM, a Room which attaches to her regardless of where she moves. As a homage to his benefactor, Rosinante, he uses Silent, preventing Big Mom from making any sound as long as she remains inside the Room. Misery attempts to aid Big Mom by attacking Law from behind, but Law uses his sword to slice her in half as Kid uses a second Damned Punk, sending an even stronger ray which finally sends Big Mom falling into the hole. When Big Mom falls and lands in the armory, she grabs one of the frozen bombs, unaware that they were explosive. The bomb explodes, blasting a second hole in the bottom of the island causing her to fall towards the Wano's mainland. Yamato is able to block the explosion with a frozen piece of debris, preventing the other bombs from detonating. However, the explosion considerably damaged Kazenbo, causing it to retreat towards Orochi. The explosion causes the entire island to crumble. A wounded Zoro, who was resting on the edge of the island, falls off the island as a result of the island crumbling. Big Mom is sent falling towards the ground. She notices the Fire Festival celebrations at the nearby Flower Capital, prompting her to reflect on her childhood with Carmel, her failure to defeat Luffy on Whole Cake Island, and finally her involvement in the raid. She curses Gol D. Roger for starting the Golden Age of Piracy, posthumously promoting the proliferation of new, inexperienced rookie pirates. Big Mom falls into the magma chamber, causing a large eruption of lava. Witnessing the fall of one of the Four Emperors, Kid and Law's crewmates cheer over the captains' accomplishment as the two rest from their epic fight with Big Mom and leaving in Luffy's hands to defeat Kaido. As Momonosuke continues to move Onigashima, Yamato approaches him through a hole caused by the explosion. Momonosuke tells Yamato thet he senses that Zunesha had appeared near the island. He also tells him that Zunesha was a companion of Joy Boy who committed a crime eight centuries ago.

1068.title_eng: Moon Princess Echoes! The Final Phase of the Land of Wano!
1068.title_romanji: Tsukihime ga Hibiku! Wano Kuni Saishū Kyokumen!
1068.title_jap: 月姫が響く！ワノ国最終局面！
1068.summary: Zunesha appears at Onigashima to aid the battle, but Momonosuke is unsure of whether to continue the battle. He explains to Yamato that it may not have been Oden's intention to liberate the Land of Wano if it endangered innocent lives. Onigashima begins to crumble as a result of the explosion, as well as the battle on the Skull Dome. Meanwhile, Franky saves Zoro from falling off the edge of the island, pulling him back onto the island with his extendable arm. Izo confronts the CP0 agents refusing to let them pass. After a short battle, Izou was quickly overpowered. However, as the agent, Maha, fatally strike Izo in the chest, Izo manages to shoot him down with his pistol, causing them to simultaneously take each other down. The lead agent briefly laments Maha's downfall. He then continues his search for Nico Robin, but he receives an imperial order from the Five Elders. Nami's group, accompanied Kid and Law's crew members, celebrate their victory against Big Mom and rest. The lead agent is ordered to interrupt Luffy's battle with Kaido and eliminate him immediately as a precaution as he's seen as an especially dangerous threat. The lead agent reluctantly obeys the order, but he is unaware that Drake has regain consciousness behind him. Komurasaki accompanies Orochi in his private chamber as he awaits Fukurokuju's return. Orochi becomes impatient and frustrated, but the ceiling suddenly collapses, crushing him under the rubble. Pressing her advantage, Komurasaki inserts a Seastone nail into Orochi's body, weakening him and preventing him from using his Devil Fruit powers. She plays Orochi's favourite song, "Moon Princess" on her shamisen and reveals that the song was also the favourite of her father, Oden and that she wears a mask so she could avoid smiling for him while playing it. In the Performance Hall, Kaid and Law acknowledge that their too exhausted to fight Kaidou, leaving it all truly up to Luffy on the Skull Dome, Kaidou notices that Big Mom had been defeated by Kid and Law, and begins to mourn her, reflecting on how they met while serving Rocks's crew. Luffy takes advantage of Kaidou's emotional state and transforms into his Fourth Gear: Snakeman, declaring it his final Fourth Gear. Luffy uses Gum-Gum Hydra to unleash a barrage of omni-directional punches at Kaido, declaring he won't stop attacking until he defeats him.

1069.title_eng: There is Only One Winner - Luffy vs. Kaido
1069.title_romanji: Shōsha wa Hitori - Rufi tai Kaidō
1069.title_jap: 勝者はひとり ルフィVSカイドウ
1069.summary: In the connected hallway, Fukurokuju completely catches fire and collapses to the flames. Raizo makes his final remarks to him before he succumbs to his injuries. Jinbe appears and extinguishes the flames using Fish-Man Karate before coming to Raizo's aid. When Jinbe refuses to let him return to battle, Raizo asks him for a favor. Meanwhile, the lead CP0 agent is ambushed by Drake before he could advance to the rooftop, being impaled by Drake's sword. However, the agent retaliates, striking down Drake with a single Finger Pistol. He then proceeds to follow his order, proceeding to the rooftop. In the Flower Capital the citizens prepare to send up the lanterns. On the rooftop, Luffy continues to hit Kaido with his barrage of direction-changing punches, with the Emperor questioning how rubber is capable of such a thing. Kaido, revealing he has advance Observation Haki, transforms into his dragon form and avoids Luffy's attacks before retaliating. He swallows Luffy before spiting him out in the air, and striking him with a Blast Breath, sending him crashing through Onigashima. Luffy manages to escape the flames by transforming into his Bounceman form. Knowing he doesn't have much time left in Fourth Gear, Luffy flies back up to the roof the Skull Dome's roof. He yells to Kaido that the people of Wano will continue to starve and go thirsty as long as he remains just as he prepares King Kong Gun infused with advance Conqueror's Haki (Gum-Gum Over Kong Gun). As for Kaido, he tells Luffy that while it is his business who he teams up with, he personally considers the people of Wano weak and used to defeat, citing the samurai as "losers" who would willingly die for the sake of "honor". Luffy retorts that the samurai are strong, but Kaido rejects this notion as he prepares another Blast Breath, but Luffy fires his attack first causing Kaidou to misfire in his mouth and crash to the ground. Luffy charges at him again but Kaido quickly gets back up and in his bulky Human-Beast Form, hits Luffy with Thunder Bellow Bagua, causing Luffy to crash. Luffy manages to maintain Fourth Gear as he and Kaido decide to settle it with the next attack. Both charge at each other once again with Gum-Gum Over Kong Gun and Thunder Bellow Bagua, but the lead CP0 agent arrives and grabs Luffy's arm to hold him back. Though Kaido sees the agent too, he is unable to stop himself from striking Luffy while the agent steps back, causing Kaido to flashback to when Oden was distracted by Kurozumi Higurashi during their fight, as a look of much horror is shown in his eyes.

1070.title_eng: Luffy is Defeated?! The Determination of Those Left Behind
1070.title_romanji: Rufi Haiboku!? Nokosareta Mono no Kakugo
1070.title_jap: ルフィ敗北!? 残された者の覚悟
1070.summary: Taking a critical strike from Kaido's kanabo, Luffy is defeated, deflating out of his Fourth Gear and collapses to the verge of death. Unhappy with being given an unfair advantage, Kaido directs his rage at the lead CP0 agent for intervening in the battle. The agent accepts Kaido's rage as he is killed. Transforming into his dragon form, Kaido returns to the Performance Floor, declares victory against Luffy, and demands the alliance's unconditional surrender. While those like Chopper and Tama cry for the loss of Luffy, Nami refuses to believe Kaido's words, even revealing herself to him to say so. He fires a Blast Breath at her but Marco blocks it while yelling for everyone not to give up until it is over. He declares his intentions to continue the New Onigashima Project, moving Onigashima to the Flower Capital and subjecting the remaining citizens of the Land of Wano to forced labour. His words cause the samurai's morale to waver as he once demands Momonosuke presents himself,  while the Beasts Pirates decide to take out Law and Kid only to be held back by their respective crews. Carrot and Cat Viper decide to rejoin the fight, while Kid and Law force themselves to stand back up as opposed to letting Kaido kill them both. As for Momonosuke, he decides that surrendering might be the best option for everyone if Luffy cannot beat him anymore, but Yamato retorts that even if surrendering may save everyone present, eventually they will all die from exhaustion as Kaidou's slaves, and because of that, he will not stop fighting, even claiming that Kaidou is at his limit too. He also reminds Momonosuke that this battle carries 20 years worth of weight on the people of Wano, so with that, he would rather die with him than surrender. Momonosuke accepts his words, and the battle rages on, with him stopping pulling the island away to join in the fight. On the rooftop, Luffy's unconscious body suddenly regains a heartbeat, which takes on the rhythm of drums. Hearing this, Zunesha speaks to Momonosuke and tells him that it can hear the "Drums of Liberation" for the first time in 800 years, and proclaims that Joy Boy has returned, just as Luffy's body undergoes a mysterious transformation that revives him.

1071.title_romanji: Rufi no Saikō Chiten - Tōtatsu!〝Gia Fifusu〟
1071.title_jap: ルフィの最高地点 到達！〝ギア5〟
1071.summary: Zunesha reveals to Momonosuke and Yamato that Joy Boy has returned. On the top of the Skull Dome, Luffy finally revives after finish his transformation, having fully awakened his Devil Fruit true power. His hair becomes flame-like and white as does his clothes (save for his straw hat, sandals and sash around his waste), while his eyebrows become swirled and billowing and his irises turn pink with a scarf of clods floating above his shoulders as the ground he walks becomes like rubber as he becomes incredibly joyful. The transformation alerts the others who're overjoyed and Nami and Tama in happy of joy that Luffy is still alive. Meanwhile, the Five Elders at Mariejois discuss having sacrificed one of their top agents in an attempt to stop Luffy. Being particularly concerned with the potency of the Gum-Gum Fruit, the World Government had been trying for 800 years to attain it, but to no avail, almost as if the fruit were evading them. One of the Elders mentions Zoan Fruits can have wills of their own as it's revealed that Gum-Gum Fruit's true identidy is actually the Mythical Zoan Devil Fruit called Human-Human Fruit, Model: Nika. The user upon awakening their fruit, transforms into the legendary "Sun God" Nika, having the power and freedom only limited by the user's imagination, as they declare the Devil Fruit to be the most ridiculously powerful thing in the world. Meanwhile, in the treasure repository, Orochi attempts to cajole Hiyori into removing his Seastone nail and setting him free. However, following his numerous betrayals and wrongdoings against Kouzuki Oden and the people of Wano Country during his reign, Hiyori angrily refuses. Kazenbo, who had been reduced to a small wisp by the armory explosion, appears, returning to its master. Orochi commands Kazenbo to burn Hiyori alive. However, Kazenbo does not listen, instead setting Orochi aflame as he remains trapped under the rubble. On the rooftop, Luffy says he can keep fighting longer now, and declares his new form to be his peak, dubbing it "Fifth Gear". Having fully recovered, Luffy emits extremely powerful Conqueror's Haki, which reaches the Beasts Pirates on the Performance Floor below. He grabs Kaido's dragon body and drags it back above the rooftop, beating him upon the rooftop with little resistance using. Kaido fires a Blast Breath at Luffy, but Luffy blocks the fireball by pulling up on the ground. The fireball bounces off the wall and strikes Kaido. Despite being unable to hit Luffy, Kaido expresses relief that Luffy was alive, apologizing for CP0 sabotaging their fight. Luffy accepts his apology and prepares to finish his final fight with him.

1072.title_eng: The Ridiculous Power! Fifth Gear in Full Play
1072.title_romanji: Fuzaketa Nōryoku! Yakudō Suru Gia Fifusu
1072.title_jap: ふざけた能力！躍動するギア5
1072.summary: With their final battle now resumed, Kaido states that he was sure Luffy had died, to which the latter agrees. Kaido correctly deduces that Luffy had awakened his Paramecia Power as he can transform his surroundings into rubber, but is confused as his transformation is more akin to a Zoan. In his dragon form, he attempts to swallow Luffy whole, but Luffy beats him from his insides, inflates himself inside his belly, and forcefully launches himself out of his mouth by stretching his hands through his eyes. Luffy then grows himself to the size of a giant and starts to use Kaido as a jump rope. Kaido then attempts to strike Luffy with a Blast Breath, sending him off the island, but Luffy is completely unaffected by the attack. Luffy uses in-universe cartoon physics to run on air back to Onigashima. At this point, Yamato and Momonosuke travel to the rooftop to investigate the strange battle, discovering Luffy's awakened form. Kaido, transforms into his Human-Beast Form and strikes Luffy with his kanabō, smashing his head into the rooftop and causing the alliance on the Live Floor below to witness Luffy's awakened form, as Nami, Tama, Chopper, even Law and Kid were shocked seeing the giant head, with Marco surprisingly curious about Luffy's appearance. As Luffy returns to normal size, he and Kaido briefly collapse, both too tired to continue to battle. Kaido assures him that he can die, and someone will share the story of his fight, but Luffy refuses to die once again, stating that all that is left after dying is bones. As he prepares to reactivate Fifth Gear, Luffy reminds himself of several people he has made promises to or is indebted to, such as Momonosuke, Tama, Kin'emon, and Pedro. As the battle continues, Kaido becomes more confused by Luffy's powers. Luffy punches Kaidou which stretches though Kaido's head, launching him into a rock wall. As he gets back up Kaido asks who he is and Luffy proclaims his name and declares himself as the man who will surpass him and become the King of the Pirates.

1073.title_eng: No Way Out! A Hellish Scene on Onigashima
1073.title_romanji: Nigeba Nashi! Jigoku Ezu no Onigashima
1073.title_jap: 逃げ場なし！地獄絵図の鬼ヶ島
1073.summary: Kaido tells Luffy that Devil Fruit Awakening occurs when one's mind and body catch up to their powers. Kaido laments the damage his crew had taken during the raid, having lost all his top officers and having his castle destroyed by battle. He continues his battle with Luffy on the Skull Dome, and as Luffy launches himself into the air as he gets an idea. Below inside the Skull Dome, the allied forces are separated and cornered by the spreading fires. Chopper reunites with Nami and Tama but fail to locate any other allies or combat the fires. Brook, Robin, Apoo, and Inbi are trapped in the basement, Sanji and the other women are cornered in the left brain tower, Usopp's group, Franky and Zoro are also trapped in the corridors, and Mink forces are trapped on the third floor. On the fourth floor, Raizo and Jinbe carry out a plan to extinguish the flames, with Raizo having been prepared for such a situation since Oden Castle was set on fire. Using his Devil Fruit ability, Raizo summons a scroll producing vast quantities of water he gathered from Zou's Rain-Ruption. Then, using a Fish-Man Jujutsu technique, Jinbe controls the water flow and floods all parts of the Skull Dome, extinguishing the flames and saving the allied forces below. However, outside Onigashima, Yamato pressures Momonosuke to create Flame Clouds to support the island. As Kaido's power is rapidly declining, the Flame Clouds he created are weakening and about to collapse. Momonosuke needs to create his own Flame Clouds before this happens, or Onigashima will fall and crash into the mainland. Luffy then appears in front of Kaido, holding a lightning bolt.

1074.title_eng: I Trust Momo - Luffy's Final Powerful Technique!
1074.title_romanji: Momo o Shinjiru - Rufi Saigo no Ōwaza!
1074.title_jap: モモを信じる ルフィ最後の大技！
1074.summary: Momonosuke struggles and fails to produce Flame Clouds to sustain Onigashima. He begins to doubt himself, but he remembers his final interaction with his mother, he regains his resolve. However, an explosion cause Onigashima to fall faster. On the Skull Dome's rooftop, Luffy continues his final battle against Kaido, where he utilizes the clouds and lightning, manipulating and merging with the lightning bolts to strike Kaido. Despite several powerful attacks being levied against him, Kaidou unleashes a series of powerful counterattacks, with Kaido claiming that no matter the Devil Fruit ability Haki trumps all, as neither Roger nor Oden ate a Devil Fruit as strikes Luffy with Destroyer of Death Thunder Bagua, sending Luffy into the sky. As the Fire Festival concludes in the Flower Capital below, Luffy grabs on to Kaido, who changes into his dragon form and sends a barrage of wind blades towards Luffy, before blasting him with fire. Meanwhile, after a tremor removes his Seastone nail, Orochi is now able to transform into his Yamata no Orochi form, though he only has one head remaining. He threatens to kill Hiyori for her to take her down with him. Inside the Skull Dome below, the remaining allied forces realize that if Luffy wins the final battle, Onigashima would still crash, killing them. Willing to sacrifice their lives to remove Kaidou from power, the allies cheer on Luffy and hope for his victory against Kaido. Hearing the cheering from the Skull Dome and the wishes hope of Wano's citizens, Luffy prepares a final most powerful technique against Kaido, inflating his fist to a size as large as Onigashima itself. Preparing to fulfill his promise of liberating the Land of Wano once and for all, Luffy tells Momonosuke to move Onigashima out of the way, stating he trusts him.

1075.title_eng: 20 Years Worth of Prayers! Take Back the Land of Wano
1075.title_romanji: Nijū-nen no Inori! Wano Kuni o Torimodose
1075.title_jap: 二十年の祈り！ワノ国を取り戻せ
1075.summary: Momonosuke is tasked with moving Onigashima out of the way of Luffy's final technique. However, he feels he is unable to move the island in time. Kaido uses his Flame Dragon Torch to cover himself in flames to form a gigantic dragon as large as Luffy's compressed fist, made of fire so hot that its tail melts through the Skull Dome's remaining horn. Luffy decides he will need to utilize Ryuo to defeat him without touching him. Kaido then performs his Rising Dragon: Flame Bagua while Luffy uses his Gum-Gum Bajrang Gun, as the two final most powerful attacks collide head-on. In the Skull Dome below, as the light from the final clash can see, memories of Wano's suffering are seen. Orochi usurped the throne through force with Kaido's help, forcing the citizens of the Land of Wano into harsh labor. During Orochi's reign, civilians fell into poverty and struggled to feed themselves, being forced to eat defective SMILE Fruits or drink polluted water to survive. Meanwhile, Orochi prepares to kill Hiyori in his Yamata no Orochi form. However, Denjiro arrives to her aid, beheading Orochi for the last time and severing his last head. Denjiro comforts Hiyori as citizens at the Fire Festival write on Sky Ships their wishes to remove Orochi from power. Remembering his family, Momonosuke regains the determination to move Onigashima. As allied combatants pray for Luffy's victory against Kaido, the two pirates continue their final clash.

1076.summary: As he clashes with Luffy, Kaido's past is revealed. Being raised in Vodka Kingdom, a kingdom forced to steal from other nations to afford membership in the World Government, he entered the army and became its strongest asset at the age of ten. However, his king sold him against his will to the Marines in order to be able to attend the Levely. Kaido attacked the Marine battleship carrying him, becoming wanted by the World Government. Becoming a wanted fugitive, he would allow himself to get captured by authorities' multiple times, eat the food on the battleships, then escape with ease each time. Eventually, at age 15 he was invited by Whitebeard into the Rocks Pirates, further contributing to the crew's feared reputation. However, the Rocks Pirates faced a defeat in God Valley at the hands of Garp, killing Rocks and dismantling the crew. Kaidou formed his own crew, the Beast Pirates, and 10 years after Rocks' death formed a coalition with the Kurozumi Family to occupy the Land of Wano. The Beasts Pirates sought to abolish the World Government's nobility system and create a world where prestige was determined by war. Later, he confides to King that he overheard Yamato mentioning "Joy Boy," and if he is the person King is waiting for, then he knows exactly who he is. In the present day, as the last CP0 agent flees the island, the allied forces in the Skull Dome work together to survive the flood created by Raizo. In the Treasure Repository, Denjiro commends Hiyori for enduring her suffering for so long for this moment, which brings her to tears. Meanwhile, with increased determination, Momonosuke successfully creates his own Flame Clouds, using them to move Onigashima away from the Flower Capital. In one final clash, Kaido asks Luffy what world he wanted to create. Luffy responds by claiming he would create a world where his friends could smile and eat their fill every day. He breaks through Kaido's flame coating, then strikes him with an island-size Ryuo-infused punch to the face, sending him falling below. Luffy floats victorious as wishes of salvation from Wano's citizens rise up around him. As his unconscious body falls into an abyss, his left horn broken off, Kaido remembers a previous conversation he had with King, where he claimed that Joy Boy himself would be the one who would defeat him. Having succeeded in their tasks, Luffy and Momonosuke both collapse from exhaustion.

1077.title_eng: The Curtain Falls! The Winner, Straw Hat Luffy!
1077.title_jap: 幕引き！勝者 麦わらのルフィ！
1077.summary: As Luffy falls asleep after using his final technique and Yamato catches him, Onigashima lands safely near the Flower Capital. With the Raid on Onigashima ending in Kaido's defeat, Cat Viper declares the prophecy fulfilled and Oden avenged. Allied forces in the Skull Dome celebrate their victory, Chopper and Miyagi tend to their wounds, and Yamato pressures remaining Beasts Pirates to forfeit. Momonosuke states to Zunesha that he will not open borders of the Land of Wano, instead personally protecting it from external threat. In the Flower Capital, right before the lanters were sent up, Tenguyama explains to Toko that Yasuie allowed himself to be captured despite knowing he'd be killed in order to give Wano another chance, otherwise the alliance wouldn't have been able to fight this day and hopefully give Toko a better life. Toko remembers how when she was desperately starving she ate a SMILE fruit and suffered from its permanent effects, Yasuie decided to eat the fruit as well so she would not have to suffer alone. In honor of her father's sacrifices to make the raid possible, Toko edits her Sky Ship to thank Yasuie. Refusing to believe they lost, The Beasts Pirate attempted to continue the battle, only for Yamato to reveal that it was thanks to Momonosuke that she carefully placed Onigashima away from the Flower Capital and threaten to beat them if they do not stop. An unconscious Kaido reverts into his human form as he falls underground. Falling into the same magma chamber as Big Mom, the impact triggers a volcanic eruption, filling the sky with ash. Momonosuke return to the Flower Capital to calm the panicked townspeople, as well as announce their victory over Kaido. He changes back to his human form as several other people appear from the smoke, among them Hiyori in her "Komurasaki" guise, which surprises everyone as they all thought she was dead, and then Denjiro, who everyone still thinks is "Kyoshiro." Denjiro tells everyone that the story is long, but he first wants everyone to meet Wano's new shogun.

1078.title_eng: He Returns! The Shogun of the Land of Wano, Kozuki Momonosuke
1078.title_romanji: Kikan! Wano Kuni Shōgun - Kōzuki Momonosuke
1078.title_jap: 帰還！ワノ国将軍 光月モモの助
1078.summary: In the Flower Capital, Kyoshiro, revealing himself to be Denjiro, announces the return of the Akazya Nine, as the citizens begin to broadcast the news to the other regions of the country. In the Skull Dome, as Chopper continues to tend to the wounded combatants, Yamato introduces herself to the Straw Hat Pirates as Kaido's son and asks to join the crew. Despite generally being in favor of admitting him, they choose not to act without Luffy's permission. When some Beast Pirates try to sneak away, they're stop by Yamato and a pair of Gifters. When Usopp asks what'll happen to the Gifters Tama reveals that her powers only last for a month, though some animals stay tamed. Speed confirms this saying she wants to remain by Tama's side, which she happily accepts, though she asks rather than be her servant her to become adoptive mother, to which she agrees. In his human form, Momonosuke announces his victory in Onigashima and the defeat of the Kaido and Orochi. Momonosuke declares his intentions to abolish slavery and end the mass poverty and pollution caused by Orochi's reign. As he speaks, Tama remembers her childhood. Following her parents' tragic deaths, Tama was left an orphan with Komachiyo. She was forced to sell hats to survive, often without success and going hungry. She was adopted by Tenguyama, who told her about the prophecy of the Kouzuki Family's return. The townspeople celebrate the return of the Kouzuki Family, and Momonosuke vows to follow his father's footsteps.

1079.title_eng: The Morning Comes! Luffy and the Others Rest!
1079.title_romanji: Asa ga Kita! Rufi-tachi no Kyūsoku!
1079.title_jap: 朝が来た！ルフィ達の休息！
1079.summary: In Mary Geoise, the Five Elders learn of the defeat of two Emperors, as well as the liberation of the Land of Wano. They recognize the return of Nika in the form of Luffy. They also discuss that Zunesha had left departed from Wano and that since the country's borders are still closed they can't invade it. They order a remaining CP0 agent to capture Robin, but their Tansponder Snail transmission is hijacked. Drake and Hawkins, both gravely injured during the raid, have a brief conversation. Hawkins asks Drake if he's a Marine, but he refuses to answer. Hawkins reveals he foresaw Kaido's defeat, but was too prideful to turn back to Kid after betraying him the first time.  He then admits that the man he foresaw having a 1% chance of surviving throughout the raid was himself, before he collapses. A week after the raid, morning arrives in the Land of Wano and its citizens continue to celebrate their liberation from Orochi. Schoolchildren are retaught the country's history through the lens of Oden, as citizens discuss that the man who defeated Kaidou was someone named Joy Boy. They believe that he has already left the country, even compared his heroism to "Sword God" Ryuma and the Akazaya Nine make plans to construct a temple for Oden and bury Yasuie, Ashura and Izou in Ringo. When Luffy and Zoro awaken after a week of sleep. After reunited with Momonosuke (who they initially don't recognize since he became an adult), they celebrate with members of the alliance in the bathhouse. In Tokage Port, as Franky finishes repairing the Thousand Sunny and General Franky, Kid and Law are informed by Apoo of their updated bounties and the new Four Emperors now that Kaido and Big Mom have fallen. Meanwhile, Marine Admiral Ryokugyu approaches the Land of Wano, Sakazuki ordering him not to cause a commotion.

1080.title_eng: A Celebration Banquet! The New Emperors of the Sea!
1080.title_romanji: Shukusai no Utage! Atarashiki Umi no Kōtei-tachi!
1080.title_jap: 祝祭の宴！新しき海の皇帝達！
1080.summary: News of Big Mom and Kaido's defeat spread internationally, but the Five Elders attempt to censor Luffy's wanted poster depicting him as Nika and remove the "D." from his name. Despite their efforts, they are unable to contact the printing companies and the uncensored image is shown to the public. The new bounties of Luffy, Law and Kid are announced, each being given a bounty of 3 billion berries. The Straw Hat Pirates visit the Flower Capital to join the extended Fire Festival and banquet, where they participate in its activities. Meanwhile, Robin locates the country's Poneglyph, where she is met by Tenguyama. Tenguyama reveals himself to be Kouzuki Sukiyaki, Oden's father. Sukiyaki was imprisoned by the Kurozumi Family. Sukiyaki escaped many years later after Oden's death, but upon seeing the way Orochi transformed the country, he went into hiding. In the present day, Robin reveals that she learned from the Poneglyph in Alabasta that the ancient weapon Pluton was indeed located within Wano which Sukiyaki confirms. In the former Udon Prisoner Mine, defeated Beasts Pirates, including King and Queen, bandage their wounds, but are visited by Ryokugyu. After instigating a battle, King and Queen are both defeated by Ryokugyu's Devil Fruit ability, allowing him to manipulate vines which pierce and dehydrate his targets. Ryokugyu orders their arrest and a battleship to come to Wano before heading to the Flower Capital to pursue Luffy. As the banquet continues, Momonosuke remembers Luffy's instructions to him, telling him not to reveal his involvement in the raid. Upon receiving these news, Kid interrupts Luffy at the festival and attempts to kill him but Luffy quickly grabs him, and everyone starts partying. After a bit, though, Kid breaks free of Luffy's grip as he tells him he cares nothing for the party and simply came to kill him, though he does tell him that the Four Emperors now consists of "Blackbeard" Teach, "Red-Haired" Shanks, Buggy "the Genius Jester" and "Straw Hat" Luffy himself. Meanwhile, Ryokugyu approaches the Flower Capital, planning to kill Luffy.

1081.title_eng: The World Will Burn! The Onslaught of a Navy Admiral!
1081.title_romanji: Sekai ga Moeru! Kaigun Taishō Shūrai!
1081.title_jap: 世界が燃える！海軍大将襲来！
1081.summary: The Red Hair Pirates approach the borders of the Land of Wano. Meanwhile, as Ryokugyu approaches the Flower Capital, the Akazaya Nine (save for Kin'emon and Kiku) and Shinobu detect his presence and confront him, deciding not to tell the Straw Hats as they're still recovering. Declaring his beliefs that the Celestial Dragons are true god, Ryokugyu uses his Logia-type Woods-Woods Fruit powers to transform into a wooden golem, repelling all the samurai's attacks. He then states that since the Land of Wano isn't affiliated with the World Government he can slaughter as many of its citizens as he wants until he gets Luffy, claiming "discrimination creates solace" before Yamato arrives to aid the samurai. Back with the Red Hair Pirates, everyone except Yasopp, who is afraid to face Usopp, wants to see Luffy again after so long. Shanks remembers his experiences with Luffy, having stolen the Gum-Gum Fruit from a CP9 ship only for it to be eaten by Luffy. Shanks decides not to meet Luffy in the Land of Wano, instead deciding to deal with Bartolomeo, who burned a Red Hair Pirates jolly roger on Shanks' territory and replaced it with that of the Straw Hat Pirates. In Marine Headquarters, Sakazuki holds a meeting with Kizaru and Criminal Investigative Service director Kurouma regarding the Revolutionary Army's invasion of Mariejois, which led to Sabo apparently assassinating of Nefertari Cobra, the disappearance of Vivi, and the freeing of Bartholomew Kuma from slavery. Saint Charlos was also victim of a failed assassination attempt from an unknown assailant, whose escape was aided by Mjosgard, whose actions are currently deliberating by the World Nobles. With the successful attack on the World Government, Sabo gained worldwide support among rebels for his rebellion efforts, now dubbed the "Flame Emperor". Kizaru also pointed out that Luffy's new status an emperor has greatly increased the influence of his adoptive brother Sabo. Back in Wano, Momonosuke in his dragon form arrives to his retainer's aid. He tries but fails to breathe fire before being overwhelmed by the Admiral and ensnared in his wooden vines. Yamato tries to help but Momonosuke demands she stay out of the fight. At the end of the meeting, Sakazuki laments about the era in which he lived in, but vows to destroy all opposition to the World Government. Meanwhile, Shanks decides to go after the One Piece.

1082.title_eng: The Coming of the New Era! The Red-Haired's Imperial Rage
1082.title_romanji: Shin Jidai Tōrai! Akagami no Kōtei no Ikari
1082.title_jap: 新時代到来！赤髪の皇帝の怒り
1082.summary: As the Straw Hat Pirates and Heart Pirates continue to participate in the Flower Capital's festivities. In the outskirts of the Flower Capital, the Akazaya Nine continue their battle against Ryokugyu, but are overwhelmed by his ability. Raizo attempts to use his scrolls to blast Ryokugyu, but the Admiral reveals that his wood is flame-resistant before piercing Raizo with his vines and drains him of liquids. Momonosuke orders Yamato not to participate in the combat but becomes cornered by Ryokugyu's vines. Sukiyaki directs Robin and Law (who had followed Robin) to a passage leading underground. The passage leads deep into the sea, showing an ancient lost civilization on the sea floor. The predecessor to the current Land of Wano, the civilization was flooded by rainwater eight centuries prior after they erected boundary walls around the country. Sukiyaki shows Robin and Law to the Road Poneglyph at the bottom of the staircase, and reveals that Pluton is even further underground, but the only way to reveal it would be to open the country's borders by destroying the physical boundary walls. Robin asks why Oden would want the borders open knowing an Ancient Weapon would be unleashed, but Sukiyaki says he's unsure, believing Oden may had discovered something during his voyage overseas. As Ryokugyu ensnares Yamato and the Akazaya, he states that while cruel, Kaido deterred potential threats before once again demanding for Luffy. after relying on the Straw Hats for so long, he needs to prove that he and his retainers can fend for themselves once they leave. Yamato urges Momonosuke to call Luffy and the others to take Ryokugyu down, but he refuses to involve them, saying after relying on the Straw Hats for so long, he needs to prove that he and his retainers can fend for themselves once they leave. Remembering Luffy, Momonosuke successfully manages to breathe fire in a similar manner to Kaidou's Blast Breath, destroying Ryokugyu's wooden golem form and forcing him to revert to his human form. Before he can retaliate Shanks, a short distance from the coast, sends a powerful wave of Conquer's Haki at Ryokugyu from a distance, overwhelming him. Shanks himself says that he thinks that going after the new generation of pirates while they have their guard down seems tasteless, asking if the new age scares him that much. His presence convinces Ryokugyu to abandon his mission, and the samurai and Yamato celebrate their victory. Luffy, Zoro, Sanji, and Jinbe, are shown to have been watching the fight waiting to intervene only if needed. They remark that their samurai friends were amazing and how intense Shanks’ Haki was to be able to drive Ryokugyu away. They don't know that it was him though, but Luffy has his suspicions as Shanks sails away.

1083.title_eng: The World That Moves On! A New Organization, Cross Guild
1083.title_romanji: Ugoku Sekai! Shin Soshiki Kurosu Girudo
1083.title_jap: 動く世界！新組織クロスギルド
1083.summary: Kin'emon and Kikunojo visit Raizo and Shinobu, in critical condition due to dehydration inflicted by Ryokugyu. As they talk it is mentioned that Kin'emon has reunited with Tsuru Carrot meets with the Minks privately; Dogstorm and Cat Viper have decided to remain in the Land of Wano to defend the shogun, so they entrust the Mokomo Dukedom to Carrot. Despite Carrot trying to refuse the role, the two reminded her travels with Luffy's crew gave her a broader view than most minks and that she possesses the same will that Pedro once had. Meanwhile, Sukiyaki then reveals his identity to Momonosuke, Hiyori, and the other Akazaya Nine, where he apologizes for going into hiding following Oden's death. Robin reports her findings regarding Pluton to the Straw Hat Pirates. Despite knowing the weapon is located in the country, Luffy decides not to attempt to uncover the weapon. Shinobu then arrives, having regained her youthful form following Ryokugyu's attack. She is accompanied by Tama, who has become her kunoichi apprentice. Tama asks Luffy if she can join his crew, and he accepts following she masters ninjutsu. Caribou, who was eavesdropping nearby, is shocked by the truth about Pluton, and must let a certain person know about it. A few days later, Momonosuke attempts to meet with them, but learns from Hiyori that the Straw Hat Pirates have all already left the castle. Kin'emon arrives and tells Momonosuke that they didn't know about their departure either and both become angry. The Straw Hat Pirates, Heart Pirates and Kid Pirates all prepare to depart the country via Tokage Port. After briefly arguing about their next direction, Kid presents a poster to Luffy. The poster reveals that Buggy now an Emperor has joined forces with Mihawk and Crocodile, though Luffy and Zoro highly doubt Buggy is actually in charge. The three have formed the Cross Guild, an organization which assigns bounties to Marines, now placing Marine soldiers under threat of civilian bounty hunters. As they prepare to depart, Law gives Kid a rubbing of Wano's Road Poneglyph, and the latter reveals his crew had managed to take one from Whole Cake Island some time ago. Killer states that in order to take part in the upcoming war over the One Piece, they need to find a "man with a burn mark". Momonosuke and Kin'emon meet with Yamato, who vows to live like Oden did.

1084.title_eng: Time to Depart - The Land of Wano and the Straw Hats
1084.title_romanji: Tabidachi no Toki - Wano kuni to Mugiwara no Ichimi
1084.title_jap: 旅立ちの時 ワノ国と麦わらの一味
1084.summary: Before their departure from the Land of Wano, Luffy and the Akazaya Nine (minus Kin'emon) and Shinobu visit the mountain where Kuri Castle once stood. Paying respects to Oden, they vow to return the Land of Wano to its state before it was taken over by the Kurozumi Family. They bid farewell to the Straw Hat Pirates as they prepare for their departure from the country, and Carrot also says her goodbye leaving towards Mokomo Dukedom. Meanwhile, Zoro visits Pedro and Yasuie's graves with alcohol, where he is joined by Toko and Hiyori. Zoro vows to increase his strength to fully master Enma as Oden has. At Tokage Port, Franky requests Minatomo's help in repairing the Thousand Sunny, but finds the ship to be in perfect condition. In the Flower Capital, Usopp purchases cloth and Sanji sells out his remaining Special Soba, being visited by Some and Chuji. As Okobore Town is being rebuilt, Luffy visits Tsurujo's tea house for oshiruko, bidding goodbye to Tama. At Tokage Port, the Straw Hat Pirates prepare to make their departure, Chopper gives Bepo a special drug. The Straw Hats have reservations about not bidding farewell to Momonosuke and Kin'emon but Luffy is confident they will appear.

1085.title_eng: The Last Curtain! Luffy and Momonosuke's Vow
1085.title_romanji: Shūmaku! Rufi to Momonosuke no Chikai
1085.title_jap: 終幕！ルフィとモモの助の誓い
1085.summary: Wano Country starts to thrive after Orochi is deposed and Kaido is defeated. The tale of the Raid on Onigashima is narrated on stage in front of an audience. Elsewhere, Momonosuke, Kin'emon, and Yamato rush towards Tokage Port to catch up to the Straw Hat Pirates. On the way, Yamato tells Momonosuke that she will be staying in Wano instead of going with Luffy because she wants to do as Oden did and travel across Wano before setting out into the world. Meanwhile, Momonosuke feels betrayed that Luffy would leave him behind before even saying farewell, despite all the adventures they had together. Kin'emon also feels slighted by the Straw Hats' actions. At the Tokage Port, Luffy parts ways with Law and Kid and they say their not-so-friendly farewells. The Kid Pirates and Heart Pirates sail towards their agreed destinations. Before the Straw Hats can follow them, Momonosuke arrives at the beach, running. The young shogun expresses how hurt he is that the Straw Hats were leaving without saying their goodbyes. He bursts into tears, begging them not to go. Luffy hands him a Straw Hat Jolly Roger as a sign of their friendship and to remind him of their time together. He tells Momonosuke that he will always think of him as his little brother. He adds that if Momonosuke, Kin'emon, and Yamato ever decided to become pirates, he will return and pick them up anytime. The Straw Hats finally set sail and head to Hakumai, Wano's official port that has a lift to lower ships, which is a much safer alternative than going through the waterfalls they previously went through when they arrived at Wano. Kid ridicules Luffy and Law for using the official port―a much safer option, which is characteristic of an "average pirate". Law and Luffy are irked by Kid's remarks and take the provocation as a challenge and head towards the waterfalls instead, causing call all three crews to go over the falls. Meanwhile, the tale of the Raid on Onigashima continues and the audience listened to how Wano was saved from its darkest hour. The citizens of Wano learned of Big Mom's role in the great battle and as a result has become a legend in the country called "O-Lin the Great Yōkai" and Kaido is now known as the "Dragon King". As everyone listened in awe of how the "three mighty outlaws" recruited by Shogun Momonosuke overcame the menacing forces, the narrator of the epic tale told Hiyori's final words to the former shogun as he burned to death: "Black charcoal would not be called Kurozumi if it wasn't burned!" As Momonosuke heads back to the Flower Capital, he contemplates where to fly the Straw Hats' flag as the curtain closes on the Land of Wano Arc.

1086.title_eng: A New Emperor! Buggy the Genius Jester!
1086.title_romanji: Shin Kōtei! Senryō Dōke no Bagī!
1086.title_jap: 新皇帝！千両道化のバギー！
1086.summary: As the Straw Hats leave Wano, an angry Nami beats up Luffy and locks him in a cage for going down the waterfall. The crew then find out their new bounties. Luffy and his crew are now referred to as the senior captain and senior officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. but Chopper and Franky are both angry, the former because his bounty hardly increased and the latter because the Thousand Sunny is shown on his poster instead of his face. Nami and Usopp are both horrified that their bounties are so high. Brook is happy about his new bounty while Robin is uninterested. Sanji is initially proud that his bounty is now over a billion but becomes jealous upon learning that Jinbe and Zoro's bounties are higher than his, with Jinbe being glad to be recognized as a member of the Straw Hat Pirates and Zoro (having the second highest bounty of the crew) rubbing it in Sanji's face. Meanwhile, on Emptee Bluffs Island, Mihawk and Crocodile confront Buggy for being portrayed as the clown's subordinates, with none of Buggy's administration members helping him. It is revealed that when the Navy came to apprehend Buggy, Crocodile saved him in order to collect the money Buggy owed him so he could use it to fund an organization he was founding with Mihawk. When Bugguy could not pay him back, he offered his and his crew's services. Unfortunately, due to their love for him, Buggy's crew unwillingly advertised as the Cross Guild's leader, leading the Marines to combine that with previous deeds attributed to him and officially recognize him as an Emperor of the Sea. While initially infuriated, Mihawk and Crocodile relent after they realize it is not the worst idea to have Buggy bear the brunt of the Marines' attention and have him become one of the new Emperors of the Sea. Thus, the Cross Guild is established with Buggy as the figurehead, and Mihawk and Crocodile as its Chief Officers.

1087.title_eng: The War on the Island of Women! A Case Involving Koby the Hero
1087.title_romanji: Nyōgashima no Ran! Eiyū Kobī no Ikken
1087.title_jap: 女ヶ島の乱！英雄コビーの一件
1087.summary: As Marco departs the Red Hair Pirates ship taking him to Whitebeard's homeland Sphinx, he remembers leaving the land of Wano. It is revealed that Yamato's real reason for staying in Wano was to protect it after Ryokugyu's attack made her realize that more powerful people will try to invade the country. As Marco said his goodbyes, Luffy thanks him for protecting him in Marineford. Marco accepts his thanks and says that Ace would be proud of how far he had come before saying that the times belong to him and the other youngsters of his generation. Back to the present on Amazon Lily, Gloriosa laments at how the island was invaded by men with part of its mountain cut down and its town heavily damaged. A bandaged Boa Hancock tells her that so long as she stays on the island, the Marines will return, especially with the Warlord system abolished. A few weeks prior the Marines invade Amazon Lily to arrest Hancock with the aid of a pair their new Seraphim Pacifista. The Seraphim bore great resemblance to Hancock and Mihawk as children while also possessing Lunarian-like traits. However, the Blackbeard Pirates also invade Amazon Lily, where Blackbeard, along with Vasco Shot and Catarina Devon, plans to steal Hancock Devil Fruit power. Blackbeard fights the Seraphim who resembles a younger Mihawk, who slices the island's mountain in two. Meanwhile, Hancock engages the Marines and turns all of them (save for Koby) to stone, as well as Blackbeard's crew. The Seraphim try to attack Hancock, despite Koby's orders for them to stand down as their attacks would shatter the petrified Marines. Hancock attempts to strike Koby but she is intercepted by Blackbeard, who grabs her by the throat and nullifies her abilities with his Dark-Dark Fruit powers. Blackbeard, whose bounty is now 3.996 billion berries, expresses his desire to obtain her Devil Fruit, but she told him that her powers were nothing without her beauty. She added that if he killed her, his people would remain petrified, and the next user would be unable to undo the petrification.

1088.summary: Joined by Rayleigh and Shakky (whose full name is revealed to be Shakuyaku, and is the former captain of the Kuja Pirates and former Empress of Amazon Lily two generations prior), Hancock and the Kuja Pirates reflect on how they repelled the Marines and the Blackbeard Pirates invasion of Amazon Lily, though Rayleigh admits he would not have been able to beat Blackbeard in combat. After subduing Hancock, Blackbeard demanded she undo her petrification of his crew. He asks Koby, who wants the Marines also restored, for assistance, saying Koby's actions in the Rocky Port Incident allowed Blackbeard to conquer Fullalead. Hancock attempted to form a peace deal with him, agreeing to reverse the petrification done on his pirates if they retreated. However, Blackbeard doggedly refuses, attempting to kill her under the belief that she was going to petrify everyone the moment she was no longer under the effect of the Dark-Dark Fruit. However, Rayleigh appears on the island and intervenes, intimidating Blackbeard into submission with Conqueror's Haki. Rayleigh oversees the deal, forcing both the Marines and Blackbeard Pirates to leave. However, it is revealed that Koby was kidnapped by Blackbeard shortly after their departure. In the present day, the Kuja Pirates fear the Marines' Seraphims, who left the conflict without taking any damage. They also note that one of the Seraphim bears a striking resemblance to Hancock in her childhood. In the Kamabakka Kingdom, members of the Revolutionary Army worry about Sabo's safety after being blamed by newspapers for the assassination of King Nefertari Cobra, though Dragon states he will not forgive Sabo if he did kill Cobra, no matter the reason. However, they receive a call on a Transponder Snail from Sabo, confirming that he is alive, though the call is intercepted by the Navy. Meanwhile, on the Thousand Sunny, the Straw Hat Pirates mourn Cobra's death and express concern for Vivi's safety, but they doubt Sabo's involvement given that the Revolutionary Army has never targeted a monarch. It is revealed that Caribou is trapped in a barrel on the Sunny. Although most members intend to rescue Vivi, Zoro opposes the idea, stating that it is still too early to act, and Vivi must fend for herself at the moment. Resting on the ship deck, Luffy reflects on the brotherhood oath he made with Ace and Sabo. He then reveals to his crew the end of his dream, an ambition even larger than becoming the King of the Pirates. Though it is not revealed, each of the Straw Hat Pirates are baffled, with Usopp believing Luffy's dream to be impossible, and Franky and Chopper amazed and supporting the idea.

1089.title_eng: Entering a New Chapter! Luffy and Sabo's Paths!
1089.title_romanji: Shinshō Totsunyū! Rufi to Sabo no Shinro!
1089.title_jap: 新章突入！ルフィとサボの針路！
1089.summary: After leaving Wano, the Straw Hats pursue the final Road Poneglyph, vital to Luffy's dream of becoming the King of the Pirates. Meanwhile, Sabo's communication with the Revolutionary Army is abruptly halted by the Marines, resulting in the destruction of Lulusia. Later, while the Straw Hats rescue a girl from the sea, they encounter a massive shark that threatens their ship.

1090.title_eng: A New Island! Future Island Egghead
1090.title_jap: 新しい島！未来島エッグヘッド
1090.summary: Luffy, Chopper, and the girl, who reveals herself as Jewelry Bonney, are rescued by Jinbe. The rest of the crew is attacked by the shark and capsizes, but are eventually saved by a woman who claims to be Dr. Vegapunk. Meanwhile, Helmeppo seeks Prince Grus' aid to save Koby.

1091.title_eng: Brimming with the Future! An Adventure on the Island of Science!
1091.title_romanji: Mirai Mansai! Kagaku no Kuni no Bōken!
1091.title_jap: 未来満載！科学の国の冒険！
1091.summary: Lilith, a satellite of Vegapunk, attacks the Thousand Sunny, but is stopped by Shaka, another satellite of Vegapunk, who identifies Zoro and Robin. He orders Lilith to bring the Straw Hats to him. Meanwhile, Luffy, Bonney, Jinbe, and Chopper explore Egghead. Bonney threatens to get revenge on Vegapunk for turning her father, into a cyborg. They encounter holograms of Egghead's inventions and meet another satellite, Atlas, who also reveals herself to be Vegapunk.

1092.title_eng: Bonney's Lamentation! Darkness Lurking on the Future Island
1092.title_romanji: Bonī no Dōkoku! Mirai Shima ni Hisomu Yami
1092.title_jap: ボニーの慟哭！未来島に潜む闇
1092.summary: A CP0 unit that resembles Bartholomew Kuma is dispatched to Egghead to eliminate Dr. Vegapunk. Meanwhile, as Luffy's group faces an assault from a Pacifista, Bonney recognizes its resemblance to Kuma and reveals him to be her father. She orders Luffy to stop attacking it. In another part of the New World, the Heart Pirates come under attack from the Blackbeard Pirates.

1093.title_eng: The Winner Takes All! Law vs. Blackbeard!
1093.title_jap: 勝者総取り！ローVS黒ひげ！
1093.summary: After an assault by the Blackbeard Pirates, the Heart Pirates flee and dock on a nearby island. Trafalgar Law is confronted and attacked by Doc Q. Van Augur and Burgess, but Law easily counters. Blackbeard aims to seize their Road Poneglyphs, which commences a heated battle. Meanwhile, Charlotte Pudding is revealed to be a prisoner on board the Blackbeard Pirates' ship. At Marine Headquarters, Sakazuki awaits the outcome of the battle between Law and Blackbeard. Blackbeard uses his powers to retaliate against Law's attacks by shrouding him in darkness.

1094.title_jap: 深まる謎！エッグヘッド.mw-parser-output .templateruby>rt{font-variant-east-asian:ruby;font-size:85%}.mw-parser-output .templateruby.large{font-size:250%}.mw-parser-output .templateruby.large>rt{font-size:50%}研究層（ラボフェーズ）
1094.summary: Luffy, Chopper, Jinbe, and Bonney evade the Pacifista after Bonney uses her Devil Fruit powers to confuse it. Jinbe reveals Kuma's backstory as a deposed king, later becoming a pirate and eventually a cyborg. Meanwhile, Lilith leads the other Straw Hats to Egghead's Labophase. There, they encounter a Seraphim resembling Jinbe. Shaka, one of the six Vegapunk satellites, contacts Dragon, informing him that he predicts his own demise.

1095.title_eng: The Brain of a Genius - Six Vegapunks!
1095.title_romanji: Tensai no Zunō - Rokunin no Begapanku!
1095.title_jap: 天才の頭脳 6人のベガパンク！
1095.summary: The Straw Hats fall into Lilith's trap and are forced to face S-Shark, who wields multiple powers. Sanji, Robin, and Usopp's attacks fail against it. Lilith, along with two other satellites of Vegapunk, Edison, and Pythagoras control S-Shark from afar. Edison conducts experiments on S-Shark to help it evolve. Shaka halts the fight, and he reveals Egghead's history. Meanwhile, Luffy's group finds an old, advanced robot in a scrapyard.

1096.title_eng: A Forbidden Piece of History! A Theory Concerning a Kingdom
1096.title_romanji: Kinji Rareta Rekishi! Aru Ōkoku no Kasetsu
1096.title_jap: 禁じられた歴史！ある王国の仮説
1096.summary: Shaka discusses his theory with Sanji's group regarding an ancient kingdom connected to the Void Century. He believes this kingdom was eradicated by the World Government to erase its history. Shaka links this theory to the Ohara Incident, where scholars sought to uncover this history. During his visit to Ohara, Shaka found discarded books that were saved by the scholars during the island's destruction. Meanwhile, Luffy and Chopper investigate an ancient robot and encounter the real Dr. Vegapunk.

1097.title_eng: The Will of Ohara! The Inherited Research
1097.title_jap: オハラの意志！受け継がれる研究
1097.summary: Shaka tells Sanji's group about how the giants saved Ohara's books 22 years ago when Dr. Vegapunk met up with Dragon. He also confirms to Robin the identity of their leader. At the scrapyard, Bonney attempts to kill Vegapunk. Meanwhile, a masked assassin approaches Egghead.

1098.title_eng: The Eccentric Dream of a Genius!
1098.title_romanji: Kisō Tengai! Tensai ga Omoiegaku Yume!
1098.title_jap: 奇想天外！天才が想い描く夢！
1098.summary: Luffy's group questions Vegapunk about the Iron Giant, a legendary robot linked to an ancient power source. Vegapunk desires to leave Egghead to pursue his ambition of harnessing infinite energy, making him a target for CP0 assassins. Meanwhile, CP0 led by Rob Lucci forcefully makes his way into Egghead. Kuma breaks free during repairs in Kamabakka Kingdom, escaping Dragon and Ivankov's pursuit.

1099.title_eng: Preparations for Interception! Rob Lucci Strikes!
1099.title_jap: 迎撃準備！ロブ・ルッチ襲来！
1099.summary: As Lucci's group launches their invasion of Egghead, Shaka begins the preparations to deal with it. However, Atlas ignores orders and is damaged when attempting to fight Lucci. Upon arriving at that location, an angry Luffy prepares to engage Lucci in battle.

1100.title_eng: Powers on a Different Level! Luffy vs. Lucci!
1100.title_romanji: I Jigen no Chikara! Rufi tai Rutchi!
1100.title_jap: 異次元の力！ルフィVSルッチ！
1100.summary: Sakazuki learns that the Straw Hats are on Egghead and are aligning with Vegapunk. He sends Kizaru to support Lucci and the CP0 agents. Despite being given orders, Lucci disobeys and battles Luffy. They both transform into their awakened forms. Vegapunk explains the uniqueness of Luffy's Devil Fruit, linking it to Nika, the Sun God. Sentomaru arrives and aids Luffy with the help of the Seraphims, but he ends up being knocked out by Lucci's attack.

1101.title_eng: The Strongest Form of Humanity! The Seraphim's Powers!
1101.title_romanji: Saikyō no Jinrui! Serafimu no Nōryoku!
1101.title_jap: 最強の人類！セラフィムの能力！
1101.summary: The battle between Luffy and Lucci continues, with Luffy overpowering Lucci. The rest of the Straw Hats learn from Vegapunk that certain Devil Fruit powers are able to be replicated through blood transfusion. Luffy rejoins Jinbe and the others, as the group makes their way to the Labophase area of Egghead. After his defeat, Lucci is reunited with Kaku and Stussy.

1102.title_eng: Sinister Schemes! The Operation to Escape Egghead
1102.title_jap: 蠢く陰謀！エッグヘッド脱出作戦
1102.summary: Luffy, Bonney, and Jinbe make it to Vegapunk's lab, where Atlas is tended to. With the defeat of Sentomaru, CP0 regains control of the Seraphims. Kuma, having escaped the Kammabakka Kingdom, crashes at Red Port. Vegapunk calls on the help of another ally to escape the island. A mysterious force deactivates the Frontier Dome defense system, allowing CP0 to enter. Kizaru is seen approaching Egghead with a marine fleet.

1103.title_eng: Turn Back My Father! Bonney's Futile Wish!
1103.title_romanji: Chichi o Modose! Hakanaki Bonī no Negai!
1103.title_jap: 父を戻せ！儚きボニーの願い！
1103.summary: Kaku and Zoro engage in a battle after Kaku fails to destroy the Thousand Sunny. Bonney pursues Dr. Vegapunk, demanding answers about Kuma. The Kid Pirates arrive at Elbaf. Meanwhile, Garp makes his way to G-14 to announce his rescue mission to retrieve Koby.

1104.title_eng: A Desperate Situation! The Seraphim's All-out Attack!
1104.title_jap: 絶体絶命！セラフィム総攻撃！
1104.summary: Bonney discovers a glowing paw, realizing it contains Kuma's memories stored before he became a cyborg. Vegapunk tries to deceive her but fails. Meanwhile, Kuma clashes with the Marines while attempting to climb the Red Line. In the fight between Kaku and Zoro, Kaku unveils his enhanced Devil Fruit form. Suddenly, Stussy reveals her true nature and betrays Kaku and Lucci, attacking them both before turning her attention towards Zoro.

1105.title_eng: A Beautiful Act of Treason! The Spy, Stussy!
1105.title_jap: 麗しき反逆！内通者ステューシー
1105.summary: Stussy reveals herself to be a spy for Vegapunk. Zoro briefly battles S-Hawk until Edison arrives and regains control over the Seraphims. Stussy restrains Lucci and Kaku, neutralizing their powers. As they prepare to leave, Luffy and Chopper search for Vegapunk and Bonney, finding the former missing. Days earlier, on Sphinx Island, Marines invade a village, seeking Whitebeard's treasure, but Weevil intervenes. Weevil's mother tells Marco that Ryokugyu captured Weevil. While heading towards Egghead, Kizaru and Saint Jaygarcia Saturn, one of the Five Elders, talk about Dr. Vegapunk.

1106.title_jap: 異常発生！探せ！Dr.（ドクター）ベガパンク
1106.summary: Sentomaru sends numerous Pacifista Mark III units to handle World Government officials. Meanwhile, Shaka informs the Straw Hat Pirates of the current situation, resulting in the group setting out to find Vegapunk, leaving Luffy and Zoro to guard unconscious Lucci and Kaku. Bonney delves into Kuma's memories to understand her father's cyborg transformation. On Morgans' airship, Morgans creates a false news article depicting Luffy as Dr. Vegapunk's kidnapper, which is opposed by Vivi.

1107.title_eng: A Shudder! The Evil Hand Creeping Up on the Laboratory
1107.title_romanji: Senritsu! Kenkyūjo e Shinobiyoru Ma no Te
1107.title_jap: 戦慄！研究所へ忍び寄る魔の手
1107.summary: Bonney delves into her father's memories, witnessing his childhood trauma. Meanwhile, chaos ensues in the lab as an explosion occurs, cutting off communication and disabling security measures. Luffy and Shaka realize someone is causing trouble. The rest of the Straw Hats continue searching for Dr. Vegapunk. Usopp's group finds Pythagoras, damaged from the explosion, while S-Snake petrifies York.

1108.title_jap: 理解不能！セラフィムの反逆！
1108.summary: As Usopp's group faces off against S-Snake, Zoro and Luffy are trapped in their own battle against S-Bear and S-Hawk. Shaka suspects that one of the Vegapunks may be controlling the Seraphim and realizes that they're in a troubling situation with communication cut off. Lucci and Kaku make a suggestion to Luffy and Zoro: that they form a temporary alliance.

1109.title_eng: A Tough Decision! An Unusual United Front!
1109.title_romanji: Kujū no Ketsudan! Ishoku no Kyōtō Sensen!
1109.title_jap: 苦渋の決断！異色の共闘戦線！
1109.summary: Zoro and Luffy battle S-Hawk and S-Bear, aided by Lucci and Kaku after negotiations for a temporary truce. Meanwhile, on Elbaf, Shanks and his crew prepare to face the Kid Pirates at sea, offering Kid a choice between surrendering his copies of the Road Poneglyphs or engaging in battle.

1110.title_eng: Survive! Deadly Combat with the Strongest Form of Humanity!
1110.title_romanji: Ikinokore! Saikyō no Jinrui to no Shitō
1110.title_jap: 生き残れ！最強の人類との死闘
1110.summary: Luffy, Zoro, Lucci, and Kaku battle S-Bear and S-Hawk, whose Lunarian abilities resist attacks. Zoro and Shaka discover their weakness: vulnerability when their flames are extinguished. On Building A's third floor, Nami, Brook, and Edison confront S-Shark, with Sanji joining in. Meanwhile, Lilith, Franky, Pythagoras, and Usopp face S-Snake; Usopp and Lilith are both petrified by S-Snake. In the basement, Shaka finds Cipher Pol agents and Vegapunk before he is fatally attacked.

1111.title_eng: The Second Ohara! The Mastermind's Ambition!
1111.title_romanji: Ohara no Sairai! Kuromaku no Yabō!
1111.title_jap: オハラの再来！黒幕の野望！
1111.summary: Kizaru's ship heads to Egghead with Saint Jaygarcia Saturn on board. Franky fails to stop S-Snake from destroying Pythagoras. Robin, Chopper, and Atlas search for Vegapunk, while Sanji battles S-Shark. Luffy, Zoro, Lucci, and Kaku discover S-Hawk has escaped, prompting Zoro and Kaku to pursue it.
